notes.content:

[b]<Event>[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0d7956b1f44189e48d75fa972feedce0526a7ebd.png[/img]
 - Black Swan
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/629d131af0b8c674546abfde9032bdebc06b56c3.png[/img]
 - Black Hound

2. Master Road Event (September 20, 2025 (Sat) After Maintenance - October 1, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5ef33ad908e3d91b4680be7a9fc088fa782795f5.png[/img]
 - For 15 days, players can log in to the game for 30 minutes to receive a daily Login Reward.
- Players can acquire the [Iris Card Box], [Event] Imprint of Harvest (1 Day) Box, Single Stat Change Scroll, Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll, GP Item Property Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, and various other items.

3. Master Road Event (September 20, 2025 (Sat) After Maintenance - October 22, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a1efa2e326e5caf98224dcb62971842c44c7f7b6.png[/img]
 - Players can navigate to the event screen by clicking the [Master Road] event icon button at the top of the screen in the World Map during the event period.
- When maintenance begins on October 22, the ongoing [Master Road] event along with any unclaimed [Mission Rewards], [Cumulative Score Rewards], and [Refinery Event Item Crafting] will all end. Please make sure to claim rewards before the maintenance starts.

1) Event Mission
- Event missions consist of Growth, Equipment, and Iris-exclusive missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/22f39018433269037487ac7d3837de584b65025e.png[/img]
(1) Missions in the [Growth] tab can be completed with any character and focus on character/account growth.
(2) Missions in the [Equipment] tab can be completed with any character and focus on equipment progression.
(3) Missions in the [Iris] tab can only be completed with the new character, 'Iris'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f6f4c4724ea8f082bd16ee6e714e2f034adbd239.png[/img]
- Click the [Guide] button to view content details.
- Click the [Shortcut] button to quickly access related content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7cd9c65cd228de60e83cb756fb9b52a9b17841ba.png[/img]
- Upon clearing a mission, click the [Receive Reward] button to receive mission points and rewards.
- Points obtained through mission clears are accumulated.
- Missions can still be completed even after all cumulative score rewards are acquired.

2) Cumulative Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8250e6b53859d3c31f554932bb5683f7c05e846a.png[/img]
- Once enough points are accumulated, [Cumulative Score Rewards] become available. Click the activated reward icon to claim rewards.
- Cumulative score rewards are delivered via mail.

notes.title: [Announcement] Character Balance Survery Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

To prepare for the upcoming balance adjustments and improvements, a survey will be conducted to gather feedback from our players.
Kindly share valuable feedback with the development team.

- Survey Period: September 19, 2025 (Fri) 06:00 - September 26, 2025 (Fri) 06:00 (UTC+0)
- Survey Link: [url=forms.gle/35DXMC3q7PcCZ3s59]forms.gle/35DXMC3q7PcCZ3s59[/url]

We sincerely appreciate the players' ongoing support of Grandchase and their valuable feedback provided to us.
We will strive to create the best experience possible.

Further balance adjustments for Iris will be applied together with the Awakening update on October 1st. Please look forward to these upcoming changes.

Thank you.

- Players can navigate to the event screen by clicking the [Master Road] event icon button at the top of the screen in the World Map during the event period.

- When maintenance begins on October 22, the ongoing [Master Road] event along with any unclaimed [Mission Rewards], [Cumulative Score Rewards], and [Refinery Event Item Crafting] will all end. Please make sure to claim rewards before the maintenance starts.
- Event missions consist of Growth, Equipment, and Iris-exclusive missions.
(1) Missions in the [Growth] tab can be completed with any character and focus on character/account growth.
(2) Missions in the [Equipment] tab can be completed with any character and focus on equipment progression.
(3) Missions in the [Iris] tab can only be completed with the new character, 'Iris'.
- Click the [Guide] button to view content details.
- Click the [Shortcut] button to quickly access related content.
- Upon clearing a mission, click the [Receive Reward] button to receive mission points and rewards.
- Points obtained through mission clears are accumulated.
- Missions can still be completed even after all cumulative score rewards are acquired.
- Once enough points are accumulated, [Cumulative Score Rewards] become available. Click the activated reward icon to claim rewards.
- Cumulative score rewards are delivered via mail.

Collect the diaries and solve the quiz to uncover Iris’s story!

1) Diary Structure
- The diary consists of 3 chapters, each containing 5 diary entries.
- Chapter 2 opens on August 27, 2025, and Chapter 3 opens on September 3, 2025 (UTC+0).

2) How to Collect Diaries
- Each diary can be collected by completing its respective diary mission.
- Players must collect previous diary entries to proceed with the next diary’s mission.
- Chapters 2 and 3 require all diaries from the previous chapters to be collected before players can progress.

3) Quiz
- Once all diaries in a chapter are collected, players can attempt the quiz.
- All quiz questions must be answered correctly for it to count as complete.
- Quizzes can be retried freely.

4) Rewards
- Completing missions grants [Mission Rewards], which are sent directly to the inventory.
- Answering quizzes correctly grants [Chapter Diary Collection Rewards], which are sent to the mailbox.

notes.title: [Announcement] Introducing Iris' Playstyle
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

A new character, Iris, will join GrandChase soon!
Before Iris officially arrives, we’d like to give our Heroes a sneak peek at her unique features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0c60d94310d892d14e38ea7032ac5f5a1ecea866.gif[/img]

Iris is a character who fights using paint-based attacks with her brush, alongside her partner, Luffy.

[b]<Iris’ Paint System>[/b]
 - When Iris attacks enemies with her Z Command, there is a chance for paint drops to appear. Collecting these increases the ‘Paint Gauge’.
 - Once the ‘Paint Gauge’ is full, Iris can unleash a powerful attack through Luffy, consuming all stored paint.
 - Players can use Luffy’s powerful attack strategically to restore MP and maximize the combat flow.

[b]<Paint Gauge and Luffy>[/b]
 - Luffy’s color changes depending on the ‘Paint Gauge’. Players can check the gauge either through Luffy’s appearance or the gauge bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/fda3ac139367f088835e373db7d56b7ba48e256a.png[/img]

We’re working hard to bring even more exciting ways to experience Iris and Luffy in action.
We hope players look forward to meeting Iris very soon!


 +) Iris and Luffy's combined attack surprise preview~! (Released during livestream on August 29th)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/fa8da869a95107baa7a4fe5fd4ceaf056a24a118.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/2d4f13c3c63e8afd9990c5727bfaa05459976322.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0b669958666a63efb5629200d8bf4c60db7b2d1c.gif[/img]


※ Since this is still under development, please note that this may be subject to change in future.

<Go to Iris Pre-Registration>
[b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/event/iris?utm_source=Notice&utm_medium=Steam]Iris, the Girl Who Draws Her Cute Imaginations (LINK)[/url][/b]


Thank you.

notes.title: [Announcement] How to Play GrandChase Classic on Mobile via Steam Link
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

This is a guide on how to play ‘GrandChase Classic’ on a mobile device using Steam Link.

[b]<How to Play via Steam Link>[/b]
1. Install the Steam Link app on a mobile device.
 - Android: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.valvesoftware.steamlink]Download Here[/url]
 - iOS: [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/steam-link/id1246969117]Download Here[/url]

2. On the PC, right-click the Steam client and select [Run as Administrator].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d984caddaf86a5c0949aa5253a58b241f812b8d6.png[/img]

3. Open the Steam Link app on the mobile device.

4. In the Settings, select [Computer].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/2ea6c89d40e768946bf6c1c460ee50af371299b5.png[/img]

5. In the Computer Settings menu, select [Other Computer] and check the 4-digit pairing code displayed on the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5d6fe8fed75d6b156ece5d129ed2c64d878ed0b4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ae693add59efa0f85375f60a14761666bdf4fdf4.png[/img]

6. On the PC, open the menu in the Steam client and click [Settings].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/97ac1a8853de7dfb54ae92c9067eca2aac48ff36.png[/img]

7. Under [Remote Play], select [Pair Steam Link].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/021e26570241daa5b3d6688eaf212df8ccbcdc64.png[/img]

8. When the pairing code input window appears on the PC, enter the 4-digit code shown on the mobile device.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/90ddb576f34e0480ce5739ecd141b6df07f187c9.png[/img]

9. Once pairing is complete, players can launch and play ‘GrandChase Classic’ on mobile through the Steam Link app!


<Additional Notes>
 - When using the touch controller in Steam Link, certain on-screen controls may not display or function as intended.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/bd71a805c4817c2be4f5b09552bab71292759d47.png[/img]
If this issue occurs, [u]tap the Steam logo on the screen to resolve the issue.[/u]
 - Players can also use standard controllers such as Xbox or PS5 controllers. Simply pair them with Steam Link to play immediately on mobile.
 - For more information on Steam Remote Play, check here: [url=https://help.steampowered.com/ko/faqs/view/0689-74B8-92AC-10F2][Learn More About Steam Remote Play](Link)[/url]


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Announcement] GrandChase Classic 4th Anniversary Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8138b66ae132e4f46cad31269f26ad7f7d19379d.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah! 

Various events will take place in celebration of 4th Anniversary of GrandChase Classic. 
We look forward to your interest and participation! 


[b]<Event 1>[/b] 4th Anniversary Loading Image Added (July 28, 2025 (Mon) 06:00 - August 20, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
 - Fan art selected through the 4th Anniversary Fan Art Contest will be featured as new loading screen images.
　We sincerely thank everyone who participated!

[b]<Event 2>[/b] 4th Anniversary Special Attendance Log (July 28, 2025 (Mon) 06:00 - August 20, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d0d8ef888d6de3ad2862bf44737e36a5ee9497cb.png[/img]
 - Starting from July 28th 06:00 (UTC+0) for 15 days, players can log in to the game for 30 minutes to receive a daily Login Reward.
 - Players can acquire the 4th Anniversary Coordi Select Box, 4th Anniversary Pet Select Box, Coordi Fusion Scroll, 4th Anniversary Coordi (21 Days) Select Box, and other various rewards.
 - Players can acquire Coordi items for all parts after completing attendance for 15 days.
 - Pet Sealed Cards cannot be moved to the Warehouse after acquisition. Please be careful when selecting the character who will receive the item

[b]<Event 3>[/b] 4th Anniversary Celebration Buff Event
  - [July 28, 2025 (Mon) 06:00 - July 29, 2025 (Tue) 06:00 (UTC+0)]
　EXP +50%, GP +50%, Item Drop Rate +30% in Dungeons, Equipment Reinforcement Rate +30%, Necklace/Anklet Reinforcement Rate +30%
  - Event Excluded Dungeons: Nightmare Circus, Monster Train 301, Hungry Pets’ Revolt, Moonlight Village, Angry Bosses, Talin’s Revenge, King Slime Dungeon, Trial Forest, Trial Tower, Dimension Door
  - EXP/GP Gain is only applied up to 400% at max.
  - Item Drop Rate and Armor/Necklace/Anklet Reinforcement Increase is only applied up to 100% at max.

[b]<Event 4>[/b] 4th Anniversary Merch Lottery Event
  - Registration Period: July 28, 2025 (Mon) 06:00 - August 20, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0)
  - Winners Announced: After the Registration Period

1) How to Enter
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/fb477fc82f46c15a75f61a6c9ee5ba2014490eb8.png[/img]
 - [4th Anniversary Merch Lottery Ticket]
① Players can acquire 10 Merch Lottery Ticket upon login
② Players can acquire additional tickets by clearing weekly chain missions (Max 10 Daily)
(1) Week 1 (July 28, 2025 (Wed) 06:00 - August 6, 2025 (Wed) 06:00 (UTC+0))
(2) Week 2 (August 6, 2025 (Wed) 06:00 - August 13, 2025 (Wed) 06:00 (UTC+0))
(3) Week 3 (August 13, 2025 (Wed) 06:00 - August 20, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
 - Clear Special Dungeon 3 Times: 4th Anniversary Merch Lottery Ticket x1
 - Clear Special Dungeon 5 Times: 4th Anniversary Merch Lottery Ticket x3
 - Clear Special Dungeon 7 Times: 4th Anniversary Merch Lottery Ticket x6

2) How to Register for the Event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f5b97bfd57756b6758cf4ec2d17723af6a77a66a.png[/img]
① Play the game to acquire Merch Lottery Tickets
② Check the in-game Event Merch Window to see how many tickets are needed to enter for the 4th Anniversary Celebration Merch
③ Choose and Register for the Merch Set

3) Things to Note
 - Players can make multiple entries into a Merch.
 - Each Merch has different number of tickets needed. Make sure to check them out before entering.
 - Players can also check how many players have entered the Merch.

[b][Ticket Count for Merch and Number of Winners][/b]
  - A total of 60 winners will be picked for the 4th Anniversary Celebration Merch. 
  - All Merch Images are for reference and may be different from the actual product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/222dfc0c4f68c1ca266be781c79bf3fcf6fcdbb0.png[/img]

[b][GrandChase Classic 4th Anniversary Celebration Merch Introduction][/b]
① Awakening Acrylic Stand [b](NEW)[/b]
  - A 3D Acrylic Stand that has the Awakening Character Illustration.
  - Players will receive a random character out of the 23 characters available.

② Character Blanket [b](NEW)[/b]
  - A blanket that contains all the characters of GrandChase Classic.
  - Players can use this as a warmer or as a display.

① Pre-Fabricated SD Acrylic Stand
  - Players can see GrandChase characters in a 3D Acrylic Stand. 
  - Players can set display individual pieces by putting them together.

④ Mini Cushion 
  - A mini cushion that has the 3 pets of GrandChase (Little Elesis, Gon, Rocco). 
  - Players can use this as a display or a wrist cushion.

⑤ Uno Acrylic Keyring
  - A keyring that shows Uno in a cute manner.

⑥ 5 Random Character Stickers

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Due to an extension in the maintenance, we will be compensating everyone who logs in during After Maintenance - June 19, 2025 (Thu) 05:59 (UTC+0) with Compensation Chest 1.


Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
June 18th (Wed) 03:00 - 08:30 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
1. Infinite Cloister Expansion/Improvements
 - Added a Stage 4 difficulty and new rewards to Infinite Cloister. 
　Challenge more powerful monsters and prove your strength as a hero! Acquire new rewards and experience Duell's story as it reaches a dramatic conclusion.
 - Improved to reduce the repeat play fatigue for Infinite Cloister.

1) Stage 4 Difficulty
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ca4011d3f69b03b648a7496f1620215c15c37dc3.png[/img]
 - Entry Requirement: Battle Power 1,000,000 or higher
 - Daily Play Limit: 3 per account
 - Entry tickets cannot be used for this dungeon.

2) New Reward
(1) New Legendary Grade Ring
[table]
[tr]
    [th]Crafted Item[/th]
    [th]Material Item 1[/th]
    [th]Material Item 2[/th]
    [th]Material Item 3[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Infinite Cycle Ring[/td]
    [td]Infinite Cycle Ring Fragment[/td]
    [td]Unkeepable Promise III[/td]
    [td]Hero's Bullion[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Infinite Cycle Ring[/td]
    [td]Infinite Cycle Ring Fragment[/td]
    [td]Shining Ring of Infinity (III)[/td]
    [td]Hero's Bullion[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 - Added [Infinite Cycle Ring] which can be acquired on a low change upon defeating Duell (IV) in Infinite Cloister Stage 4 or through upgrade.
 - Clear Infinite Cloister Stage 4 to acquire [Infinite Cycle Ring Fragment] 
 - [Infinite Cycle Ring Fragment] is used to craft [Infinite Cycle Ring]. 

(2) 4 Infinite Cloister Exclusive Monster Cards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/3f88dc0deea64dafcd87e496c680505aab4eef9a.png[/img]
 - Added 4 monster cards that can be acquired on a set chance when defeating monsters in Infinite Cloister Stage 4.
 - All monster cards that appear from Infinite Cloister can be registered in the card collection. 
 - Monster cards that appear from Infinite Cloister cannot be acquired through card fusion.

3) Dungeon Improvements
(1) Repeat Play Improvements
 - After the update, monsters on floors 1-3 that have been cleared once will no longer need to be replayed on the next playthrough.
 - After entering the battle of the selected stage, players will now be able to select a stage to challenge, and will be returned to a place where they can select a stage if they fail to clear the stage.
 - After successfully clearing a stage, players will be able to advance through the stages in a set order.

(2) Reward Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/227751ea16aa01b5e6ba681db4623b4397e2e85e.png[/img]
[table]
[tr]
    [th]Crafted Item[/th]
    [th]Material Item 1[/th]
    [th]Material Item 2[/th]
    [th]Material Item 3[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Unkeepable Promise III[/td]
    [td]Trace of Promise[/td]
    [td]Shining Ring of Infinity (III)[/td]
    [td]Hero's Bullion[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 - Added [Trace of Promise] as a reward for defeating Duell in Infinite Cloister Stage 3.
 - [Trace of Promise] is used to craft [Unkeepable Promise III]. 
 - [Infinity Ring Fragment (III)] can be used to craft [Trace of Promise]. 

2. New Chaser Pass (June 18, 2025 (Wed) After Maintenance - August 20, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a0b2ede1f54c5ac225ca0dacc8e58d9a3a8728a1.png[/img]

(1) Chaser Pass Entry
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d51f22c6dcc37e5f8df138a97362b8c55c4b3f6b.png[/img]
 - Players can enter Chaser Pass by pressing Chaser Pass found in the right-hand bottom corner of the Main Lobby.
 - Chaser Pass Mission will be added to the Repeat Mission and will be marked with [Chaser Pass].
 - There will be Free Chaser Pass and Premium Chaser Pass.

(2) Free Chaser Pass
 - Players can clear Daily and Weekly Missions to receive Pass EXP to raise Pass Level.
 - Players can acquire Pass Levels to open rewards. Players can press the Receive button to claim the rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/09e1c1087a717a3e9469f20c67ae11ac4f0559f6.png[/img]
 - Players can purchase [Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket] to acquire additional Pass EXP equivalent to 1 Level. (Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(3) Free Chaser Pass Reward
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can receive [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card. [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card: 772 Special Attack / 0.87% Taint Resistance
 - Exclusive Reward and Chaser Pass Card Select Box, Special Reinforcement Release Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16), and other various rewards.
 - Players can select 1 of Solar Chaser, Luna Chaser, and Star Chaser Monster Card from the [Chaser Pass Card Select Box].
 - [Solar Chaser] Monster Card: 760 Special Attack / 0.40% Taint Resistance
 - [Lunar Chaser] Monster Card: 475 Attack / 0.40% Taint Resistance
 - [Star Chaser] Monster Card: 26.50% Critical Damage / 0.40% Taint Resistance

(4) Premium Pass
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b733a7937afa899ce0e655e2a43af2b112bb3546.png[/img]
 - Players who purchase [Premium Pass] will receive additional rewards on top of the Free Rewards from the Free Chaser Pass. (Premium Pass Price: 20,000 VP)
 - Players can clear Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal Mission to receive Pass EXP to raise Pass Level.
 - [Chaser Pass - Seasonal Mission] can only be cleared 1 time during the Pass Period after purchasing [Premium Pass].
 - [Premium Pass] will be applied upon purchase and will allow players to receive all rewards up to the Pass Level that the player has reached.
 - Players can purchase [Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket] to acquire additional Pass EXP equivalent to 1 Level. (Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(5) Premium Pass Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/eb57fd846d51d965e30ef1888713d5cbdeda0f4e.png[/img]
 - Players can acquire additional Premium Pass exclusive rewards.
 - Exclusive Reward: [Free] Floaty Tube Motion, [Wings of Blue Wave Coordi Select Box], [Tail of Blue Wave Coordi Select Box] will be added. Players can select and acquire the Coordi for the character of choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/2922cc34810bf57317d50f68cf433ed1cb01200f.gif[/img]
 - [Free] Floaty Tube
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8b4b56c2a671cc8e060df3d430c1a74671ea35bc.png[/img]
 - Wings of Blue Wave Coordi (Epic Grade Season 9 Coordi)
 - Tail of Blue Wave Coordi (Epic Grade Season 9 Coordi)
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can select a Void Challenger, a Void Chaser, or a Void Avenger Monster Card from the [Chaser Pass Card Select Box 2].
- [Voidal Challenger] Monster Card: Critical Damage 31.50% / Taint Resistance 0.43%
- [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card: Special Attack 772 / Taint Resistance 0.87%
- [Voidal Avenger] Monster Card: Attack 515 / Taint Resistance 0.47%
Players can also acquire [Awakening Stone of Transformation], [Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket], [Single Stat Change Support Box], and [Berkas' Property Select Scroll] as exclusive rewards.
 - Players can acquire Another TYPE Coordi Outfit Select Box, Another TYPE Coordi Weapon Select Box, Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), GP Item Property Scroll, Chaser Pass: A box that contains a title for growing heroes, and various other items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7ccbbc55abb92e72900896de04ebbedc863b78e6.png[/img]
 - [Hero Dungeon Sweep Ticket] will be added to the premium pass rewards.
 - Consume [Hero Dungeon Sweep Tickets] to immediately clear The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, or Wizard's Labyrinth.

(6) Other Fixes/Improvements
① Changed the [Special Dungeon Clear] mission details in Daily Missions as follows.
 - Clear Requirement: 1 Time (Before: 3 Times)
 - Pass EXP Reward: 200 (Before: 300)
 - Clear GP Reward: 20,000 (Before: 30,000)

② Changed the [Special Dungeon Clear] mission details in Weekly Missions.
 - Clear Requirement: 12 Times (Before: 9 Times)
 - Pass EXP Reward: 1,000 (Before: 800)


[b]<Event>[/b]

[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Quality of Life Improvements #2
1) Skill Tree Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/2107e3a2e6ff7e0b46b06e83701e8100c1f59a21.png[/img]
 - Improved the UI design and quality of life od the Skill Tree.
 - Changed the skill border icon to more clearly distinguish skill types and ranks.
 - AP/HB characters will be able to view all class skills on a single page.
 - Reduced the prerequisites for unlocking character skills, increasing freedom in skill development.
 - Due to the changes in prerequisites, all skills will be reset. Please adjust the skill tree before entering dungeons or PVP battles.
 - As compensation for the skill tree system revamp, players will receive: SP All Reset x3, Premium GC Club (3 Days), and Hero Dungeon Sweep Ticket x5 via in-game mail. (Login between June 18th After Maintenance - July 9th Before Maintenance (UTC+0). Limit: 1 per Account)

(1) Job Change Guide
 - Improved so that players can view the job skill tree before completing the job mission.
 - Characters who have not completed job missions or awakening will see a [Job Change Now] shortcut icon.

(2) Skill Slot
 - Improved the design of 4th bar special and Awakening special skill slots to distinguish them from regular slots.
 - Fixed the method of displaying skill slots for characters with skill-switching capabilities.
 - Players can now right-click equipped skills in the skill slot or board to unequip them.

(3) Inherent Skills
 - Skills previously acquired through missions will now be classified as 'Inherent Skills'. (Ex: Quicksave, Increased Stored MP, 4th Bar Special, Awakening Special)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f0faacdeee7cb570515dbee3483b994b85cb656f.png[/img]
 - Added a tooltip pop-up window to explain how to acquire Inherent Skills.
 - Players cannot equip 4th Bar Special skills without possessing the Increased Stored MP skill.

(4) Skill Tooltip Improvements
 - Categorized skill types. (Special/Technique/Effect/Select Effect/Command/Special Command)
 - Tooltips will now visually display the amount of MP/AP consumed when a skill is used.
 - Pressing the Alt key while hovering over a skill will show a preview video instead of a description.
 - Skills with a maximum level will now display stat increases per level more clearly (applies only to skills that already showed numerical values).
 - Tooltips for skills unlocked via Core Awakening will now display those unlockable skills.

(5) Other Improvements
 - Skills that cannot be acquired due to unmet conditions will show a message over their icons.
 - SP All Reset items can now be used directly from the skill tree window.
 - Players will be able to view exclusive skills available post-transformation for Ryan's active skills.
 - Dio, Zero, Ley, Rin, Asin, and Lime can switch between two skill boards using the X key.
 - Even after selecting either the Light or Dark tree, Rin can view the opposite skill tree.

2) Mailbox Function Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f52df784e99a70ce142652c9eee29a3409e0c906.png[/img]
 - Improved the mailbox UI to help players locate desired mail more easily.
 - Mails will be categorized into four types: [①Event/②System/③Admin/④ETC]
 - Added filters for sorting by received date or expiration time.
 - Players can view mails separately excluding those that include 'Warehouse Unavailable Item' or 'Limited Time Item'.
 - All mails can now be viewed using scroll with no page separation. Players can select up to 50 mails at once using the “Select All” option.
 - A 'Delete Received Mail' button will allow players to bulk-delete mails after claiming attached items.

3) Keybinding Function Expansion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b5677a6e17a03d4d8e6db813c8f0de79d09a686e.png[/img]
 - Improved the hotkey settings UI to allow easier viewing and customization.
 - Current hotkeys will be shown using a visual keyboard layout, updated in real time.
 - Hotkeys will be grouped into categories: [①Character Controls / ②Quick Slots / ③UI Controls / ④System].
 - A 'Default' button will restore default settings.
 - 'Save' and 'Revert' buttons will apply changes or undo them as needed.

4) Dungeon Sweep System Added
 - Added a new sweep system that allows players to instantly clear certain dungeons using dedicated tickets.
 - Eligible dungeons include: The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, and Wizard's Labyrinth.
 - Sweep rewards will be granted to the character used, and will differ from regular clear rewards.
 - Bonus EXP and GP factors will apply when claiming sweep rewards.
　Applicable factors include: Achieved Rank Bonus/EXP Gain/GP Gain/GC Club/Premium GC Club/Ring of Beefiness/Event Buffs/Guild Benefits

(1) Sweep Tickets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7ccbbc55abb92e72900896de04ebbedc863b78e6.png[/img]
 - Added the [Hero Dungeon Sweep Ticket].
 - [Hero Dungeon Sweep Ticket] can be used to sweep The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, or Wizard's Labyrinth.
 - [Hero Dungeon Sweep Ticket] can be acquired from events, premium pass rewards, and more.

(2) How to Use the Sweep Function
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1aaf805b9d23ca8a358cde86e744780a57ab642e.png[/img]
 - Added a [Dungeon Sweep] button to the dungeon Waiting Room list of supported dungeons.
 - Clicking the [Dungeon Sweep] button opens a dedicated sweep screen that allows players to use the new sweep system.
 - Players can only use the sweep feature for dungeons they have already cleared with the current character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/67ac47f3d18707ead27b69759565f10692766a78.png[/img]
 - Pressing [Start Sweep] in the dedicated screen will grant sweep rewards.
 - Each sweep consumes:
　① 1 Reward Acquisition Count of the Target Dungeon
　② 1 Weekly Sweep Count of the Target Dungeon
　③ The required number of Hero Dungeon Sweep Tickets for the target dungeon
 - Sweeping will not be possible if any of the required resources are insufficient.

5) Auto Item Acquisition System Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d186a917efa41a3086033137b428b0ae11c42b24.png[/img]
 - Added [Seal of Harvest], which can be applied to pets to enable auto-acquisition of nearby dropped items.
 - A permanent version, [Eternal Imprint of Harvest], will be available via two methods:
 - Purchase Method ①: Click [Imprint Slot] after equipping a pet in the [Inventory] to open a pop-up window
 - Purchase Method ②: [Shop] ▶ [Item Mall] ▶ [Pet] ▶ [All] or [Special] Category
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/e219e5ab155f0c8bb5fd3389b941b490defdbeb7.gif[/img]
 - When entering dungeons with a pet equipped with the [Imprint of Harvest], items dropped will be automatically collected after defeating monsters.
 - Limited-time [Imprint of Harvest] will be distributed via events or chaser passes for players to experience auto-acquisition.

6) GP Acquisition Structure Improvements
 - Changed the system so that dungeon GP gain, which were previously distributed among all party members, are now acquired individually by each player.
 - As a result, players will now receive the same amount of GP in party play as they would in solo play.
 - The GP gain remains unchanged.

7) Pet Sealed Card Lock Function Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7f7913c74a56eec9ab877ab3f79b54845f12cdc1.png[/img]
 - Added a new lock feature that prevents accidental sale of pet sealed cards.
 - Similar to the existing item lock system, players can click the padlock icon to lock a pet sealed card.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/3aed1c706928992dbfbc86fc544e221996068d66.png[/img]
 - Locked cards will not appear in Sell, Sell All, or Refinery menus until unlocked.
 - Locked pets will only be shown in Sell All mode if the [View Locked Items] option is enabled.

8) Inventory Sort & Filter Improvements
(1) Limited Time & Auto-Delete Item Sort Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/315d0c8ea1581e87a545653d03ba2018de078645.png[/img]
 - Improved so that limited-time and auto-delete items are sorted to the top of the inventory (including Coordi items).

(2) Other Item Filter Functions Added
 - Added a filter function to help players easily sort miscellaneous items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/cd7ad42874ce90061fcd91f07fefa650845c7807.png[/img]
 - Filters are divided into: [①Consumables / ②Scrolls / ③Entry Tickets / ④Materials / ⑤General].

2. Pet Balance
1) Jackie
 - Slightly increased the vertical attack range

2) Glen
 - Adjusted so that the first multi hit attack deals more damage than the last attack

3) Eris
 - Slightly increased the vertical attack range

3. Other Fixes
 - Improved the 2nd Job item display order for Ryan and Ley in Chase Coordi Collection
 - Fixed an error in the item name for Wind Chaser Coordi Gloves for Kallia and Uno
 - Fixed a typo in the skill tooltip for Lime's new 4th bar special 'Divine Punishment'
 - Fixed a bug where evolution transfer information was displayed in the tooltip for evolved pets in the inventory
 - Fixed so that Ai's White Cat Coordi item name is the same as the other characters
 - Fixed so that Jin's Another TYPE1 Fighter Coordi Helm headband is the same color as the icon
 - Fixed a bug where an error message displayed when opening the inventory under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where the Hero's Precious Pearl item was unintentionally acquirable in Infinite Cloister
 - Fixed a bug where the master volume could not be adjusted using the F7 hotkey immediately after starting the game
 - Fixed a bug where Uno's voice was missing for the Mysterious Wind skill
 - Improved so that item tooltips behind the filter list is not displayed if the filter list is open in Warehouse

notes.title: [Announcement] June 18th Developer Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8d285c6f92a1f8f5429636761e50b40f84b46fc4.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

We are planning a second wave of improvements to quality of life in the patches scheduled during the maintenance on June 18, 2025.
We will continue to carefully study the improvements that are not included in this upcoming patch but continuously requested from the community.
We ask for players' understanding that some improvements may come at a future date and are not included in the upcoming patch.
The example images below are still under development and may be subject to change.


■ Skill Tree Improvement
The Skill Tree UI Design and Quality of Life will be improved overall.
- Players will be able to check the job skill tree even if they have not completed the job change.
　For AP/HB characters, players will be able to check all the skills of all jobs within a single page.
- Players will also be able to check the skills through videos in the skill tooltip.
- An image will be provided so that players can easily see the MP Cost in the skill tooltip.
- A guide will be added so that players can see how to acquire exclusive skills (4th bar special, awakening special).
- skill positioning will be improved so that related skills can be seen at a glance.
- Skill border icon will be changed so that players can differentiate skill type and grade.
Character skill acquisition condition will be eased, allowing players to have more freedom in skill growth.

■ Mailbox Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1fb7836dc6a4e041a1f6417d5aa947c25e9e607b.png[/img]
Mailbox will be improved to allow players to find the mail they searched for.
- Players will be able to categorize mail.
- Players will have a filter function that allows them to sort mail by received date or by time remining until deletion.
- Players will also be able to check and open mail that does not contain 'Items that Cannot Be Stored in Warehouse' or 'Limited-Time Items'.
- Players will be able to open and check all mail with just scrolling and no page separation. Also, players will be able to select up to 50 mail at once through the "Select All" function in the Mail List.

■ Infinite Cloister Dungeon Improvements
The burden on running repeated runs through Infinite Cloister will be eased. Also, higher difficulty will be added and rewards will be expanded.
- Players will no longer have to re-clear Stage 1~3 after clearing it.
- Stage 4 Difficulty will be added, providing new rewards.

■ Improved GP Gain in Dungeons to be acquired as Personal Loot
GP will no longer be divided amongst party members. GP will now be acquired as personal loot.
Party play will no longer reduce the amount of GP gained.

■ Hotkey Expansion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/70ab647cd23fe305d462f7d59486560840c0482b.png[/img]
Hotkeys will be expanded, allowing more keys to be reassigned.
Players can look at all the hotkeys in a glance and reassign keys as they wish.

■ Inventory Sort Rule Improvement
- Items will be improved so that players can differentiate limited time items and items scheduled for deletion, sorting them towards the top of the inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/e56f4c5c470b0f9c6141755844735b0b93d590f1.png[/img]
- A filter system will be added so that items can be sorted better.

■ Pet Lock Function Added
A lock system will be added to pet items so that players do not mistakenly sell Sealed Pet Card.

■ Sweep System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ca54facde6a7a62818fddcca28db25a4da9af6e7.png[/img]
A Sweep System will be added so that players can use a Sweep Ticket to immediately clear and receive rewards for The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, and Wizard's Labyrinth.
The system will only be available when reward count has not been expended. Players will have a limited use count on the sweep ticket during a set period.
The item will be provided for limited cases through the Chaser Pass Reward.

■ Item Auto Acquisition System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9d50cd3a55f8bcb4027df7fe152dc666c9733702.png[/img]
A magnet feature will be added to pets, allowing pets to auto loot items that have been dropped.
- This item will be provided as a limited-time feature through events or acquired as a permanent item from the shop.

■ Other Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/40fb49cb88b2ec36405c23c966b542e2deaf89cb.png[/img]
A marker for 'Cannot Be Moved to Warehouse' will be added to Item Image.


We will strive to provide the best possible experience.

Thank you.

1. Quality of Life Improvements #1
1) Preset System Added
① Preset Function Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/90bfe15c907d89edb2a44da0d3cafa8a92a0ec5a.png[/img]
- Added a preset for Equipment/Coordi/Rune/Quickslot.
- Players can quickly switch to a pre-configured item set by clicking the Preset Page button.
- Preset data is saved per character.

② Preset Page Expansion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/81eba3d3f1f41f1fc9644db4da57a9c8918e2895.png[/img]
- By default, 2 pages of Equipment/Coordi/Rune/Quickslot presets are provided.
- Players can expand up to 5 pages using a Preset Voucher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c16cc08c2500bcd20a71fa92b5527a51545766b2.png[/img]
- The basic [Preset Voucher] can be purchased from the pop-up window that appears when clicking the [+] button, or via [Shop] ▶ [Item Mall] ▶ [Expansion] category.
- Preset page expansion data is saved per character.

③ Combined Preset Function Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/846a2060c1981f292bccfaa035d43220dfcc3107.png[/img]
- Added Combined Presets that allow players to change Equipment/Coordi/Rune/Quickslot/Chase Point preset pages all at once.
- Players can register [Pet Cards] and [Titles].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/941d17bf7278ec56b011f11679436d41aec1ebb6.png[/img]
- Players can click the [Apply] button to equip the items based on the information stored on the currently viewed preset page.

④ Combined Preset Page Expansion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f6a91089e0ff7f67bdd4db8a9a4a86141b9dd229.png[/img]
- By default, 1 page of combined preset is provided.
- Players can expand up to 5 pages using a Preset Voucher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/bee42548e768ea85e9b54de194d44ce086170183.png[/img]
- The [Combined Preset Voucher] can be purchased from the pop-up window that appears when clicking the [+] button, or via [Shop] ▶ [Item Mall] ▶ [Expansion] category.
- Combined Preset page expansion data is saved per character.

⑤ Handling Items Registered in Preset
- If an item registered in a preset is used as a material for Fusion/Transmutation/Sell/Dismantle/Move to Warehouse/Evolution/Incubation/Coordi Transformation/Coordi Fusion/Craft, it is automatically unregistered from the preset.

2) Play Fatigue Reduction
■ Hero Dungeon Improvements
① Changes to Reward Acquisition Count and Reset Cycle for 3 Hero Dungeons
- Changed the reward acquisition count from 1 time daily to 5 times weekly for the following dungeons: The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, Wizard's Labyrinth
- Adjusted dungeon rewards and repeat mission rewards to minimize the gap caused by this change.
- Changed the repeat mission conditions from 1 time daily to 5 times weekly for the following dungeons: The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, Wizard's Labyrinth

② Removal of Entry Time Restrictions for 2 Hero Dungeons
- Berkas' Lair and Tower of Disappearance is now accessible at all times with no time restrictions.

③ Changes to Reward Acquisition Method
- Changed the acquisition method of 'Atom Monster Card Box' that was available on a certain chance upon defeating [Berkas] in Berkas' Lair.
(Before) Dropped on certain chance upon defeating [Berkas] ▶ (After) Guaranteed reward upon dungeon clear while weekly reward count remains

④ Hero Dungeon Reward Improvements
- Added individual items as a reward instead of the crafting material for certain repeat missions.
- Removed the Hero Dungeon Box crafting materials (Refined Opal, Box Craft Tool Set, Core Essence) as a reward from repeat missions.
- Changed so that Hero Dungeon monsters do not drop 'Hero's Precious Pearls'.
- Removed selective rewards upon clearing the 30th floor of Wizard's Labyrinth.
- Added item blueprint for 'Phantom Phoenix's Earrings' to the Hero's Bullion Shop.

■ Another World Dungeon Improvements
① Changes to Kounat Great Explosion Reward Acquisition Count
- Changed reward acquisition count from 2 times daily to 1 time.
- Adjusted the amount of 'Dimension Cores' acquired upon clearing dungeons. Players can acquire up to 2 cores per day.

② Another World Dungeon Reward Improvements
- 'Dimension Guardians Earrings Fragment' and 'Dimension Guardians Piercing Fragment' can now be moved in the Warehouse.

③ Another World Earring of Chaos & Another World Piercing of Chaos Improvements
- [Scattered Chaos Fragment] is available upon clearing Kounat Great Explosion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/21518750fe16125c4a1dc67aeb93db39268857b5.png[/img]
- Improved so that players can use multiple select boxes at once.
- Players can adjust the quantity of items to receive per content.
- Players can simultaneously adjust quantities across multiple items.
- The number of select boxes to be used is displayed in real-time in the quantity field when adjusting item quantities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/567667153c7a95e7754158ce8598106a8b6a2ad8.png[/img]

4) Added Quality of Life Settings
(1) Added Damage Value Opacity Setting
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/af22c6e100d319502bdcc149f79d935d4e31474c.png[/img]
- Separated certain graphics settings to its own effect setting.
- The following settings will be relocated:
① Hit Effects
② Skill Effect Opacity Adjustment
- Added a damage value opacity category to the effect settings.
- Players can adjust the opacity of damage values separately for their character and other players.

(2) Audio Settings Refinement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7c3b030198dd016ca76b2713f1f393763ec93f4d.png[/img]
- Changed the mute function from a checkbox to a speaker icon.
- The current volume is displayed as numerical values from 0-100.
- Added a master volume function that allows players to adjust the game's overall volume.

② F8 : No Function

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/96f3c0446672565ec2e5e9698aa00d626c0901aa.png[/img]

- Players can check the current Waiting Room members, dungeon status, and chat while switching characters.
- Removed the 10 second restriction that was applied upon switching characters.

- If a GP Item Property Scroll is used on Dimension Guardians equipment that has removed properties already applied, the existing property will be removed and replaced with a new one from the new property and rate list.

- Changed the acquisition method of 'Atom Monster Card Box' that was available on a certain chance upon defeating [Berkas] in Berkas' Lair.
- Added individual items as a reward instead of the crafting material for certain repeat missions.
- Removed the Hero Dungeon Box crafting materials (Refined Opal, Box Craft Tool Set, Core Essence) as a reward from repeat missions.
- Changed so that Hero Dungeon monsters do not drop 'Hero's Precious Pearls'.
- Removed selective rewards upon clearing the 30th floor of Wizard's Labyrinth.
- Added item blueprint for 'Phantom Phoenix's Earrings' to the Hero's Bullion Shop.
- Changed reward acquisition count from 2 times daily to 1 time.
- 'Dimension Guardians Earrings Fragment' and 'Dimension Guardians Piercing Fragment' can now be moved in the Warehouse.
- [Scattered Chaos Fragment] is available upon clearing Kounat Great Explosion.
- [Scattered Chaos Fragment] can be used to craft [Another World Earring of Chaos] or [ Another World Piercing of Chaos].
- [Scattered Chaos Fragment] can be acquired after dismantling [Another World Earring of Chaos & Another World Piercing of Chaos].
- Changed the reward acquisition count from 3 times weekly to 2 times weekly for the following dungeons: Void (Invasion), Void (Taint), Void (Nightmare)
- Changed the repeat mission conditions from 3 times weekly to 2 times weekly for the following dungeons: Void (Invasion), Void (Taint), Void (Nightmare)
- Players can acquire 'Twisted Voidal Box (Invasion)', ' Twisted Voidal Box (Taint)', 'Twisted Voidal Box (Nightmare)' upon clearing the new repeat missions.
- Improved so that players can use multiple select boxes at once.
- Players can adjust the quantity of items to receive per content.
- Players can simultaneously adjust quantities across multiple items.
- The number of select boxes to be used is displayed in real-time in the quantity field when adjusting item quantities.
- All selected items are received at once. The results are displayed in a pop-up window.
- Separated certain graphics settings to its own effect setting.

- The following settings will be relocated:
① Hit Effects
② Skill Effect Opacity Adjustment
- Added a damage value opacity category to the effect settings.
- Players can adjust the opacity of damage values separately for their character and other players.
- Changed the mute function from a checkbox to a speaker icon.
- The current volume is displayed as numerical values from 0-100.
- Added a master volume function that allows players to adjust the game's overall volume.
- Added a function that allows players to adjust the character voice separately from the effect sounds.
- Removed the existing BGM/SFX hotkey. Replaced with a master volume hotkey.
- Added a function that allows the current room master to delegate the leadership to another player in the Waiting Room.
- The delegated player gains full room master authority, including the ability to change room settings, invite, kick, and start game.
- GC Club paint effects are refreshed when the room title is changed.
- Improved so that players can switch characters without leaving the Waiting Room.
- Players can check the current Waiting Room members, dungeon status, and chat while switching characters.
- Removed the 10 second restriction that was applied upon switching characters.
- Removed the following properties from Dimension Guardians equipment: 'Defense', 'Vitality', 'HP Recovery', 'GP Gain', 'Special Defense'

- Dimension Guardians equipment that has the removed properties already applied will retain the stats and continue to benefit from the stats. However, the removed properties will no longer appear in the selectable property list when using the Single Property Scroll (Lv.85).

- If a GP Item Property Scroll is used on Dimension Guardians equipment that has removed properties already applied, the existing property will be removed and replaced with a new one from the new property and rate list.

- Players can check out the new property and rate list in the rate information page after maintenance on May 28th. [url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][b][Rate Information Page] (Link)[/b][/url]
- Improved so that players can use the 4th Bar Special Skill and Awakening Special Skill while transforming. Transformation is canceled upon using the skills.
- Improved so that players can use Quicksave while transforming.
- Changed the special skill to a command attack. (X↑)
- Changed so that MP is not consumed upon use.
- Added a cooldown. (Dungeon: 15 seconds / PVP: 15 seconds)
- Changed controls to XX. (Before: X)
- Improved so that the buff can be canceled by inputting the same control (C↓) one more time while the buff effect is active.
- Applied Portuguese voice for Awakening Kallia, Asin, Zero, Decanee, Ley, Dio, and Ronan
- Fixed a display error in the required skill points for '[Special] Rolling Attack' and '[Special] Berserker' for Ryan Druid (1st Job)
- Improved so that the midair motion plays if X is used to combine or separate weapons midair when playing as Ryan Vanquisher (4th Job)
- Fixed a bug where the character motion did not work as intended if X was used to combine or separate weapons when playing as Ryan Vanquisher (4th Job)
- Improved so that the motion for each job plays when Jin uses Iron Fist or End of Days
- Improved so that Dio can use Critical and Double Attack in the opposite direction when 'Sharp Move' is not activated during a weapon combo.
- Changed so that Zero's weapon is not visible when using '[Special] Zero Domain'
- Improved so that the weapon disappears with Zero when '[Special] Gran X' is used
- Fixed a bug where the voice did not play when Rufus used '[Special] Bloody Gust TYPE2'
- Changed the Korean and English voice for Decanee's '[Special] Fabrication of Fate' and '[Special] Denouement'

- Improved so that the gate to progress in the dungeon cannot be destroyed using skills (Target Dungeons: Infinite Cloister, Sanctum of Destruction, Void Raid, Kounat Great Explosion, Tower of Disappearance)
- Improved so that players can progress through the dungeon without destroying the gate that appears after defeating Dullahan and Urkah in Siege of Teroka
- Fixed a bug where the hand and feet size for characters had an unintended size for certain Coordis
- Fixed a bug where Rin could not use charging skills (Z key) when transformed in PVP
- Fixed a bug where the icon image did not display for Ronan's Noble Armor Set
- Fixed a bug where certain voices of stage 2 monster 'Ai' did not play in Infinite Cloister
- Fixed so that the Hyper Armor effect ends when Lime cancels after using the defense skill
- Fixed an error in the skill tooltip description for Lime's Dash Attack TYPE2
- Fixed a bug where certain equipped Coordis displayed bigger than intended under certain circumstance
- Fixed a bug where the resurrection window unintentionally displayed that bonus was available when the character died in difficulty 101 or higher for Abyssal Path
- Fixed so that the strings for Jin's Fighter and Asura Coordi Helm has movement
- Fixed a bug where 2 cores were unintentionally destroyed when Graham's Illusion was defeated in Kounat's Collapse under certain circumstances
- Improved the hitbox when Jin Shisa (2nd Job)'s 4th bar special skill Total Smash was used in Training Mode
- Removed the information for items that have not been dropped yet in the Tower of Disappearance Dungeon Reward window
- Improved certain appearances for Ai's Awakening Coordi Lower Armor
- Fixed a bug where the 'Abyssal Path' dungeon reset time displayed an unintended time in the Special Dungeon Entry Information window
- Fixed the tooltip of certain skills for Asin
- Fixed the error in tooltip of skills for Asin for certain languages
- Fixed the tooltip of certain skills for Rin to be the same as the actual skill
- Fixed a bug where certain skill effects for Rin were not affected by 'Other Player Skill Effect Opacity' option

notes.title: [Announcement] May 21st Developer Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8d285c6f92a1f8f5429636761e50b40f84b46fc4.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

The long-running Awakening update has finally come to an end.
Thanks to many heroes, we've received a lot of support and feedback that allowed us to finalize the update.
We hope the Awakening update was an opportunity to empower various characters and enjoy a new purpose in game.

The GrandChase Team is preparing content updates in the second half of the year to bring you new and exciting experiences.
We will reveal more about the content update as we continue development. Please look forward to the new updates.
Before we go forward with the content updates in the later half of the year, we plan to go forward with  improvements in player experience and quality of life.
The dev team has taken into account various suggestions and requests since the last survey. We will go through 2 separate patches to cover various improvements.
The 1st quality of life changes will take place on May 28, 2025.

■ 3 Hero Dungeon Reset Period and Count Changes
- The play count limit for The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, and Wizard's Labyrinth will be changed from 1 daily count to 5 weekly counts.
- With the play count changes, dungeon rewards and repeat mission rewards will be adjusted accordingly.
- The repeat mission condition for The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, and Wizard's Labyrinth will be changed from clear 1 time daily to clear 5 times weekly.

■ Tower of Disappearance, Berkas' Lair Dungeon Entry Time and Reward Improvement
- Entry Time for Tower of Disappearance and Berkas' Lair will be removed.
- Upon defeating [Berkas] in Berkas' Lair, players will be able to acquire 'Alcubra Monster Card Box' on a 100% chance if they still have an entry count.
- Upon defeating [Berkas] in Berkas' Lair, players will be able to acquire 'Mystery Potion' on a 100% chance only if they still have an entry count.

■ Hero Dungeon Reward Improvement
- Some Repeat Mission Rewards will give the completed item instead of the Hero Dungeon Box Craft Materials.
- Hero Dungeon Box Craft Material (Refined Opal, Box Craft Tool Set, Core Essence) will be removed from the Repeat Mission Rewards.
- The Clear Select Reward for Wizard's Labyrinth 30th floor will be removed.
- Item blueprint will be available for 'Phantom Phoenix's Earring' in Hero's Bullion Shop.
- Hero Dungeon monsters will no longer drop 'Hero's Precious Pearl'.

■ Another World Dungeon Improvement
- Daily Reward Count for The Great Explosion of Kounat will be reduced from 2 times to 1 time.
- 'Dimension Core' count upon clear will be adjusted to have the same daily acquisition count.
- 'Dimension Guardians Earring Fragment' and 'Dimension Guardians Piercing Fragment' can be moved to the Warehouse.
- Upon clearing The Great Explosion of Kounat, players can acquire new material items.
  New material items can be combined with 'Dimension Core', and 'Dimension Guardians Earring & Piercing (Legendary)' to craft 'Another World's Chaos Earring & Piercing'.
- Dismantling 'Another World's Chaos Earring & Piercing' will also provide new material items.

■ Raid Dungeon Improvement
- Dungeon Reward Count for Void (Invasion), Void (Taint), and Void (Nightmare) will be reduced to 2 per week. 
- With the reward count changes, a new repeat mission will be added for each character.
- Raid Repeat Mission condition will be changed from 3 times to 2 times.
- Upon clearing the New Repeat Missions, players will acquire 'Twisted Voidal Box (Invasion)', 'Twisted Voidal Box (Taint)', and 'Twisted Voidal Box (Nightmare)'.
- Twisted Voidal Box contains Monster Card and Scrolls of the respective dungeons. 

■ Preset System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/90bfe15c907d89edb2a44da0d3cafa8a92a0ec5a.png[/img]
- Preset for Equipment, Coordi, Rune, and Quickslot will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/846a2060c1981f292bccfaa035d43220dfcc3107.png[/img]
- An integrated preset system will be added where players will be able to swap Equipment, Coordi, Rune, Quickslot, Chase Point, Title, Pet Card Presets.

■ Select Box System Improvement
- Select Box will be changed so that multiple boxes can be used at once instead of 1 at a time. This way, players can select multiple items at the same time and receive them.

■ Quality of Life Options
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7c3b030198dd016ca76b2713f1f393763ec93f4d.png[/img]
- Volume Adjustment for Character Voice will be separated from Sound Effects.
- An option to control all sound volumes will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/af22c6e100d319502bdcc149f79d935d4e31474c.png[/img]
- An option to control the transparency of the player's and party members' damage fonts.

■ Room Master Promotion Function
- A function where the room master can promote a party member to be room master will be added.

■ Room Character Swap Improvement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/96f3c0446672565ec2e5e9698aa00d626c0901aa.png[/img]
- Players will be able to swap characters while in a room and with no time limit.


Lastly, we would like to provide information regarding [b]additional compensation[/b] related to the probability issue with the 'Seal Breaker Scroll'.

Following the previous round of compensation, we received feedback from players requesting that compensation be based on actual usage rather than just purchases.
After reviewing these requests, we have prepared an additional compensation plan that takes both purchase and usage into account, as outlined below.

Below is a breakdown of compensation eligibility and how it is calculated:

[b]<Eligibility Criteria>[/b]
 - Players who purchased the 'Seal Breaker Scroll' using either free VP or paid VP until February 27, 2023.
   Players who have a record of using the scrolls during the period from August 3, 2022 - February 27, 2023.

[b]<Compensation Calculation>[/b]
- For eligible players, 10% of the number of scrolls used during the affected period will be calculated as the 'usage-based compensation amount'.
- The minimum compensation amount is 10 scrolls. If fewer than 10 scrolls were used, the compensation will match the actual number of scrolls used.
- Based on this, we will compare the[b] previously granted 'purchase-based compensation amount' [/b]with the [b]newly calculated 'usage-based compensation amount'.[/b] If the usage-based amount is higher, the difference will be provided as additional compensation.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement - Awakening/Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
May 7th (Wed) 02:00 - 06:00 (UTC+0)

[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/37667a008445807aa896236295e60752ef6a05fb.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Rin, Lime, and Uno will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9a9ffda36ccb0ae2a37ea27369cad8e74323dd13.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/24fce711c1ddbe277b133cd2b3d36337707d62bd.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7eeb803d59acbc915f74c42866604fcf6fe33c49.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Rin, Lime, and Uno will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a3880b976afe582f3753726a25eedb08b366ae0a.png[/img]
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Rin, Lime, and Uno will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Character Command Controls Improvements
 - All learned skills for Rin, Lime, and Uno will be reset due to various skill information changes.
 - Please re-learn the skills after the maintenance.

1) Rin
 - Fixed and removed duplicate or incorrect command guides.

■ Light
▶ Phoenix (1st Job)
[Combo Attack][Combo Special Attack][Dash Attack][Dash Special Attack][Jump Attack][Jump Special Attack]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.
 - Improved the hitbox to make combos easier and longer to chain.
[Combo Attack]
 - Added a hitbox when attacked within a certain area in PVP.
[Jump Attack]
 - Increased the attack range.
[Combo Special Attack][Dash Special Attack][Jump Special Attack]
 - Increased the damage.
[Dash Attack][Dash Special Attack][Jump Special Attack]
 - Reduced the delay in cancel window for the motion so that next motion can happen faster.
[Talisman]
 - Increased the basic recovery speed upon battle for Talisman.

▶ Awakened (2nd Job)
[Basic Combo Range Increase]
 - Increased attack range and speed.
 - Added a hitbox when attacked within a certain area in PVP.
[2 Step Jump]

[Charging Strike]

1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Rin, Lime, and Uno will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9a9ffda36ccb0ae2a37ea27369cad8e74323dd13.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/24fce711c1ddbe277b133cd2b3d36337707d62bd.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Rin, Lime, and Uno will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]

 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement - Awakening/Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
April 16th (Wed) 04:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/358e925a7eca626648a962b11af432fee5e5acbe.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Zero, Asin, and Kallia will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ac5d00316928eb4ea235eafefc0d3a54616c3459.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7b01293f5791d8e9d5e6d379c1786840fbf2f8bc.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7eeb803d59acbc915f74c42866604fcf6fe33c49.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Zero, Asin, and Kallia will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/41b3b7e1256d008912fc15cd38264a959cd1a23d.png[/img]
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Zero, Asin, and Kallia will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Added Asin's Classic VO Settings
 - Added the option to select Asin's Korean Character Voice in the Settings > Audio > Language menu as the [Classic Voice] before the Awakening update.


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Character Command Controls Improvements
 - All learned skills will be reset due to various skill information changes for Zero and Asin.
 - Please re-learn the skills that have been reset after maintenance for Zero and Asin.

1) Zero
 - Fixed and removed duplicate or incorrect command guides.
[Special Skill]
 - Improved to use immediately by removing the Grandark motion. Removed the [Sword Stance Enhancement] effect upon use as a result.
 - Improved to return to stance after using the special skill.
[Switch Stance]
 - Improved to be able to switch to any stance when using the Switch Stance command during command movement or attack.

■ Normal State
▶ Wanderer (1st Job)
[Combo Attack][Critical][Double Attack][Dash Attack][Jump Attack]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.
 - Improved the hitbox to make combos easier and longer to chain.
[Combo Attack][Dash Attack]
 - Increased attack range and speed.
[Critical][Double Attack][Dash Attack]
 - Reduced the delay in cancel window for the motion so that next motion can happen faster.
[Critical]
 - Improved to be able to use Critical on the first attack.
[Double Attack]
 - Improved to reduce Zero’s skill cooldown upon activation.
[Jump Attack]
 - Improved to jump after a certain amount of time following a jump attack, allowing players to continue to the next action.
[Sword Stance Activate]
 - Changed command controls to Hold C+↑. (Before: XX)
[Defensive Stance Activate]
 - Changed command controls to Hold C+↓. (Before: X+↓)

▶ Seeker (2nd Job)
[Offensive Stance Activate]

▶ Advancer (4th Job)
[Additional Combo Attack][Additional Dash Attack]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.

 - Adjusted damage and hitbox.

 - Adjusted the Grandark's Domination gauge gain.

▶ Wanderer (1st Job): [Loss][Rude Pressure]

 - Removed the motion to draw the sword in Normal State.

■ Sword Stance (SS)
▶ Wanderer (1st Job)
[Combo Attack][Sword Stance: Spin Slice][Sword Stance: Thrust][Sword Stance: Jump Slice]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.

[Critical][Double Attack][Sword Stance: Spin Slice][Jump Slice][Dash][Dash Attack]

[Combo Attack]
 - Improved all combo attacks to be able to chain into [Sword Stance: Spin Slice], [Sword Stance: Thrust], and [Sword Stance: Jump Slice].
[Critical]

 - Added Double Attack.

[Sword Stance: Thrust]
 - Improved to chain to Critical or Double Attack based on the combo attack stage that initiated Thrust when using Dash after learning the skill.
[Jump Slice]
 - Improved to be able to use Combo Attack faster when using Z during attack.
[Walk]
 - Improved to be able to activate all stances while walking.
[Dash]
 - Added so that dash can be used with →→ input.
 - Players can use Jump during Dash.

1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Zero, Asin, and Kallia will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.

2) Core System
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Zero, Asin, and Kallia will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%

- Awakening Chase Coordi for Zero, Asin, and Kallia will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Added Asin's Classic VO Settings
 - Added the option to select Asin's Korean Character Voice in the Settings > Audio > Language menu as the [Classic Voice] before the Awakening update.
