notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement - Awakening/Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
March 5th (Wed) 04:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)

[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f7624c603e9216f8ba52c86c7385861ce8758f5b.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ac5d00316928eb4ea235eafefc0d3a54616c3459.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7b01293f5791d8e9d5e6d379c1786840fbf2f8bc.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7eeb803d59acbc915f74c42866604fcf6fe33c49.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/41b3b7e1256d008912fc15cd38264a959cd1a23d.png[/img]
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.

1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.

2) Core System
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%

- Awakening Chase Coordi for Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Added Portuguese Voices
 - Portuguese voices for Amy, Sieghart, Veigas, Ronan, Dio, Ley, and Decanee will be added.
 - The voices for other characters will be applied in additional updates, which will be announced at a later date.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement - Awakening/Event
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
March 5th (Wed) 02:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)

[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/15c1fccd9253d44473206317e1c96127272ddad5.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Ryan, Jin, Rufus, and Ai will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ac5d00316928eb4ea235eafefc0d3a54616c3459.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7b01293f5791d8e9d5e6d379c1786840fbf2f8bc.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7eeb803d59acbc915f74c42866604fcf6fe33c49.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Ryan, Jin, Rufus, and Ai will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/41b3b7e1256d008912fc15cd38264a959cd1a23d.png[/img]
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Ryan, Jin, Rufus, and Ai will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

6) How to Use Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/711e65ec7a72359e812e4eae17a66632f2d94b0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/30ea10e328a08ed4d4ef9c60d7db8a264db0fa5a.png[/img]
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' can be exchanged for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' in the Item Refinery - Craft - Event tab.
 - Please note that once crafted, these items cannot be reversed.

1 New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Ryan, Jin, Rufus, and Ai will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Ryan, Jin, Rufus, and Ai will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%

- Awakening Chase Coordi for Ryan, Jin, Rufus, and Ai will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

We will strive to create the best experience possible.

notes.title: [Announcement] February Community Events
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

We're excited to share our community events for February. This month, we’re hosting a GM livestream, and Discord Quests are making a return. Please see below for more details.

[h3]1. GM Livestream: Awakening[/h3]

Join us next week for our upcoming GM Livestream. The GMs will be taking a look at the latest Awakening update and playing through the Abyssal Path dungeon with viewers!

[b]Livestream Date:[/b]

●	2/20/2025 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC +0) / 2/19/2025 (Wed) 16:00 (PST)

[b]Livestream Links:[/b]

●	Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/gcclassic 
●	YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GrandChaseClassic 

[b]Giveaways: [/b]

The livestream will have five giveaways of 20x Seal Breaker Scrolls

[h3]2. Discord Quests[/h3]

Discord Quests have returned alongside the latest wave of Awakening updates! Players can partake in completing up to seven different quests in Discord. All quests will involve the most recent Awakening update, so players are encouraged to work on their Sieghart, Veigas, and Amy.

[b]Event Period: [/b]

2/13/2025 (Thu) 00:00 ~ 3/6/2025 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC +0) / 2/12/2025 (Wed) 16:00 ~ 3/5/2025 (Wed) 16:00 (PST)

[b]How to Participate: [/b]

Head to the official Discord (Discord.gg/GrandChaseClassic) and navigate to the Discord-Quests channel. Each quest will have its own set of instructions on how to participate. Complete each quest to earn a raffle entry. Each quest is available for a limited time, so don’t miss out! 

[b]Prizes: [/b]

At the end of the event, all entries will be added into a raffle to be drawn for the following prizes.

●	1 winner of 20k VP
●	5 winners of 10k VP
●	25 winners of 5k VP

We look forward to seeing your participation in these events. For further information, head to Discord.gg/GrandChaseClassic.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement - Awakening/Improvements
notes.content:
Due to an extension in the maintenance, we will be compensating everyone who logs in during After Maintenance - February 13, 2025 (Thu) 05:59 (UTC+0) with Compensation Chest 1.


Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
February 12th (Wed) 04:00 - 08:30 (UTC+0)


[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9d805fc4112f5c539e523a5bab97f0d5bba559b6.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Amy, Sieghart, and Veigas will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/67f781b1e41824582ab15c480e06e55c40215411.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0dcfb800735fba17d5f5337019584fae32dca019.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7eeb803d59acbc915f74c42866604fcf6fe33c49.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Amy, Sieghart, and Veigas will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0f050236a0daf180588ceab273626e2fa2742755.png[/img]
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Amy, Sieghart, and Veigas will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Added Portuguese Voices
 - Portuguese voices for Elesis, Lire, Arme, Lass, Mari, and Edel will be added.
 - The voices for other characters will be applied in additional updates, which will be announced at a later date.

6) How to Use Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0066e54c44809a86c6d65e3c44e14b6017ca56a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/30ea10e328a08ed4d4ef9c60d7db8a264db0fa5a.png[/img]
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' can be exchanged for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' in the Item Refinery - Craft - Event tab.
 - Please note that once crafted, these items cannot be reversed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/84f09ec2f7a4a1e3ac2f807846400947f4d689b4.png[/img]
 - A 'Change Ticket' will be mailed to those who participated in the Awakening Pre-Registration PART 1 for each additional Awakening update following January 22nd.
 - The 'Change Ticket' can be used with the 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' to exchange for the 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' of characters that will be updated.
[b] - [Change Ticket III] Reward Period: February 12, 2025 (Wed) After Maintenance - March 5, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0)[/b]
 - Players who log in during the Change Ticket Reward Period will receive a 'Change Ticket' via mail. The reward is only valid for 21 days, so please ensure to receive the [Change Ticket] before it is deleted.
 - Players can use 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' and 'Change Ticket III' together to exchange for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box III' for Amy, Sieghart, or Veigas that is set to release on February 12th.
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1' and 'Change Ticket III' will be deleted during maintenance on March 26, 2025 (Wed). Please note the removal date and use the items before the maintenance begins.

tags.feature:
- 'Awakening' for Amy, Sieghart, and Veigas will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.

- The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.

- Awakening Chase Coordi for Amy, Sieghart, and Veigas will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

- The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%

- Awakening Chase Coordi for Amy, Sieghart, and Veigas will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Added Portuguese Voices
 - Portuguese voices for Elesis, Lire, Arme, Lass, Mari, and Edel will be added.
 - The voices for other characters will be applied in additional updates, which will be announced at a later date.

- 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' can be exchanged for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' in the Item Refinery - Craft - Event tab.
 - Please note that once crafted, these items cannot be reversed.

- A 'Change Ticket' will be mailed to those who participated in the Awakening Pre-Registration PART 1 for each additional Awakening update following January 22nd.
 - The 'Change Ticket' can be used with the 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' to exchange for the 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' of characters that will be updated.

- Players can use 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' and 'Change Ticket III' together to exchange for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box III' for Amy, Sieghart, or Veigas that is set to release on February 12th.

notes.title: [Announcement] Bug Fixes/Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
Bug fixes and improvements have been updated.


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
- Removed Edel ‘Despair TYPE3’ special stun effect applied to players
- Fixed a bug where Lass Thief’s ‘Shadows of the Past LV1’ and ‘Shadows of the Past LV2’ did not work as intended when used under certain circumstances
- Fixed a bug where Mari Polaris’ ‘Call of Ruin’ did not work as intended when used under certain circumstances
- Fixed a bug where Ronan Aegis Knight’s ‘Tempest Slash’ did not work as intended when used under certain circumstances
- Fixed a bug where the 2nd and 3rd additional attacks after Lass Assassin’s Dash Attack did not activate as intended
- Improved additional attacks for Lass Assassin’s Dash Attack to move at a faster speed
- Changed the commands for Lass Assassin’s Dash Attack to Dash ZZ
- Adjusted the hit damage for Lass Assassin’s Dash Attack
- Fixed a bug where Lass Assassin’s Grab Attack did not work while dashing
- Fixed a bug where party members were able to see messages from players who were chat restricted in dungeons and PVP
- Fixed a bug where the Back Attack damage did not apply as intended when Pet skills were used
- Fixed a bug where players could not use Awakening skills in PVP


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement - Awakening/Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
January 22nd (Wed) 04:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)

[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/263ea6d87cfef0f143ea1f3105d2402debb43f3f.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Lass, Mari, and Edel will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/67f781b1e41824582ab15c480e06e55c40215411.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0dcfb800735fba17d5f5337019584fae32dca019.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7eeb803d59acbc915f74c42866604fcf6fe33c49.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Lass, Mari, and Edel will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0f050236a0daf180588ceab273626e2fa2742755.png[/img]
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Lass, Mari, and Edel will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Applied Portuguese Voices
 - Portuguese voices will be available in an additional update.
 - The update date will be announced separately at a later date.

6) How to Use Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/13d3f17ba8fa30aa48e6d834aeae4d42cb378bf4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/30ea10e328a08ed4d4ef9c60d7db8a264db0fa5a.png[/img]
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' can be exchanged for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' in the Item Refinery - Craft - Event tab.
 - Please note that once crafted, these items cannot be reversed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c5418c8bc475540411d069504d40510a048cc428.png[/img]
 - A 'Change Ticket' will be mailed to those who participated in the Awakening Pre-Registration PART 1 for each additional Awakening update following January 22nd.
 - The 'Change Ticket' can be used with the 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' to exchange for the 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' of characters that will be updated.
 - [Change Ticket II] Reward Period: January 22, 2025 (Wed) After Maintenance - February 12, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0)
 - Players who log in during the Change Ticket Reward Period will receive a 'Change Ticket' via mail. The reward is only valid for 21 days, so please ensure to receive the [Change Ticket] before it is deleted.
 - Players can use 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' and 'Change Ticket II' together to exchange for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' for Lass, Mari, or Edel.
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1' and 'Change Ticket II' will be deleted during maintenance on March 26, 2025 (Wed). Please note the removal date and use the items before the maintenance begins.

7) Other Improvements
(1) Improved so that 4th Bar Skill is differentiated from Awakenign Skill.
(2) Improved so that players can tell Awakening Support Core Grade apart better in the Skill Tree.
(3) Improved so that information is more visible in the Awakening Support Core Stat Reroll Window in Skill Tree.
(4) Improved Skill Cooldown Number Size and Position.
(5) Added an option to allow players to use previous [Classic Voice] before the awakening for Lire and Arme.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/af59d2c5bd008738d15f48ac3e18e73ae384a11d.png[/img]
- Can be selected in Options > Audio > Select Character Voice.


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Character Command Controls Improvements
1) Lass
[Shadow Vanish][Dash][Super Jump]
 - Changed the input from X + Direction Keys to C + Direction Keys.
[Double Jump]
 - Improved so that the delay in landing motion is reduced so that the next action can be done faster.

■ Thief (1st Job)
[Combo Attack Lv1][Combo Attack Lv2][Critical Lv1][Critical Lv2][Double Attack][Dash Attack Lv1][Dash Attack Lv2][Dash Attack Repeat][Rising Attack]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.
 - Improved the hitbox to make combos easier and longer to chain.
 - Reduced the duration of motion after certain command attacks.
[Run]
 - Dash can now cancel Running.
[Double Jump Down Attack]
 - Improved to ease the command input segment to make it easier and faster to trigger than before.
 - Reduced the fall speed during commands and improved so that commands are not canceled upon landing on platforms.
 - Can now be activated also with single jump.
 - Increased the attack speed.
 - Added a command input so that players can activated with XX while jumping.
[Wild Throw]
 - Improved to ease the command input segment to make it easier and faster to trigger than before.
 - Increased the attack speed.
 - Changed the input from ZZZZZ to XXX.
[Rapid Slash]
 - Changed the input from ZZZZZ to XXX.
[Dash Attack]
 - Changed so that Additional Attacks can be activated by pressing Z key without successfully landing the first attack.
 - Changed so that Dash can be used to cancel the additional attack.
 - Removed the Critical and Double Attack after Dash Attack.
[Dash Attack Lv2]
 - Reduced the duration of motion after attack so the next action can be done faster.
 - Reduced the delay in cancel window for the motion so that next motion can happen faster.
[Dash Attack Lv3]
 - Reduced the duration of motion after attack so the next action can be done faster.
 - Reduced the delay in cancel window for the motion so that next motion can happen faster.
 - Changed the input from Up + Z to ZZ after Dash Attack.
[Jump Attack]
 - Improved to jump after a certain amount of time following a jump attack, allowing players to continue to the next action.
[Critical]
 - Improved combo attacks to trigger from the first hit.
 - Reduced the delay in cancel window for the motion so that next motion can happen faster.
[Double Attack]
 - Reduced the delay in cancel window for the motion so that next motion can happen faster.
[Up Attack Repeat While Combo Attack]
 - Improved to ease the command input segment to make it easier and faster to trigger than before.
[Fatal Fury]
 - Fixed a bug where sometimes the attack could not hit the enemy on a low chance.

■ Assassin (2nd Job)
[Combo Attack][Critical][Jump Attack][Dash Attack Additional Attack][Rising Attack]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.
 - Improved the hitbox to make combos easier and longer to chain.
[Jump Attack]
 - Improved to jump after a certain amount of time following a jump attack, allowing players to continue to the next action.
[Critical]
 - Added a hitbox when going behind the enemy. (Dungeon: Stun / PVP: Knockdown, Throw)
 - Improved so that pressing the Z Key while going behind the enemy makes an instant attack. The Dash Attack from the Z key input is removed.
 - Improved combo attacks to trigger from the first hit.

■ Dark Assassin (3rd Job)
[Combo Attack][Critical][Double Attack][Jump Attack]
 - Fixed a bug where attack speed was reduced from the character being stunned when using certain command attacks.
 - Fixed a bug where there was a low chance of only hitting certain enemies when attacking multiple enemies.
 - Improved the hitbox to make combos easier and longer to chain.
[Critical]
 - Added a Critical Attack that attacks the front by pressing Dash Command while Combo Attack.
 - Improved combo attacks to trigger from the first hit.

tags.feature:
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' for Lass, Mari, and Edel will be updated.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.

- Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Lass, Mari, and Edel will be added to the crafting list.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%

- Awakening Chase Coordi for Lass, Mari, and Edel will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
Please see below for more details on the changes.

(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
 - Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.

(2) Applied Portuguese Voices
 - Portuguese voices will be available in an additional update.
 - The update date will be announced separately at a later date.

6) How to Use Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' can be exchanged for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' in the Item Refinery - Craft - Event tab.
 - Please note that once crafted, these items cannot be reversed.

- A 'Change Ticket' will be mailed to those who participated in the Awakening Pre-Registration PART 1 for each additional Awakening update following January 22nd.
 - The 'Change Ticket' can be used with the 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' to exchange for the 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' of characters that will be updated.
 - [Change Ticket II] Reward Period: January 22, 2025 (Wed) After Maintenance - February 12, 2025 (Wed) Before Maintenance (UTC+0)
 - Players who log in during the Change Ticket Reward Period will receive a 'Change Ticket' via mail. The reward is only valid for 21 days, so please ensure to receive the [Change Ticket] before it is deleted.
 - Players can use 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket' and 'Change Ticket II' together to exchange for 'Special Awakening Coordi Select Box' for Lass, Mari, or Edel.
 - 'Special Awakening Coordi Exchange Ticket 1' and 'Change Ticket II' will be deleted during maintenance on March 26, 2025 (Wed). Please note the removal date and use the items before the maintenance begins.

7) Other Improvements
(1) Improved so that 4th Bar Skill is differentiated from Awakenign Skill.
(2) Improved so that players can tell Awakening Support Core Grade apart better in the Skill Tree.
(3) Improved so that information is more visible in the Awakening Support Core Stat Reroll Window in Skill Tree.
(4) Improved Skill Cooldown Number Size and Position.
(5) Added an option to allow players to use previous [Classic Voice] before the awakening for Lire and Arme.
- Can be selected in Options > Audio > Select Character Voice.

notes.content:
Due to an extension in the maintenance, we will be compensating everyone who logs in during After Maintenance - January 9th 05:59 (UTC+0) with Compensation Chest 1.


Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
January 8th 03:00 - 10:00 (UTC+0)

[b]<Character>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f12adcdd40ea6e2a987e6a3be95ad3f164a2a68d.png[/img]
1. New Character System 'Awakening' Update
 - 'Awakening' will be updated for Elesis, Lire, and Arme.
 - Completing Awakening Missions will awaken the character. Players can unlock 2 new skills and a Core System.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/dc0a36ed96ef4d079adfd1b565f9be7dd0d4ab04.png[/img]
 - 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item [u]can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests[/u]. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.

1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
 - Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.

(2) Awakening Special Skill
 - After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
 - The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
 - Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/67f781b1e41824582ab15c480e06e55c40215411.png[/img]
 - Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
 - Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.

2) Core System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0dcfb800735fba17d5f5337019584fae32dca019.png[/img]
 - The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
 - The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
 - The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
 - Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
 - Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9ee579f81ba31f46a8182701749ad6f0257e4ecf.png[/img]
 - Further details on the rate information can be viewed in the Announcement page below after the maintenance on January 8th.
 - [b][url=https://www.koggames.com/game/grandchaseclassic/ItemRateTable][Rate Information Website] (Link)[/url][/b]

3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
 - Awakening Chase Coordi for Elesis, Lire, and Arme will be added to the Craft Tab.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
 - Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.

4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edb4bf75d9ea7fc0acd9b1a7915c94f14c6c46c6.png[/img]
 - The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
 - This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
 - 1 Character (Vitality +1000) / 3 Characters: Critical Strike Damage +10% / 5 Characters: Critical Strike Chance +3% / 10 Characters: EXP +5%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0f050236a0daf180588ceab273626e2fa2742755.png[/img]
 - Elesis, Lire, and Arme Awakening Chase Coordi Collection will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
 - Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.

5) Character Information - Awakening Information Added

[b]<Contents>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/89a61acf7144a29103e295b84b0a543a72e89f96.png[/img]
1. New Special Dungeon - Character Awakening Dungeon 'Abyssal Path' Update

To keep the world in balance, the Creator created the Tower of Disappearance to symbolize the cycle of creation and destruction.
It was a tool that allowed the Demons to destroy and the Celestials to create.
However, mesmerized by the Tower's power, the Void planned to harness it over time.

After a long time,
a small rift formed in the Tower of Disappearance after a fierce battle between the GrandChase and Kaze'aze.
The Void, which had been waiting for the moment, took advantage of the breach to infiltrate the tower. The order of the tower began to crumble in an instant.
With the intervention of a strange power other than that of creation and destruction, the tower quickly collapsed.
In the aftermath, all life on Aernas was dragged into the unknown space of the Abyssal Path.

This twisted world, warped by the Void
reflected the inner lives of all creatures, materializing their fears and wounds.

In this place, where even the concept of time and space was lost, the GrandChase was condemned to endless wandering.
Yet they could never give up.
Only by escaping this place could they save the crumbling Aernas and rekindle the flames of hope.

“There is only one way out of this place. To surpass ourselves.”
Can the GrandChase overcome their respective trials, escape the Abyssal boundary, and save Aernas again?
Time passes, while hope and despair walk on a fine line.
Everything is in their hands now.

1) Entry Requirements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a1215b726116cf63c7aae06df045ae9c68bffdca.png[/img]
 - Entry is available with Level 85 characters.
 - There will no daily play limit.
※ However, if players reach the maximum inventory holdings of 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation', players cannot play the dungeon.

2) Abyssal Path Dungeon Features
 - The Abyssal Path randomizes the monsters and maps that appear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/704fcd975548779f669c8ea8f4941a37aa9dc0ee.png[/img]
 - Abyssal monsters have been given traits by the Void. They are randomly assigned a trait at the start of each stage, and each trait has different effects on attack and defense.
 - From a certain stage onward, 'Calamities' occur on the Abyssal Path. Periodically, a wide AOE attack is cast across the map.

3) Difficulty
 - The Abyssal Path consists of 20 stages, each of which has a 'difficulty'.
 - The time spent clearing a stage determines how much the difficulty of the next stage will increase.
 - Boss monsters will appear in certain stages. If players clear that stage, a gate will appear that will increase the difficulty.
 - Rewards can only be claimed once the dungeon has ended. Rewards are based on the difficulty level at the time of the final stage.

- 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation' will be added. This item [u]can be acquired through the Awakening-exclusive dungeon 'Abyssal Path', Shop, or quests[/u]. It is used to unlock and use new skills and the Awakening Core System.
1) New Skill
(1) New 4th Bar Special Skill
- After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the first Main Core from the Core System.
- Each character will have 1 additional skill. This special skill can be used with all jobs of the same character.
- Players must choose between the existing and new 4th Bar Special Skill for use.
(2) Awakening Special Skill
- After Awakening the character, players can unlock and use the second Main Core from the Core System.
- The Awakening Special Skill will be reinforced each time another Main Core is unlocked.
- Each character will have 1 additional skill. Players can register the skill to the new skill slot added to right of the existing skill slot.
- Awakening Special Skills can be used when the exclusive gauge is full. Players can charge the gauge by consuming MP. However, even if the gauge is full, the skill cannot be used while on cooldown.
- Awakening Special Skills are not affected by the 'Reduce Skill MP(AP) Consumption' and 'Reduce Skill Cooldown' stats.
2) Core System
- The Core System will be added to the Awakening Tab of the Skill Tree.
- The Core System consists of 4 Main Cores and 9 Support Cores.
- The Main Core provides skills related to the new special skill, and the Support Core provides stats.
- Players can use the 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' to unlock Cores in order.
- Unlocking a Support Core provides fixed stats, which can be reset within a specified range using the 'Awakening Stone of Transformation'.
3) Crafting for New Chase Coordi - Awakening Added
- Awakening Chase Coordi for Elesis, Lire, and Arme will be added to the Craft Tab.
- Awakening Chase Coordi can be crafted using 300 'Chase Coordi Fragments'.
- Awakening Chase Coordi will be provided with Season 5 stats.
4) Bermesiah's Hero Collection - Awakening Added
- The 'Awakening' effect will be added to the 'Collections' category in Bermesiah's Hero Collection.
- This can be viewed in the tab to the right of the Lv. 85 effects. The Awakening effects are as follows.
- Elesis, Lire, and Arme Awakening Chase Coordi Collection will be added to Chase Coordi Collection.
- Completing the collection will provide additional stats for the account.
5) Character Information - Awakening Information Added
- For Awakened characters, '(Awakened)' will be added to the right of the job name.
6) Character Growth Guide Added
- 'Awakening Special Skill' and 'Core System' guides will be added.
7) Stat Descriptions Added
- The following 14 stats will be added to the Inventory's 'Stat Ranking' category and Player Information's 'Stat Information' category.
8) Awakening Shop Added
- The Rune category in the Shop will be renamed to Special Shop.
- The Awakening Shop will be added under the Special Shop.
9) Awakening Stone Package Added
- Players can purchase Awakening Stone of Freedom and Awakening Stone of Transformation packages with VP or GP in the Awakening Shop.
- Awakening Stone packages can be purchased 1 time per week per account.
10) Character Voice Overs
With the Awakening update, additional new Special Skill voices have been recorded for each language.
(1) Improvements to Existing Character Voices
- Improved voices that had low quality or inconsistent volume.
(2) Replaced Korean Voice Actors for Lire and Arme
- Changed the Korean voice actors for Elesis, Lire, and Arme from the same voice actor to separate voice actors for each character.
- Elesis' voice actor will remain the same, while Lire and Arme will have new voice actors.
(3) Applied Portuguese Voices
- Portuguese voices will be available in an additional update.
1. New Special Dungeon - Character Awakening Dungeon 'Abyssal Path' Update
1) Entry Requirements
- Entry is available with Level 85 characters.
- There will no daily play limit.
※ However, if players reach the maximum inventory holdings of 'Awakening Stone of Freedom' and 'Awakening Stone of Transformation', players cannot play the dungeon.
2) Abyssal Path Dungeon Features
- The Abyssal Path randomizes the monsters and maps that appear.
- Abyssal monsters have been given traits by the Void. They are randomly assigned a trait at the start of each stage, and each trait has different effects on attack and defense.
- From a certain stage onward, 'Calamities' occur on the Abyssal Path. Periodically, a wide AOE attack is cast across the map.
3) Difficulty
- The Abyssal Path consists of 20 stages, each of which has a 'difficulty'.
- The time spent clearing a stage determines how much the difficulty of the next stage will increase.
- Boss monsters will appear in certain stages. If players clear that stage, a gate will appear that will increase the difficulty.
- Rewards can only be claimed once the dungeon has ended. Rewards are based on the difficulty level at the time of the final stage.
4) Reward
(1) Awakening Stone
- Players can acquire 'Awakening Stone of Freedom', 'Awakening Stone of Transformation', and various rewards from each difficulty.
- The amount of rewards acquired increases with increasing difficulty.
(2) Title and Monster Card

notes.title: [Announcement] January 3rd Dev Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8d285c6f92a1f8f5429636761e50b40f84b46fc4.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

We understand that there are many questions about the upcoming [b]Awakening System[/b].
Today, we would like to give a brief introduction to the basic structure of the Awakening System and the direction of its development.
Let's check it out!


[b]■ Awakening System Introduction[/b]
[b] □ How to Awaken[/b]
Awakening can be unlocked after reaching [b]level 85[/b] and completing the [b]Awakening Missions[/b]!

[b] □ Awakening Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0dcfb800735fba17d5f5337019584fae32dca019.png[/img]
Players can use [b]Awakening Currency[/b] acquired through play to open the [b]Skill Tree[/b] and advance.
 The Skill Tree is composed of 2 elements shown below:
- [b]Main Core[/b]: The main growth component for acquiring and reinforcing new special skills.
- [b]Stat Support Core[/b]: The support growth component for fine-tuning and adjusting the stats for the character.


[b]  1. New Stage 4 Special Skill[/b]
This special skill has been developed to overcome the weaknesses of existing special skills and make them more useful in various contents.

[b]  2. Awakening Special Skill[/b]
[b]This will be the most powerful special skill[/b], allowing players to focus attacks in moments when players need to deal a great amount of damage.
[b]Features[/b]:
Upon using the special skill, the character's appearance will change and have increased stats for a certain period of time.
However, there is a [b]use limit[/b]. Players must choose the right timing to gain the upper hand.

[b]  3. Stat Support Core[/b]
Upon acquisition, fixed stats will be applied.
Players may use [b]Awakening Currency[/b] to reapply stats if necessary.
Each core has a set number of properties and values that can be acquired. Players must play the [b]Awakening Dungeon[/b] consistently to gain the desired stats!


[b]■ Awakening Dungeon[/b]
The [b]Awakening Dungeon[/b] is a challenge content that will test the limits of the characters that players have developed.

- [b]Requirements[/b]: Characters Level 85 or higher, 4-player dungeon.
- [b]Features[/b]:
Monsters and maps in each stage are randomized to provide a new twist.
Players can challenge to a higher difficulty level based on their performance.
The higher the final difficulty, the more [b]Awakening Currency[/b] players can acquire.


[b]■  Character Control Improvements[/b]
We are improving existing characters alongside the Awakening update to address feedback regarding the challenges with character controls and hitboxes.

[b]- Hitbox Improvements for Certain Attacks that Use Weapons:
Improved the hitbox for attacks that did not hit all enemies in the area[/b]
Improved the hitbox for certain attacks that cause reverse stun on successful hits, slowing down the player's attack speed

- Controls Improvements:
Improved controls for certain characters that were unable to dash in-air
Improved controls to make combo movements flow more smoothly

- Improvements may vary by character, so please stay tuned for more details in the update.
[b][Elesis Improvements Preview][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a53997a94ba966948a6cd28e32584d291eedefbe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/233dfed6f40250d5478f6e936544f653dae89c11.gif[/img]

[b][Lire Improvements Preview][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c1c912df19b30062750a3f00a6ec48927f479793.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c8d975fc8d1a9c4c64861e02edb6b3fc6f21a9c1.gif[/img]

[b][Arme Improvements Preview][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/73f46d535bb7d320762bca8ba5180640acd42731.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/95001192f224eff81edb65f23da03b661def0772.gif[/img]


The upcoming [b]Awakening system[/b] is being carefully developed to bring even more fun and challenge to players.
And please stay tuned for more contents to come!

We'll see you again in our next dev note. Thank you!

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
November 27th 03:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/217682cb4f454d949769e773586607866c3604f9.png[/img]
1. New Raid 'Void (Nightmare)' (November 27th After Maintenance - Permanent)
"The Void has withdrawn, but the world remains distorted."

The members of GrandChase succeeded in banishing the Void, but the victory was by no means complete.
The Void had merely withdrawn, and its abysmal darkness still lingered.

Then something unexpected happened. In the place where the battle had ended, an entirely new form of the Void was born.
The Void engulfed the world and absorbed parts of it, transforming it into something unnatural and grotesque.

Even now, the Void is still engulfing the world. The mutated beings are growing stronger and stronger.
If these beings continue to spawn, the world will eventually fall into the Void's control.

The members realize the urgency of the situation, and recognize how much stronger they need to be. 
At the same time, the will to overcome the despair begins to awaken within each of them.

In their minds, a new battle is about to begin. 
The nightmare has begun, and they must fight to its end.


1) Entry Requirement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b4afa758f07c924d03f6370ae690632e3f3c4ad0.png[/img]
 - Characters at Level 85 SS+ (200K↑) Battle Power or higher can enter.
 - Players can play 3 times per week. If players continue to play, clearing is possible but players will be given a penalty and will not be able to acquire additional rewards.
 - Players can use [Raid Dungeon Entry Tickets] to subtract the number of weekly clears and earn additional clear rewards.
 - The weekly clear count for Void (Nightmare) will reset every Friday.

2) Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b4ca3d4e3cecd51d07793f281a726957cff8412a.png[/img]
(1) [Voidal Absolute Equipment] Added
 - Added Level 85 Ancient grade equipment: [Voidal Absolute Gloves], [Voidal Absolute Shoes], and [Voidal Absolute Cloak].
 - Upon defeating Voidal Apostle (Nightmare), players can acquire [Voidal Absolute Gloves Select Box], [Voidal Absolute Shoes Select Box], or [Voidal Absolute Cloak Select Box] on a low chance.
 - Players can upgrade the [Voidal Fragment of Nightmare] and [True Iron Dragon Equipment] into [Voidal Absolute Gloves Select Box], [Voidal Absolute Shoes Select Box], or [Voidal Absolute Cloak Select Box] in the Hero's Bullion Shop.
 - The [Voidal Fragment of Nightmare] can be acquired as a reward from the Void (Nightmare) dungeon.
    Collect [Pieces of Voidal Fragment of Nightmare] for upgrades in the Hero's Bullion Shop.
    Collect 4 [Voidal Fragment of Invasion] or [Voidal Fragment of Taint] for upgrades in the Hero's Bullion Shop.

[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Game Client Optimization
Client optimization following the 64-bit client application will be implemented.
After the maintenance, the game will start with preloaded resources every time players launch the client.
In certain circumstances, players may experience a momentary delay to load additional resources. After that, we will continue to optimize based on play patterns to keep players' experiences as lag-free as possible.

The following improvements will be made with the optimization.
 - Improved the screen loading delay on initial click of the Seal Breaker Coordi button
 - Improved the screen loading delay on initial click of the Shop button
 - Improved the screen loading delay on initial click of the Collection button
 - Improved the lag when scrolling through Monster Card items in Warehouse
 - Improved the lag when scrolling through Monster Card categories in Collection
 - Improved the lag when changing weapons for MP characters in dungeons
 - Improved the initial loading speed when launching the game client
 - Improved the loading delay when clicking on another character in the Character Selection window

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9c76ae86de460fbe62367b39dc1cdc02acae44ca.png[/img]

1) Arsen
 - Slightly reduced activation time for tornado attack
 - Increased stun duration of tornado attack

2) Rui
 - Fixed a bug where the attack effect unintentionally occurred at a different location when attacking while facing left
 - Fixed so that the motion and hit box align when attacking while facing left

4. Other Fixes
 - Improved the effect and sound of the results upon using Seal Breaker Coordi
 - Fixed a bug where Elesis' image location unintentionally got displaced on the Minimap (TAB Key) in dungeons
 - Fixed a bug where the accessory effects would unintentionally remain after the character dies under certain circumstances

- Players can progress through missions with up to 3 characters at max.
- Players can receive rewards every time they reach a set battle power level.

- If players reach a certain Battle Power, players can acquire [Flawless Vigilance] Title, [Event] Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), [Event] GP Item Property Scroll, [Event] Growth Support Card Select Box, Single Stat Change Support Box, Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket, Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), Reinforcement Protection Scroll, GP Item Property Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, Monster Card Box, and other various items depending on the stage.
- Players can progress missions by pressing participating characters. (Players can progress through missions without selecting all 3 participating characters.)
- Once a player has made selections, players can only see the Event Menu in the World Map when they log into participating characters.
- All missions will be terminated during maintenance on December 18th (UTC+0).
- [Event] Growth Support Card Select Box: A box containing useful cards for each part of the equipment. Select 1 of 5 different cards to acquire.
- [Event] Growth Support Card Select Box Contents
- Players can acquire the [Flawless Vigilance] title upon achieving all Battle Power goals.
3) Daily Event Mission (November 6th After Maintenance - December 18th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
- Upon clearing the Daily Mission, players can acquire the rewards for the mission completed.
- The Daily Mission is not a chain mission and can be cleared at any order.
4) Weekly Chain Event Mission (November 6th After Maintenance - November 27th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
(1) Week 1 Chain Mission (November 6th After Maintenance - November 13th 06:00 (UTC+0))
- Players can clear a total of 8 missions in order and acquire rewards.
- Chain Mission can only be cleared 1 time per account.
- Login Mission will be counted starting on the next day the mission is registered. (Login Missions will not count on the registered day.)
- Players can acquire [Event] Single Property Scroll, [Event] GP Item Property Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll, and other various items upon clearing all missions for Week 1.
(2) Week 2 Chain Mission (November 13th 06:00 - November 20th 06:00 (UTC+0))
- Players can clear a total of 8 missions in order and acquire rewards.
- Chain Mission can only be cleared 1 time per account.
- Login mission can only be cleared if the previous login mission is cleared.
- Players can acquire [Event] Single Property Scroll, [Event] GP Item Property Scroll, [Event] Growth Support Card Select Box, and other various items upon clearing all missions for Week 2.
(3) Week 3 Chain Mission (November 20th 06:00 - November 27th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
- Players can clear a total of 8 missions in order and acquire rewards.
- Chain Mission can only be cleared 1 time per account.
- Login mission can only be cleared if the previous login mission is cleared.

- Players can acquire [Event] Single Property Scroll, [Event] GP Item Property Scroll, Another World Dungeon Entry Ticket, Hero Dungeon Entry Ticket, and other various items upon clearing all missions for Week 3.
2) Challenge! Aernas Great Exploration (November 6th After Maintenance - December 18th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
- Players can devise expedition parties to explore various regions of Aernas.
- There are a total of 10 regions and players can explore up to 3 regions at once.
- Exploration will take 20 hours.
(1) Expedition Party
- Up to 4 characters can be put in 1 Expedition Party
- Expedition Party will be created automatically based on character level
- Expedition Rank will be decided based on the sum of the levels of characters deployed in the Expedition Party and will give more rewards and more Exploration Progress the higher the rank.
(2) Exploration Reward
- Players can press [Receive Reward] or [Receive All] after 20 hours of exploring to receive rewards for Exploration.
- Players can receive higher grade rewards based on Rank.
- Exploration Rewards will be sent by mail. Certain items for Exploration Reward cannot be moved to the warehouse. Please carefully choose the character to receive the Exploration Reward.
(3) Exploration Progress
- Upon receiving Exploration Reward, players will gain Exploration Progress based on Expedition Rank
- Players will receive rewards for each region if they reach 100% Exploration Progress.
- Total Exploration Progress is the sum of Exploration Progress for all regions.
- Players will receive rewards for every 10% of Total Exploration Progress gained.

Client optimization following the 64-bit client application will be implemented.
After the maintenance, the game will start with preloaded resources every time players launch the client.

- The transparency of skill effects for the player can be set in increments of 20%/40%/60%/80%/100%.

- Changed so that Elesis is able to cancel the motion by dashing after landing.
[Annihilate]

- Increased the damage.

- Increased the damage.

- Improved the arrows to penetrate targets.

[Chained Rush]

[Hyper Sonic Step]
- Increased the attack range.
- Improved so that players can press the Z key while attacking to consume MP and deal additional attack.
- Increased the damage.
[Unlimited Blade]
- Increased the attack range.
- Increased the hit count by 1 and increased the damage.
Improved so that all hit range are equal for [Spacial Divide].

■ Striker (4th Job)
◇ Skill
[Quick Slash]
- Improved so that damage is dealt to a set area instead of following Lass around.
- Increased the attack range.

5) Ryan
■ Druid (1st Job)
◇ Skill
[Heaven's Guardian]
- Reduced the duration of stun for special skill.
- Adjusted the time it takes to summon all fireballs to be halved.
- Reduced the duration of fireballs for faster hit intervals.
- Reduced the duration and explosive damage of fireballs.
- Increased damage over time.

■ Vanquisher (4th Job)
◇ Skill
[Gatling Spiral]
- Reduced the duration of stun for special skill.
- Increased the attack range.
- Improved so that players can press direction keys while attacking to move.
- Improved so that players can press the Z key while attacking to consume MP and deal additional attack.
- Reduced the damage for 1st~4th damage and increased the damage for 5th~7th damage.
- Increased the total damage.

- Reduced the duration of stun for special skill.
- Increased the distance moved with skill by a small amount.
- Increased the attack count by 1.
- Changed so that Ryan does not fall from the air until end of hit.

- Removed the 1st and 2nd hit.
- Increased the final explosion attack range.
- Increased the damage of hits after the removed hits by the amount of damage lost.

- Improved so that normal monsters hit by the projectile will be moved to the center.

◇ Skill
Increased the attack range and damage of [Asura Strike] and [Asura Strike (Enhanced)]
[Asura Slicer][Enhanced Asura Slicer][Asura Yang][Enhanced Asura Yang]
- Reduced the duration of stun for special skill.
- Increased the attack range.
[Skyfall]
- Removed the lotus damage that targets enemies within the area of effect.
- Added an attack that hits a large area.
- Increased the area of effect of the lotus that is created at the designated location.

9) Sieghart
■ Duelist (3rd Job)
◇ Skill
Improved [Rising Weapon] and [Rising Weapon (Rage)] so that directions can be changed by pressing left/right during skill cast.
Increased the attack range of [Death Punisher].
[Death Punisher (Rage)]
- Improved so that the hitbox matches the visual effects of the first slash attack.
- Increased the attack range.
- Increased the damage.
[Power Liberation]
- Improved MP Recovery by changing the Enhanced Command Attack while buff is active to Basic Attack.
- Added an attack increase effect while buff is active.

◇ Skill
Changed the [Shockwave] so that only 1 shockwave will be created and have increased range.
[High Power Rush]
- Changed so that each individual explosion deals separate damage.
- Changed the explosion so that it hits only 1 time per explosion.
- Increased the attack range.
Increased the attack range of [Chaos Beam].
[Ultimate Weapon]
- Improved MP Recovery by changing the Enhanced Command Attack while the buff is active to Basic Attack.
- Removed the stack effect of Enhanced Command.
- Increased the damage of Enhanced Command.
- Changed so that explosion occurs at the location of attack of Enhanced Command.

- Improved so that the hitbox matches the visual effects.
- Increased the damage.

- Reduced the damage interval by 50%.
- Reduced the sustained hit damage.
- Added a powerful hit at the creation of Kill Zone.
- Added stun to special skill. However, Dio will not be stunned.
Added 3 small explosions after the final big explosion of [Chaos Hit].
Increased the attack range and damage of [Innocent Fear].

◇ Skill
Improved [Grandark's Domination] so that duration will not be reduced when skill is used while the buff is active.
[Shining Gran]
- Increased the projectile speed.
- Improved so that the target will not counterattack upon contact with the projectile.
- Changed so that the projectile explodes upon contact with the target.
- Removed the damage from the projectile.
- Increased the range of explosion.
- Increased the damage of explosion.
Increased the attack range of [Bleeding Gash].
Increased the damage of [Zero Domination].
Increased the damage of [Dimension Fissure].

[Flawless Attack]
