notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
October 16th 04:00 - 08:30 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
1. New Chaser Pass (October 16th After Maintenance - December 18th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/49fc048b2098ba2e591952c0ee4e3dff01f82e44.png[/img]

(1) Chaser Pass Entry
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d51f22c6dcc37e5f8df138a97362b8c55c4b3f6b.png[/img]
 - Players can enter Chaser Pass by pressing Chaser Pass found in the right-hand bottom corner of the Main Lobby.
 - Chaser Pass Mission will be added to the Repeat Mission and will be marked with [Chaser Pass].
 - There will be Free Chaser Pass and Premium Chaser Pass.

(2) Free Chaser Pass
 - Players can clear Daily and Weekly Missions to receive Pass EXP to raise Pass Level.
 - Players can acquire Pass Levels to open rewards. Players can press the Receive button to claim the rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/09e1c1087a717a3e9469f20c67ae11ac4f0559f6.png[/img]
 - Players can purchase [Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket] to acquire additional Pass EXP equivalent to 1 Level. (Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(3) Free Chaser Pass Reward
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can receive [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card. [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card: 772 Special Attack / 0.87% Taint Resistance
 - Exclusive Reward and Chaser Pass Card Select Box, Special Reinforcement Release Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16), and other various rewards.
 - Players can select 1 of Solar Chaser, Luna Chaser, and Star Chaser Monster Card from the [Chaser Pass Card Select Box].
 - [Solar Chaser] Monster Card: 760 Special Attack / 0.40% Taint Resistance
 - [Lunar Chaser] Monster Card: 475 Attack / 0.40% Taint Resistance
 - [Star Chaser] Monster Card: 26.50% Critical Damage / 0.40% Taint Resistance

(4) Premium Pass
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b733a7937afa899ce0e655e2a43af2b112bb3546.png[/img]
 - Players who purchase [Premium Pass] will receive additional rewards on top of the Free Rewards from the Free Chaser Pass. (Premium Pass Price: 20,000 VP)
 - Players can clear Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal Mission to receive Pass EXP to raise Pass Level.
 - [Chaser Pass - Seasonal Mission] can only be cleared 1 time during the Pass Period after purchasing [Premium Pass].
 - [Premium Pass] will be applied upon purchase and will allow players to receive all rewards up to the Pass Level that the player has reached.
 - Players can purchase [Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket] to acquire additional Pass EXP equivalent to 1 Level. (Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(5) Premium Pass Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/e7a4147837dc846fcee1142ca81a0a18cb6bac1f.png[/img]
 - Players can acquire additional Premium Pass exclusive rewards.
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can acquire [Free] Space Float Motion, [Twinkle Twinkle Shooting Star Coordi Select Box], [Space Rabbit Coordi Select Box]. Players can freely choose the Coordi item for the character of their choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c2aaec190ac3b22c92f70c24aec894c7e529dc40.gif[/img]
 - [Free] Space Float
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8b3d830638ee2c59a78b604fe57c394664a905fb.png[/img]
 - Twinkle Twinkle Shooting Star Coordi (Epic Grade Season 8 Coordi)
 - Space Rabbit Coordi (Epic Grade Season 8 Coordi)
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can receive [Voidal Challenger] Monster Card. [Voidal Challenger] Monster Card: 31.50% Critical Damage / 0.43% Taint Resistance
Players can acquire [Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket], [Single Stat Change Support Box], [Berkas' Property Select Scroll] as exclusive rewards.
 - Players can acquire Another TYPE1 Coordi Outfit Select Box, Another TYPE1 Coordi Weapon Select Box, Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), GP Item Property Scroll, Chaser Pass: Growing Hero's Title Box, and other various rewards.

[b]<Event>[/b]
1. Spooky Halloween Event Background Change
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c8c3a3cd9daccc61828797f2b8060cda1c7614b2.png[/img]
 - Embark on a mystical adventure through the spooky Halloween themed Lobby and Elven Forest!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b2cd88b4004bc9284e74c8d866ff2c4757ba3041.png[/img]

2. Spooky Halloween Event (October 16th After Maintenance - November 6th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
1) Spooky Halloween Event Attendance Log
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/be167b395c57e94548ee65cf0694260c7514d3d7.png[/img]
 - Players can acquire login rewards by logging in for 30 minutes daily for 15 days.
 - Players can acquire [Special] Halloween Box, Single Stat Change Scroll, Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll, Another World Dungeon Entry Ticket, Hero Dungeon Entry Ticket, GP Item Property Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll, and other various items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/766dc584b9a2bc1fb32720ef65211fa97321d383.png[/img]
 - Players can acquire all contents of [[Special] Halloween Box].
 - [[Special] Halloween Box] Content: Halloween Accessory Select Box x1, [Jack-O-Lantern] Monster Card x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0705e2ae993c330165538b0f7fbaca49ad77082f.png[/img]
 - A box that lets you select 1 of the content of [Halloween Accessory Select Box].
 - [Halloween Accessory Select Box] Content: Halloween Headband Select Box x1, Witch's Hat Coordi Select Box x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1d17256c3a83c435601b8fc6fdeb13504997b012.png[/img]
 - Halloween Headband / Witch's Hat Equip Preview

2) Jack-O'-Lantern Hunt Event Mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8a1aa98fd80e193c7037b111dac13343f10331b4.png[/img]
 - Players can collect [Pumpkin Basket] by clearing Event Daily Missions.
 - Players can acquire [Pumpkin Basket] x5 by clearing Event Daily Mission (1): Defeat Jack-O'-Lantern 7 Times
 - Players can acquire [Pumpkin Basket] x5 by clearing Event Daily Mission (2): Defeat Jack-O'-Lantern 8 Times
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/cb8b170a0a6cd0a5dd7eeff61b7eb2069f660043.png[/img]
 - Players can receive 1 of the contents of [Pumpkin Basket] at varied rates.
 - [Pumpkin Basket] Content (Acquire 1):
   Single Property Scroll (Lv.85) x1, GP Item Property Scroll x1, Another World Monster Card Box x1, Region Monster Card Box x1, Special Reinforcement Release Scroll x1, Socket Gem x1, Lisnar's MP Potion x1, Lisnar's HP Potion x1, 50% Potion of Wills x1, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x1, 1 Million GP Coupon x1
 - Event Excluded Dungeons: The Crucible, The Sanctum of Destruction, Wizard's Labyrinth, Berkas' Lair, Tower of Disappearance, Land of Judgment, Nightmare Circus, Monster Train 301, Hungry Pets' Revolt, Moonlight Village, Angry Bosses, Talin's Revenge, King Slime Land, Dimension Door, Trial Forest, Trial Tower, Outer Wall of Serdin, Kerrie Beach, Orc Temple, Gorgos' Dungeon, Elven Forest, Gorge of Oaths, Marsh of Oblivion, Forsaken Barrows, Forgotten City, Gaikoz's Castle, The Whispering Woods, Ruins of the Silver Knights, Lake Aurora, King Guang's Fen, Primeval Island, King Fang's Lair, Victor's Fortress, Voidal, Infinite Cloister, The Great Explosion of Kounat, île de Frost Region, Trivia Region

3) Weekly Chain Mission
 - Players can clear weekly chain missions consecutively and acquire rewards.
 - Weekly missions can be cleared 1 time per account.
(1) Week 1 (October 16th After Maintenance - October 23rd 06:00 (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9fbf96f35b01a66976fe070c2f846a45653af694.png[/img]
 - Defeat 100 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pumpkin Basket x3, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x5
 - Defeat 200 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pumpkin Basket x3, GP Item Property Scroll x1
 - Defeat 300 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Title [Spooky Halloween] x1
 - Spooky Halloween title will be registered to the current character and cannot be moved once acquired, so please note when selecting the character to receive them.

(2) Week 2 (October 23rd 06:00 - October 30th 06:00 (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/4ae693e49e89e6e438d4477971ccb57cbedcf99c.png[/img]
 - Defeat 100 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pumpkin Basket x3, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x5
 - Defeat 200 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pumpkin Basket x3, GP Item Property Scroll x1
 - Defeat 300 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Halloween Accessory Select Box x1, [Jack-O-Lantern] Monster Card x1

(3) Week 3 (October 30th 06:00 - November 6th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d08b0f65f588c95c91776470b0153f15ee5d90a0.png[/img]
 - Defeat 100 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pumpkin Basket x3, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x5
 - Defeat 200 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pumpkin Basket x3, GP Item Property Scroll x1
 - Defeat 300 Monsters in the Appropriate Level Range: Pet Trickster Card x1
 - Pet Trickster Card cannot be moved to the Warehouse once acquired, so please note when selecting the character to receive them.

4) Accumulated Login Event (October 31st 06:00 - November 4th 06:00 (UTC+0))
- Accumulated Login Event will begin after selecting a server and a starting character.
- The Accumulated Login Event time count may vary by seconds when players switch servers and change characters, compared to the Login Event time count.
 - 30 Minutes Accumulated Login Reward: SP All Reset x1, Dungeon Entry Ticket Box x1
 - 60 Minutes Accumulated Login Reward: Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15) x3, Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16) x1
 - 90 Minutes Accumulated Login Reward: Advanced Rune Summon Chest x10, Premium GC Club 3 Days
 - 120 Minutes Accumulated Login Reward: Single Stat Change Support Box x1, Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket x1
 - 150 Minutes Accumulated Login Reward: Spooky Jack-O'-Lantern Necklace Select Box x1, Single Property Scroll (Lv.85) x2, GP Item Property Scroll x2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/debd6fdec05a8e5d3658df01cab8fa6ac9519fb0.png[/img]
 - Players can select a 'Spooky Jack-O'-Lantern Necklace Box' for a specific character through the [Spooky Jack-O'-Lantern Necklace Select Box].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/38256c62ede58ebeef2c66f32a340a67e0c5cb2c.png[/img]
 - Upon opening the [Spooky Jack-O'-Lantern Necklace Box], players can acquire '+0 Halloween Necklace' or '+9 Halloween Necklace' at set rates.

5) 7 Days Login Event (October 25th 06:00 - November 1st 06:00 (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/35b706647e61c520aa921672960b739e5e5754b1.png[/img]
 - Login for all 7 days during the event period to acquire all parts of the Halloween Day Coordi items.
 - Day 1 (October 25th 06:00 ~ October 26th 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Helm' upon login!
 - Day 2 (October 26th 06:00 ~ October 27th 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Upper Armor' upon login!
 - Day 3 (October 27th 06:00 ~ October 28th 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Lower Armor' upon login!
 - Day 4 (October 28th 06:00 ~ October 29th 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Gloves' upon login!
 - Day 5 (October 29th 06:00 ~ October 30th 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Shoes' upon login!
 - Day 6 (October 30th 06:00 ~ October 31st 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Cloak' upon login!
 - Day 7 (October 31st 06:00 ~ November 1st 06:00 (UTC+0)): Acquire 'Halloween Special Coordi Select Box - Weapon' upon login!

6) Dungeon Permanent Entry Event (October 16th After Maintenance - November 6th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
 - The 'Tower of Disappearance' and 'Berkas' Lair' will no longer have entry time limits during the event period.
 - The daily entry count for 'Tower of Disappearance' and the daily reward count for 'Berkas' Lair' will reset on 06:00 (UTC+0), same as the original reset time.

3. Character Level Growth Event (October 16th After Maintenance - November 27th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c5a284659a1139bdacdce4661ad9546971985b7c.png[/img]
 - Players can select 1 character per account to go forward with the mission during the event period.
 - Rewards will vary depending on the character.
 - Once a player makes the selection, they cannot change the character anymore. Players must choose the character for the event carefully.

 - Party members who are changing characters cannot be kicked.
 - If the Waiting Room has a password set, players can enter without entering the password with the changed character.
 - However, please note that players will be kicked from the Waiting Room in the following cases.
(1) If the dungeon has not been opened because the swapped character did not clear the previous dungeon (stage)
(2) If the player does not meet the dungeon entry requirements due to Level, Battle Power, etc.
(3) If the player does not meet the Battle Power Limit set by the Room Master
(4) If the player does not own the corresponding Dungeon Entry Tickets
(5) If the dungeon has not opened for entry yet
(6) If the player has reached the daily reward limit for Wizard's Labyrinth
(7) If the player takes longer than 10 seconds to change their character
(8) If the player attempts to enter île de Frost and Trivia region dungeons with characters other than Edel and Veigas

However, once players unequip that piece of equipment, players will not be able to equip it again until its level requirement is reached.

notes.title: [Announcement] October 11th Developer Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8d285c6f92a1f8f5429636761e50b40f84b46fc4.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We hope that everyone is enjoying the recent updates to Costume Suit Coordi, Motion System, and Quality of Life improvements.
The development team is preparing fun updates for the second half of the year.
Further announcements will be made as development progresses to the point where it's ready for release.

The October 16th update will bring [Character Balance Adjustments] and [Quality of Life Improvements #2].

[b]1. Character Balance Adjustments[/b]
We are grateful for the feedback we have received from players through surveys and other means.
We will continue to improve the balance so that various characters are not neglected and can thrive in various contents.

■ Stage 4 Special Skill Improvements
The damage of Stage 4 Special Skills will be reviewed and adjusted as a whole to reduce performance differences between characters.
Certain skills will undergo changes such as damage and hitbox adjustments to systemic changes.
If a skill's concept makes it difficult to improve, we will consider replacing the skill or adding a new Stage 4 Special Skill after this balance.

■ Non-Preferred Job and Special Skill Improvements
Special skills that were previously underutilized due to performance will be improved.
Performance differences will be reduced so that players can choose from a wider variety of jobs based on preference.

■ Other Improvements
Skills that are less effective or miss due to the hit box range will be improved.
Skills that underperform due to a long wait time before hit box activation will be improved.

■ PVP Balance
Decanee's dash and combo attacks will be adjusted first as it has been determined overpowered compared to other character skills in existing PVP matches.
We are currently looking closely at PVP balance improvements, but we apologize for the delay in making necessary adjustments.
We believe PVP needs more than just balance adjustments, but also long-term improvements to play goals and rewards.
We will be working on a more detailed plan to ensure PVP works as a fun feature of GrandChase.

[b]2. Quality of Life Improvements #2[/b]
We will continue to make necessary improvements after Quality of Life Improvements #2.

■ Character Change in PVP/Dungeon Waiting Rooms
We are working on a long-standing issue that many players have commented on.
Players will now be able to instantly switch characters in the Waiting Room and continue playing without having to go to Character Selection.
We are hoping this feature will help players develop various characters.

■ Move All Function for Warehouse
The ability to move items with selectable quantities for from the inventory to the warehouse at once by pressing the [Move All] button will be added.
We expect this function to reduce the time it takes to organize the Warehouse.

■ Game Visual Settings Added
Various functions will be added to help reduce the discomfort caused by flashy effects and graphics.
 - A toggle option for the Zoom effect when using skills will be added.


There are many other improvements in the works, and more details will be shared in an update announcement.
We will continue to work hard to make GrandChase a great game that players will enjoy for years to come.


Thank you.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
September 25, 2024 (Wed) 04:00 ~ 08:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<System>[/b]
1. Expression System Update
- 'Expression System' allows players to customize characters in various ways.
- 'Motion System' has been added to the 'Expression System' and it will be expanded further in future updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/085056eb9eb980cdecc1b7957b93e012593bc8bf.png[/img]
- New Motion Items can be purchased with VP or GP in the Shop, or earned through Events.

1) Expression Tab Update
- Players can enter the 'Expression Tab' through the Menu. (Cannot be entered through Inventory or Skill Tree window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/416d38294c458cb4cc7bd487c0d50be67d739571.png[/img]
- Players can equip or replace registered Motions from the 'Expression Tab'
- New Motions must be used in the Inventory to be applied in the UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c948d917ccad4166b79313c9a37de671fa44e88a.png[/img]
  - Character's Job Motion is automatically registered.
  - Players cannot register the same Motion Item more than once.
  - Registered Motion will be assigned to the character.
  - Unregistered motions can be moved to the storage or sold.
  - All Motions can be viewed in the Expression Tab, regardless of their registration status.
  - MP Characters can only view Job Motion that match their equipped weapon.
- Click the Star Icon to set as 'Favorites'. Motions set as 'Favorites' will be placed above other Motions.
  - However, Character's Job Motion cannot be added to 'Favorites'.

2) Motion Type
- Motions are categorized into 'Exclusive Motion' and 'Free Motion'.
(1) Exclusive Motion
- Exclusive Motion can be only used in specific situations, such as [Waiting Room], [Start], [Taunt], and [Victory].
  - Waiting Room Motion : A Motion that automatically plays when player enters the Waiting Room.
  - Start Motion : A Motion that automatically plays when player enters Dungeon or PvP
  - Taunt Motion : A Motion that automatically plays when Taunt (V) is pressed.
  - Victory Motion : A Motion that automatically plays when player wins.

(2) Free Motion
- Free Motions are motions that can be applied and used in a Quickslot, with a maximum of 5 Motions. (Keyboard Shortcut 6~0)
- Unlike Exclusive Motions, Free motions can be used in the Waiting Room, Dungeons, PvP, and at the Park.

3) Motion Item Shop Category
- 'Expression' category will be added to the Cash Shop and GP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/2f5e03af8224849fa8d9091dbd82062a5e0f264f.png[/img]

4) Quickslot Change
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0e75062d166fc3aa9695411489dc9b208147da82.png[/img]
- In Waiting Rooms and Dungeons with the Quickslot command, players can change Quickslots by pressing the [~] key.
- The Quickslot will be changed to the following order in the Waiting Room: Potions, Emotes, and Motions.
- Applied Dungeons: Berkas' Lair, Void (Invasion), Void (Taint)

notes.title: [Announcement] 64-Bit Client Update and 32-Bit Discontinuation on September 25th
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

As previously announced, to provide players with a more stable gaming experience, we will discontinue support for 32-bit clients and transition to 64-bit clients starting with the upcoming September 25 maintenance.

The 64-bit client update will be applied across all platforms, including Steam.  Please check back in advance to ensure smooth gameplay.


[b]■ How to check current operating system [url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/which-version-of-windows-operating-system-am-i-running-628bec99-476a-2c13-5296-9dd081cdd808][Link][/url][/b]
 - If the PC already has a 64-bit Operating System, an upgrade is not needed to play.

[b]■ How to upgrade to 64-bit Operating System[/b]
 - First, check the 64-bit support for the current CPU.
- [Windows 10]: Settings > System > About > System Type
- [Windows 8/8.1]: Settings > PC Info > System Type
- [Windows 7]: Start Menu > Right-click Computer > Properties > System Type

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "64-bit processor" or "x64", the CPU supports 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after updating to 64-bit Windows.
[url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/software-download/windows10][64-Bit Windows Update Link][/url]

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "32-bit processor" or "x86", the CPU does not support 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after changing the CPU for one that supports 64-bit Operating Systems and updating to 64-bit Windows.

[b]※ Additional Details[/b]
- Players who are currently using the 32-bit client are asked to upgrade to the 64-bit client before the September 25th maintenance.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Announcement] Uno Play Style Introduction
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

Today, we will be introducing Uno's 'Wound' System.


1) Uno can use Blood Energy Attack using the 'X' key to apply a 'Wound' on an opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/6917376f50cb3708914946c1f1f1ad62e3b1d007.gif[/img]

Wound' deals Bleed damage for a certain time, and players can attack enemies with 'Wound' to deal even more Bleed damage.

Players can also use the expand command 'X' to deal additional damage to enemies with 'Wound', or recover Uno's HP.


2) Uno has a Just Frame command on his skills for additional attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/10b0aa958ac2be794850d765c1c57b6c70f15fcb.gif[/img]
- Uno 3rd Bar Special Skill Bloody Rain

Stay tuned for Uno, which will be updated on August 14th!


[b]<Go To Uno Pre-Registration>[/b]
https://classic.grandchase.net/event/uno/



Thank you.

1. New Solo Hero Dungeon 'Infinite Cloister' (July 24th After Maintenance - (UTC+0))
A part of the world has been distorted from the explosion caused by the Chaotic Witch,
and multiple worlds have come together as the borders between time and dimension have disappeared.

A new dark power taking advantage of the chaos to take over the worlds has emerged.
Among them, the most powerful is one who has lost their loved one, the Ancient Demon Duell

The only reason why Duell, who would go through any lengths to bring her back…
To use the infinite possibilities of multiple worlds to bring back Edna.

He knew that manipulating the dimensions would put all of the world in danger, but he could not stop.
Despite opening countless dimensional doors, only monsters awaited him… Edna was nowhere to be found.

He continued to look for her despite his waning body, valuing even the smallest chance he had.
He continued on endlessly searching for her, between time and dimensions.
"Only if I can see you again…"

Meanwhile, Kallia has detected the danger in the multiple worlds and started her investigation.
She noticed that the giant dimensional tear would put all the worlds in danger.

And so begins a fierce battle in an infinite world, where no one can afford to lose. He two face each other in the end and Kallia tries to stop Duell. But at a crucial moment, she hesitates.
This was because Kallia saw not the evil in Duell but his sacrifice to find his loved one.
Although Kallia is usually stoic, she feels compassion for Duell. However, for the sake of a stable world, she has to stop him. 

And so begins a fierce battle in an infinite world, where no one can afford to lose.
"Sorry… But I have to stop you"'

notes.title: [Announcement] 2024.07.24 Duell VS Kallia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/19b3eda5369821e9f657164560e2cd8ab4820772.png[/img]

A part of the world has been distorted from the explosion caused by the Chaotic Witch,
and multiple worlds have come together as the borders between time and dimension have disappeared.

A new dark power taking advantage of the chaos to take over the worlds has emerged.
Among them, the most powerful is one who has lost their loved one, the Ancient Demon Duell

The only reason why Duell, who would go through any lengths to bring her back…
To use the infinite possibilities of mulitple worlds to bring back Edna.

He knew that manipulating the dimensions would put all of the world in danger, but he could not stop.
Despite opening countless dimensional doors, only monsters awaited him… 
Edna was nowhere to be found.

He continued to look for her despite his waning body, valuing even the smallest chance he had.

Only if I can see you again…

Meanwhile, Kallia has detected the danger in the multiple worlds and started her investigation.
She noticed that the giant dimensional tear would put all the worlds in danger.

The two face each other in the end and Kallia tries to stop Duell. But at a crucial moment, she hesitates.
This was because Kallia saw not the evil in Duell but his sacrifice to find his loved one.
Although Kallia is usually stoic, she feels compassion for Duell. However, for the sake of a stable world, she has to stop him. 

And so begins a fierce battle in an infinite world, where no one can afford to lose.
"Sorry… But I have to stop you"'

<Content>
1. Monster Card Collection Addition
 - A 'Monster Card Collection' where players can collect Monster Cards and acquire rewards will be added. This new system can be accessed through the current collection window. (Hotkey C)
 - The Monster Card Collection is an account-wide system similar to Hero Collection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d0e3da423f21148e1ae92abd51eb2f732bc1be28.png[/img]
 - All cards will have 'Card Points' when added to the collection. Cards will have different points based on rarity and cards with higher points decreases cards needed for the collection. 
 - Card equip level will no longer be used. instead, card points will be shown at the top right of the monster card.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7fe65992d4d759e14d511cba1ca2f579ebf41eab.png[/img]

1) How to Progress Monster Card Collection
 - Consume identical Monster Cards to increase the Monster Card Collection Level.
 - Monster Card Collection Level starts at Lv 0 and can be increased up to Lv 3
 - However, Collection Level for some cards cannot be raised. Limited time event dungeon cards (Gorgos Queen's Lair, Illusions of Memory, Throne of the Goddess, Dimensional Chaser), Chaser Pass Card

2) Collection Rewards
 - Abilities and Chaser Points will be activated based on Monster Card Collection Levels.
 - For ever 5 levels of Collection Level, the Collection Reward will be activated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/64304399aca98017a7b804b43475eecdf19931e7.png[/img]

notes.title: [Announcement] Sea Dragon King Coordi Upper Armor Ornament Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
‘Sea Dragon King Upper Armor Ornament’ has been changed to always be displayed in Dungeon/PvP.
 
Originally, the goal was to have the item always be shown in game. But during internal testing, we found that the item caused the characters to have abnormal movements and excessive obstruction of combat motions for certain characters. After considering alternatives to avoid these issues, we changed the item to only appear when using a skill.
 
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused to players who purchased the ‘Sea Dragon King Coordi Upper Armor Ornament’ expecting the ornament to always be shown.
After this patch, the ‘Sea Dragon Coordi Upper Armor Ornament’ will be shown regardless of the situation.
We will continue to monitor and make additional improvements to the item in the future.
We will continue to provide more detailed information about any important changes to the item.

[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
- Improved Sea Dragon King Upper Armor Ornament to always be displayed in Dungeon/PvP

We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Announcement] Notice for 64-bit Client Update on July 3rd
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

As mentioned in the previous announcement, in order to provide a more stable gaming experience, 
we are planning on [b]updating to the 64-bit client during maintenance on July 3rd.[/b]

There will be a period in which the 32-bit client can still be used after the update to the live servers.
However, please note that after the period is over, players must update to the 64-bit client.
We will announce the end of support of the 32-bit client in a separate announcement.

[b]■ How to check current operating system [url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/which-version-of-windows-operating-system-am-i-running-628bec99-476a-2c13-5296-9dd081cdd808][Link][/url][/b]
 - If the PC already has a 64-bit Operating System, an upgrade is not needed to play.

[b]■ How to upgrade to 64-bit Operating System[/b]
 - First, check the 64-bit support for the current CPU.
- [Windows 10]: Settings > System > About > System Type
- [Windows 8/8.1]: Settings > PC Info > System Type
- [Windows 7]: Start Menu > Right-click Computer > Properties > System Type

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "64-bit processor" or "x64", the CPU supports 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after updating to 64-bit Windows.
[url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/software-download/windows10][64-Bit Windows Update Link][/url]

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "32-bit processor" or "x86", the CPU does not support 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after changing the CPU for one that supports 64-bit Operating Systems and updating to 64-bit Windows.

[b]※ Additional Details[/b]
 - On July 3rd maintenance, the Steam Client will be updated to 64-bit/32-bit.
Other clients will stay at 32-bit and be updated to 64-bit over time.
 - Upon starting the client after the update to the servers, the client wil automatically update to the 64-bit client and be used as the default client.
 - In order to use the 32-bit client, a separate method must be used. Details will be included in a separate announcement at a later date.

We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

In order to provide a more stable gaming experience, we are preparing for a 64-bit client update.
Switching to a 64-bit client will provide benefits such as reduced game lag and improved loading speeds.

Once the update is on live servers, the game will only run on 64-bit operating systems. Players with 32-bit operating systems will have to upgrade to 64-bit operating systems.

- [Windows 10]: Settings > System > About > System Type

There will be a period in which the 32-bit client can still be used after the update to the live servers.
However, please note that after the period is over, players must update to the 64-bit client.

We will conduct internal testing to ensure as few problems as possible while switching to the new client.
We will announce the details in a separate announcement at a later date.

We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
May 8th 04:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f57e3bff91cebc3af9b05a896a14271bb6fff72b.png[/img]
1. New Another World Dungeon 'The Great Explosion of Kounat' (May 8th After Maintenance (UTC+0))

"Stop the Great Explosion that will Destroy the World at the End of the Past!"

The Grand Chase have travelled back in time in pursuit of the Witch.
The Grand Chase have arrived at the ancient kingdom of Kounat, just before Ashtaroth was about to cause the Great Explosion.
Ashtaroth desired to end the world through the Great Explosion and become the Creator of the new world.

The Grand Chase defeated the enemies that stood in their way and finally reached the center of the plot.
Ashtaroth acquired the powers of the creator, but it is unstable. This is the last chance to stop him!
The Grand Chase is about to engage the awakened Ashtaroth in a final battle to stop the Great Explosion.

However, in this desperate situation, everyone forgot about a certain presence amidst all the chaos…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d035fac94a9de6c65780badf79484e1fdc862d00.png[/img]
1) Entry Requirement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/95ad328e366195a93b7bc4999d66dea88aba4f21.png[/img]

 - Players can play 2 times a day. Players may enter and clear past the clear limit, but will not receive any rewards.
 - Players can receive additional clear rewards by using [Another World Dungeon Entry Ticket]. Weekly clear count will be consumed upon clearing.

2) Reward
(1) 6 New Lv.85 Relic Grade Earrings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a7dee81d809f1efe5b9c83d575b7fb7a3b0509d2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d6755de5367f19093c74e6ef515d2c81e181ce8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1d1d367f56b35e4a987bad27fee500f710b19411.png[/img]

- Players can acquire [Hero's Bullion] and [Dimension Core] as clear rewards. If the player has reached the clear limit, the player will not receive rewards.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
April 3rd 05:00 - 07:55 (UTC+0)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/3a97eefc271fa3e8530606eb5690c9dd86f5a1e1.png[/img]

1. New Chaser Pass (April 3rd After Maintenance - June 12th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0c52a2d95ec43abd66945c990cd6bdf1f75be04d.png[/img]

(1) Chaser Pass Entry
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d51f22c6dcc37e5f8df138a97362b8c55c4b3f6b.png[/img]
 - Players can enter Chaser Pass by pressing Chaser Pass found in the right-hand bottom corner of the Main Lobby.
 - Chaser Pass Mission will be added to the Repeat Mission and will be marked with [Chaser Pass].
 - There will be Free Chaser Pass and Premium Chaser Pass.

(2) Free Chaser Pass
 - Players can clear Daily and Weekly Missions to receive Pass EXP to raise Pass Level.
 - Players can acquire Pass Levels to open rewards. Players can press the Receive button to claim the rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/09e1c1087a717a3e9469f20c67ae11ac4f0559f6.png[/img]
 - Players can purchase [Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket] to acquire additional Pass EXP equivalent to 1 Level. (Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(3) Free Chaser Pass Reward
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can receive [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card. [Voidal Chaser] Monster Card: 772 Special Attack / 0.87% Taint Resistance
 - Exclusive Reward and Chaser Pass Card Select Box, Special Reinforcement Release Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16), and other various rewards.
 - Players can select 1 of Solar Chaser, Luna Chaser, and Star Chaser Monster Card from the [Chaser Pass Card Select Box].
 - [Solar Chaser] Monster Card: 760 Special Attack / 0.40% Taint Resistance
 - [Lunar Chaser] Monster Card: 475 Attack / 0.40% Taint Resistance

(4) Premium Pass
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b733a7937afa899ce0e655e2a43af2b112bb3546.png[/img]
 - Players who purchase [Premium Pass] will receive additional rewards on top of the Free Rewards from the Free Chaser Pass. (Premium Pass Price: 20,000 VP)
 - Players can clear Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal Mission to receive Pass EXP to raise Pass Level.
 - [Chaser Pass - Seasonal Mission] can only be cleared 1 time during the Pass Period after purchasing [Premium Pass].
 - [Premium Pass] will be applied upon purchase and will allow players to receive all rewards up to the Pass Level that the player has reached.
 - Players can purchase [Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket] to acquire additional Pass EXP equivalent to 1 Level. (Pass Level 1 Increase Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(5) Premium Pass Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/867f5eac31504e77b5a93d13ccb4cdf7b051cce6.png[/img]
 - Players can acquire additional Premium Pass Exclusive Rewards.
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can receive [Voidal Challenger] Monster Card. [Voidal Challenger] Monster Card: 31.50% Critical Damage / 0.43% Taint Resistance
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/e19358a73d42a3b6564ea8a9014410e0df4bfabd.png[/img]

Players can acquire [Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket], [Single Stat Change Support Box], [Berkas' Property Select Scroll] as exclusive rewards.
 - Players can acquire Another TYPE1 Coordi Outfit Select Box, Another TYPE1 Coordi Weapon Select Box, Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), Chaser Pass: Growing Hero's Title Box, and other various rewards.

notes.content:
Due to an extension in the maintenance, we will be compensating everyone who logs in during After Maintenance - March 13th 23:59 (UTC+0) with Compensation Chest 1 by mail.



Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
March 13th 04:00 - 08:30 (UTC+0)


[b]<Event>[/b]
1. Growth Support Event (March 13th After Maintenance - April 3rd Before Maintenance (UTC+0))

[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Growth Improvements
■ Improved the Difficulty of Normal Dungeons
Reduced the attack and HP of boss monsters in Normal Dungeons.
Reduced the hitbox of monsters in Normal Dungeon that knock down players or push players back.
Adjusted the hitbox of attacks from monsters to fit the visual effect.

■ Improved Void (Invasion) Dungeon
Improved the Voidal Devourer's breath pattern after flight. The position of the breath attack after flight (left or right) will depend on the direction of the wind.
Improved the fire zone pattern after Voidal Devourer drops the Void Sphere. Fire Zone will only occur on the 1st floor or 2nd and 3rd floor based on the signals and will have reduced duration.

■ Reduced the Craft Time Needed for True Iron Dragon
Increased the number of drops for Demon Core and Hero's Bullion from Hero Dungeons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f7e898a149d95881322d3ee4ed48840be5edf176.png[/img]

■ Phantom Phoenix Equipment Select Box and Iron Dragon Equipment Select Box
Phantom Phoenix and Iron Dragon Equipment will now be changed from random drops to select boxes.
Available Equipment will be adjusted from Rare Grade to Epic Grade.

■ Reduced the Daily Play Count for Another World Dungeon
Reduced the daily play count for 'Siege of Teroka' and 'Temple of Time' to 1 time. Rewards will increase for playing the dungeon and the daily fragment acquisition limit will be retained.
Increased the [Another World Entry Ticket] count for additional rewards have been increased to match the increase in rewards.
 - Siege of Teroka: 2 Tickets
 - Temple of Time: 3 Tickets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ef7b5451c5fd02595d3ec3968d14c2df3dc0fab0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/acbafe842007b07d2fb60aabd56e699cee13f091.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/409596df388af8c055bf1d8a820c25df948ab7fd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ecfeff6e303b24cc1a150821010bc58ae5c7c7ee.png[/img]

Players who have already met the conditions will receive all the guides, rewards, and missions upon their first login.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0e1fdcd5003486748377906b80ed790d2d990e95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/3016b9f7bca7660efee82a9ea4ee5cffad653bfc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7c668f1d021359f31446af31dba4fc0514a345da.png[/img]

Equipment with Monster Card and Reinforcement Stones equipped will no longer be used as crafting materials when upgrading in Hero's Bullion Shop.

notes.title: [Announcement] March 8th Developer's Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8d285c6f92a1f8f5429636761e50b40f84b46fc4.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

Is everyone enjoying the new character Kallia?
The dev team is preparing more exciting content for players in addition to the usual updates.
For more long-term projects, we will reveal them slowly over time as we near delivery. We will work hard to provide the best entertainment for players.

The following updates will be made during the maintenance on March 13th.

1. Improvements to Growth
We plan to improve the downside to growth so that new and returning players will have more ease with the game.
We will also have an ongoing Character Growth Support Event so that players can try out new characters and experience the improvements themselves.

■ Adjusted the Difficulty of Normal Dungeons
Improved the hitbox of tricky monsters and improved the difficulty of hard dungeons.

■ Reduced the Crafting Time for True Iron Dragon
Increased the drop quantity of Demon Core and Hero's Bullion in Hero Dungeon.
Phantom Phoenix and Iron Dragon Equipment will be changed from Random Drops to Select Boxes.

■ Reduced the Daily Quest Count for Another World Dungeon
The daily play count for 'Siege of Teroka' and 'Temple of Time' will be reduced down to 1. The rewards for play will be increased and fragment drop will be retained.

■ Added Crafting for Another World Boss Monster Card
Players can acquire the card fragments upon dismantling earrings and piercings. Players can craft Gaian Card and Belile Card with the fragments.

■ Added a Function: Rune Total Battle Power Comparison
Added a function so that players can compare the Total Battle Power between the runes equipped and runes in the inventory.

■ Added Safety Nets to Hero's Bullion Shop Equipment Upgrade
Upgraded Hero's Bullion Shop Upgrades so that players cannot use items with monster card and reinforcement stones equipped cannot be used as crafting materials.


2. Balance Adjustments

We'd like to thank everyone for their opinions regarding the balance adjustments. 
We will adjust the balance on a regular basis so that players can use all of their characters in various content without having any characters left behind.

■ Improved Command Attack
Increased the damage if certain characters had low damage compared to the difficulty level of control.
Improved the attack speed of commands if certain characters had slow attack speed.
Adjusted so that characters with same equal critical damage and double attack damage have the damage separated and adjusted to match that of other characters.

■ Improved Skills
Improved the skill of characters with no means to deal great damage to large monsters.
Reduced the delay for certain skills with long delay compared to other characters.
Improved the performance of skills with low damage compared to the duration of the skill.
Improved the hitbox of skills that had a smaller hitbox compared to the size of the effect.

We will strive to create the best experience possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
February 21st 05:00 - 07:50 (UTC+0)


[b]<Event>[/b]
1. Chaser Expedition Event
1) Chaser Expedition Attendance Log (February 21st After Maintenance - March 13th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/900eb85f02e2223fe153607296d48474c342dcb1.png[/img]
 - Players can log in daily for 30 minutes for 15 days to acquire Login Rewards.
 - Players can acquire Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket, Single Stat Change Scroll, Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll, GP Item Property Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, Special Reinforcement Release Scroll, and other various rewards.

2) Aernas Great Exploration (February 21st After Maintenance - April 3rd Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d08d588e5d39b207d55a85dd0230f48457d487b2.png[/img]
 - Players can devise expedition parties to explore various regions of Aernas.
 - There are a total of 10 regions and players can explore up to 3 regions at once.
 - Exploration will take 20 hours.

(1) Expedition Party
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/401e7d95d7d8517fb864f36914b63c373ec46793.png[/img]
 - Up to 4 characters can be put in 1 Expedition Party
 - Expedition Party will be created automatically based on character level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/cb6fa7c1baeeda81096dfd5887fda8108e369f10.png[/img]
 - Expedition Rank will be decided based on the sum of the levels of characters deployed in the Expedition Party and will give more rewards and more Exploration Progress the higher the rank.

(2) Exploration Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/3d6e066ecbfe1db80f93e82b327fb0dd54f2388e.png[/img]
 - Players can press [OK] or [Receive All] after 20 hours of exploring to receive rewards for Exploration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/fb7d43534de4ee60332bc512ddd3ff505fff046d.png[/img]
 - Players can receive higher grade rewards based on Rank.
 - Exploration Rewards will be sent by mail. Certain items for Exploration Reward cannot be moved to the warehouse. Please carefully choose the character to receive the Exploration Reward.

(3) Exploration Progress
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0b9be64ebd569b3ac0b5893d69fb2334295bda32.png[/img]
 - Upon receiving Exploration Reward, players will gain Exploration Progress based on Expedition Rank 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/129605f236105f06a365808de2ab30958c4a1c8d.png[/img]
 - Players will receive rewards for each region if they reach 100% Exploration Progress.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/80fb61fe594031b897c2fba81ff27b73337e7b95.png[/img]
 - Total Exploration Progress is the sum of Exploration Progress for all regions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/20dd298fe9a8c785e3dd73bb5bc467026f215335.png[/img]
 - Players will receive rewards for every 10% of Total Exploration Progress gained.

3) Chaser Expedition Weekly Chain Mission (February 21st After Maintenance - March 13th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
(1) Week 1 (February 21st After Maintenance - February 27th 23:59 (UTC+0))
 - Defeat 100 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: Dungeon Entry Ticket Box x2
 - Defeat 300 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: Chaser Coordi Fragment x50
 - Defeat 500 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: GP Item Property Scroll x1
(2) Week 2 (February 28th 00;00 - March 5th 23:59 (UTC+0))
 - Defeat 100 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: Dungeon Entry Ticket Box x2
 - Defeat 300 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: +30 Bag x1
 - Defeat 500 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: GP Item Property Scroll x1
(3) Week 3 (March 6th 00;00 - March 13th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
 - Defeat 100 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: Dungeon Entry Ticket Box x2
 - Defeat 300 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: Coordi Fusion Scroll x1
 - Defeat 500 Monsters at Appropriate Level Range: GP Item Property Scroll x1


[b]<Shop>[/b]
1. Spirit Guide Seal Breaker Coordi (February 21st After Maintenance - March 13th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/2ca20925a3438d0e75fed17ec94ecd7ce85a99ba.png[/img]


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Improved Pet Skills
 - Pet Skill can now be used without the Pet Skill Item.
(However, Awakening Skills will still require Pet Skill Items.)
 - Acquiring new pet will no longer provide basic Pet Skills.
 - All unnecessary Pet Skill items will be deleted.
 - All unused Pet Seal button will be removed.

2. Pet Balance
1) Dark Nightmare!
 - Adjusted the damage
2) Mori
 - Adjusted the damage
3) Canapy
 - Adjusted the attack range

3. Other Fixes
 - Fixed an error in tooltip for Ryan's 3rd Job Combo in Practice Mode
 - Fixed a bug in Overheat Gauge for Kallia in Practice Mode under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where Kallia could use Overheat Explosion while dungeon cutscene is in progress
 - Fixed a bug where Kallia's Wild Force Item had an icon error
 - Fixed a bug where Kallia's weapon did not have any appearance under certain circumstances
 - Changed so that Iron Dragon Box Item can only be crafted through the forge list
 - Changed Warrior Saint Cloak so that it can be dropped from dungeons
 - Fixed a bug where Emoticons would not go on display in chat under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where Event Icon Area in the top bar would have an abnormal display under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where Leona Pet Skill did not work as intended under certain circumstances
 - Fixed an error in tooltip for Harkion's Wings (Kallia) item for certain languages


[b]<List of Items to be Deleted>[/b]
1. List of Items to be Deleted during Maintenance on February 21st (UTC+0)

 - Epic Glyph Box
 - Relic Glyph Box
 - Brilliant Diamond Box
 - Ornate Gold Box
 - Gold Box
 - Silver Box
 - Copper Box


[b]<Banned Players Notice>[/b]
Number of players banned for using and/or promoting hack tools: 92 (Permanent Bans)

Lastly, we are preparing for a Balance Revamp.
We are looking into Community Feedback and in-game data to adjust the balance on characters.
Before we continue with the Balance Revamp, we'd like to hear from as many heroes as possible so that we can make the best improvements.
 - Survey Period: February 21st 00:00 - February 28th 23:59 (UTC+0)
 - Please check out the link below to give us opinions regarding the Balance Revamp.
 - We will make sure to go over all opinions to improve the Balance Revamp.
 - Link: https://forms.gle/2jfp93WTj2HwKbwv9

We'd like to thank everyone for the continued support of our game.
We will make sure to go over all opinions to create a better GrandChase Classic.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/56f495abe249a206b02f03638986f64b2f9ddcb8.png[/img]
1) Christmas Mood Change
 - Loading Image Logo will be changed in light of Christmas.
 - Entering the World will play Christmas Music.
 - World Map will start snowing. Spend a white Christmas with GrandChase!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b1477db34f963a58210f28a6d1fbbe7001cd6f52.png[/img]
 - Enjoy the Christmas Lobby filled with Carols!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/cf511e015ace60b700fb6caf3e61040cf6e6a353.png[/img]
2) Event Attendance Log
 - Players can acquire login rewards by logging in for 30 minutes daily for 15 days.
 - Players can acquire Little Elesis Card, Awesome Christmas Coordi Limited Time Select Box, Single Stat Change Scroll, Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll, GP Item Property Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16), Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15), Potion of Wills (50%), Premium GC Club, Advanced Rune Summon Chest, and other various rewards.
 - Little Elesis Card cannot be moved to the warehouse after acquisition. Please carefully select which character to receive the card.

3) Good Deeds Event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d1a812f63a3615f42a05d3de427d5bbbe9c71a52.png[/img]
 - Players can collect 3 Good Deeds Stamps to raise the [Good Deed Progress].
 - Good Deed Progress can be increased 5 times per day.
 - Players can [Make a Wish] every time they complete Good Deed 5 times.

(1) Collecting Good Deed Stamps
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a94b2f7ad8893ea52100101376e748606983d722.png[/img]
 - [Good Deed Stamp] can be acquired 15 times per day.
 - How to Acquire ①: Daily Repeat Quest
　　Clear Another World Dungeon 1 Time: Can acquire Good Deed Stamp x1
　　Clear Event Dungeon 1 Time: Can acquire Good Deed Stamp x1
　　Clear Harrier Dungeon 1 Time: Can acquire Good Deed Stamp x1
 - How to Acquire ②: Dungeon Clear Reward - Clear dungeons at appropriate level range to acquire up to 12 [Good Deed Stamp] at max.
　　Excluded Dungeons: The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, Wizard's Labyrinth, Berkas' Lair, Tower of Disappearance, Land of Judgment, Nightmare Circus, Monster Train 301, Hungry Pets' Revolt, Moonlight Village, Angry Bosses, Talin's Revenge, King Slime Dungeon, Trial Forest, Trial Tower, Void (Invasion), Void (Taint)
 - All leftover [Good Deed Stamp] can be exchanged for 1 Bonus Recharge at the forge.

(2) How to Raise Good Deed Progress
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/055f4846cca6c15249e960409d294e6a88b2662a.png[/img]
 - Players can receive Christmas Random Box by collecting Good Deed Stamp x3 to increase [Good Deed Progress].
   Good Deed Increase 1 Time: 1 Christmas Random Box
   Good Deed Increase 2 Times: 2 Christmas Random Boxes
   Good Deed Increase 3 Times: 3 Christmas Random Boxes
   Good Deed Increase 4 Times: 4 Christmas Random Boxes
   Good Deed Increase 5 Times: 5 Christmas Random Boxes
 - Players can acquire 1 of the contents of [Christmas Random Box] at set rates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f5e67805b62204d6a871900a27503f7c575893d7.png[/img]
 - [Christmas Random Box] Contents (Acquire 1):
   Christmas Cookie Box x1, Harrier Monster Card Box x3, Another World Monster Card Box x3, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x3, Bonus Recharge x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a26e9c3eaf228e6a90ab536e8ca5079d294f4b73.png[/img]
 - [Christmas Cookie Box] contains Christmas Butter Cookie x3 and Christmas Chocolate Cookie x3.

(3) Make a Wish
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/33c8668c0fd371bd7e9cd46754c6db5a7db47de3.png[/img]
 - Players can progress with [Make a Wish] once they increase Good Deeds 5 times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5476623c2b349ab83e34b90fa3acfd89d803598e.png[/img]
 - Players can press [Receive Gift] button that activates 12 hours after pressing [Make a Wish] to receive rewards by mail.
 - Receiving rewards from [Make a Wish] will reset the Good Deed Progress gauge.
 - Players will receive rewards based on the number of [Make a Wish] they have completed.
 -All [Make a Wish] rewards in progress and unclaimed [Receive Gift] will terminate during maintenance on January 10th (UTC+0). Please make sure to receive all rewards before the maintenance begins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/e206578d3a103cfae266dcb58389f138b3f19d28.png[/img]

2. Holiday Battle Power Event (December 20th After Maintenance - January 10th Before Maintenance)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1a2690c5b7511d48b1846d9f6c9db32c975d0132.png[/img]

 - Players can receive rewards every time they reach a set battle power level.
 - Upon reaching certain battle power, players can receive Single Stat Change Support Box, Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket, Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), Reinforcement Protection Scroll, GP Item Property Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, Monster Card Box, and other various rewards by rank.
 - Once a player makes a selection, they cannot cancel or change their selection. Players must make their selection carefully.

 - Once a player has made selections, players can only see the Event Menu in the World Map when they log into participating characters.

[b]<Shop Items>[/b]
1. Snow Cantabile Seal Breaker Coordi (December 20th After Maintenance - January 10th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f1a4d729ce12986a8d8bdbe4f730114e3d948012.png[/img]

2. Christmas Coordi Item Sale (December 20th After Maintenance - January 10th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5b694f3cc9e4099eb0ca5a18b13232cad338a451.png[/img]
 - Awesome Christmas Coordi Package
 - Happy Christmas Coordi Package
 - Happy Christmas Coordi Individual Items
 - Mittens Card

3. Merry New Year Package on Sale (December 20th After Maintenance - January 10th Before Maintenance (UTC+0))
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1573f8d92d03ac822aa86b57feb1dbd56208ce0d.png[/img]
1) Merry New Year Summon Package (Can be purchased up to 3 times during the sale period)
 - Seal Breaker Scroll x150
 - Advanced Rune Summon Chest x10

2) Merry New Year Property Package (Can be purchased up to 3 times during the sale period)
 - Single Property Scroll (Lv.85) x2
 - GP Item Property Scroll x30

3) Merry New Year Reinforcement Package (Can be purchased up to 3 times during the sale period)
 - Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15) x30
 - Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16) x20
 - Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+17) x20

4) Merry New Year Void Package (Can be purchased up to 3 times during the sale period)
 - Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket x1
 - Single Stat Change Scroll x10
 - Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll x10


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Improved Harrier Dungeon
 - Monster difficulty for World Harrier will be improved to provide a better gameplay experience.

<Battle Gameplay>
The contents below will be improved
 - Adjusted the damage for attacks with abnormally high damage output
 - Reduced the hitbox for the frequent knockdowns that harm the gameplay experience
 - Improved attacks that don't line up with the monster's motion
 - Improved attacks that don't match the visual effects
 - Adjusted the projectiles that are too well guided and have a long duration
 - Reduced the collision hitbox for monsters that players cannot jump over
 - Removed the Frost property from Champion monsters

<Monster Level>
 - Adjusted all Monster Levels to 85.

<Taint Resistance>
Reduced the Taint Resistance stat requirement for each dungeon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ac2111c2dfea0bcf8efabe4280d3fd2da64c3e86.png[/img]

<Reward>
Changed so that 3 [Harrier Guardian Chest] drops upon clearing the dungeon instead of 1 dropping from a random monster in Harrier Dungeon.

2. Improved Item Tooltip
 - With the release of items at higher grade, players have a harder time seeing the information they want in a glance. Also, the tooltip began to cover up the buttons, harming the gameplay. Item tooltip has been improved to address these issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/6c6396b1f2d16741a508393e8eb842054d248bc9.png[/img]
 - Tooltip will have item image on display.
 - Font Size and Color will be adjusted so that important information is more visible.
 - Set Effect will be set to hidden as the default setting.
 - Pressing the Alt button will display the Set Effect Tooltip while the key is pressed.

3. Improved Title Acquisition Notification
 - If a player acquired a Title through dungeon drops, it will be displayed in the loot window.
 - A red dot will be marked in the collection menu upon acquiring the Title.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Completed) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates.


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
November 29th 04:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a89f629da2dd821193a4b798b142e46900c92959.png[/img]
1. New Raid 'Void (Taint)' (November 29th After Maintenance - ) (UTC+0)
"Stop the taint and uproot the void from this world"

The GrandChase has managed to defeat the Voidal Devourer that has taken the shape of a powerful being.
However, the Voidal Devourer has taken a new form to once again threaten Aernas.

As it splits into countless particles, chaos consumes Aernas.
In order to save the world, GrandChase begins a fierce struggle.

However, this was all a trap as amidst all the chaos…
The Void had enough time to root itself into the world…

The Void now goes beyond taking shape…
And now started to seep into Aernas.
The GrandChase now must struggle to fight back.

The apocalypse has begun.
The restless advance of Taint… And the pinch the GrandChase are pitted into…

The battle begins once again wth fate of the Aernas on the scale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a17060df93f694825d2d6a9defd98b38d502984b.png[/img]
1) Entry Requirement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/016ae60a664b43215aec831692cc1b828308a5f1.png[/img]
 - Characters at Lv. 85 SS+ (200K↑) or higher Battle Power can enter.
 - Players can play 3 times per week. Players may enter and clear past the clear limit, but will not receive any rewards.
 - Players can receive additional clear rewards by using [Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket]. 1 Weekly clear count will be consumed upon clearing.
 - Void (Taint) Weekly Clear Count will reset every Wednesday.

2) Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/403e5b2c091dccacaaca028129ef076865932e4f.png[/img]
(1) [Voidal Gazer Equipment] added
 - Lv.85 Ancient Grade Equipment [Voidal Gazer Helm], [Voidal Gazer Upper Armor], and [Voidal Gazer Lower Armor] will be added.
 - Players can acquire [Voidal Gazer Helm Select Box], [Voidal Gazer Upper Armor Select Box], and [Voidal Gazer Lower Armor Select Box] on a low chance upon defeating Voidal Gazer.
 - Players can upgrade [Voidal Fragment of Taint] and [True Iron Dragon Equipment] to craft [Voidal Gazer Helm Select Box], [Voidal Gazer Upper Armor Select Box], or [Voidal Gazer Lower Armor Select Box].
 - [Voidal Fragment of Taint] can be acquired as reward from Void (Taint) Dungeon Reward. Players can collect [Piece of Voidal Fragment of Taint] to upgrade at Hero's Bullion Shop.
As the player clears higher stages of Voidal (Taint) Dungeon, players will receive more rewards and acquire [Voidal Gazer Equipment] at a faster rate.

(2) Single Stat Change Scroll
 - [Single Stat Change Scroll (Weapon)]'s item name will be chagned to [Single Stat Change Scroll] and will have its tooltip changed.
 - Players can use [Single Stat Change Scroll] to change the stats of a property of an Ancient Grade Equipment without changing the property.
 - [Single Stat Change Scroll Box (Weapon)]'s item name will be chagned to [Single Stat Change Scroll Box] and will have its tooltip changed.
 - Players will also receive [Single Stat Change Scroll] or [Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll] from clearing Void (Taint) Dungeon on a set chance.

(3) Void Equipment Set Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/649a759b98d251329624929c241ef83a608c002d.png[/img]
 - Players who equip [Voidal Devourer Weapon] and [Voidal Gazer Equipment] will have [Void Defier] set effect.

(4) Title and Monster Card
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/cfd9e459c6547bffa577dad872279d0b672e4fb1.png[/img]
 - Apocalypse of World (Title)
 - Voidal Sentry (Monster Card)
 - Voidal Crusher (Monster Card)
 - Voidal Executor (Monster Card)
 - Voidal Gazer (Monster Card)
Upon clearing Void (Taint), players will receive the above items.
 - [Apocalypse of World] Title can be upgraded by using [Voidal Fragment of Taint] in Hero's Bullion Shop.

(5) Other Clear Rewards
 - Upon clearing Void (Taint) Dungeon, players will receive [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+17)] on a set chance.
 - Players can acquire [Advanced Rune Summon Chest] and [Twisted Void Box] from clearing Void (Taint) Dungeon Stages.
[Twisted Void Box] contains Lisnar's Prayer, Another World Monster Card Box, and other various items.
 - Weekly Repeat Mission '[Hero Dungeon] Defeat Voidal Gazer 1 3 Times' will be added.
Players can acquire [Single Stat Change Scroll] x1 as mission clear reward.

※ 'Void (Taint)' Raid Dungeon will not be affected by the dungeon drop rate increase buff.

3) 'Void' Raid Changes
 - 'Void' Dungeon Name will be changed to 'Void (Invasion)'.
 - [Voidal Fragment of Death] and [Piece of Voidal Fragment of Death] item name will be changed to [Voidal Fragment of Invasion] and [Piece of Voidal Fragment of Invasion] and will have the tooltip changed.
 - Changed the icon for [Voidal Devourer Weapon Select Box].
 - Voidal Devourer will no longer drop runes. Instead, players will be able to acquire [Advanced Rune Summon Chest] and [Twisted Void Box] upon clearing each stage of Void (Invasion).
 - Players can now upgrade [Origin of Chaos] Title by collecting [Voidal Fragments of Invasion] in Hero's Bullion Shop.

4) Added Hidden Stage to Raid
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/999cdd9229f59de711a4713cda9064352988edef.png[/img]
(1) Hidden Stage
 - Hidden Stage will be added to Void (Invasion) and Void (Taint).
Players can enter Hidden Stage by meeting the requirements during the dungeon play.
 - Players will not be able to use recovery or resurrection items other than Lisnar's Prayer in the Hidden Stage. Each player can use Lisnar's Prayer at max 1 time.
 - Players will receive additional rewards for clearing the Hidden Stage. Players will receive [True-Voidal Fragment of Invasion] in Void (Invasion) and will receive [True-Voidal Fragment of Taint] in Void (Taint).

(2) Special Title
 - Ancient Grade Titles [(True) Origin of Chaos] and [(True) Apocalypse of World] will be added.
 - [(True) Origin of Chaos] Title can be upgraded in Hero's Bullion Shop using [Origin of Chaos] and [True-Voidal Fragment of Invasion].
 - [(True) Apocalypse of World] Title can be upgraded in Hero's Bullion Shop using [Apocalypse of World] and [True-Voidal Fragment of Taint].

 - Players can acquire Login Rewards every day for logging in for 30 minutes for 15 days.
 - Players can acquire Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket, Single Stat Change Scroll, GP Item Property Scroll, Coordi Fusion Scroll, Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16), Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15), Hero Dungeon Entry Ticket, Event Dungeon Festival Entry Ticket, Premium GC Club, Advanced Rune Summon Chest, and other various rewards.

   Coordi Fusion Scroll x1, Another World Monster Card Box x1, Archimedia Monster Card Box x1, Premium GC Club x1, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x1, Natal Ring x1, Mystery Potion (L) x1, Bonus Recharge x1
 - Excluded Dungeons: The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, Wizard of Labyrinth, Berkas' Lair, Tower of Disappearance, Land of Judgment, Nightmare Circus, Monster Train 301, Hungry Pets' Revolt, Moonlight Village, Angry Bosses, Talin's Revenge, King Slime Land, Dimension Door, Trial Forest, Trial Tower, Outer Wall of Serdin, Kerrie Beach, Orc Temple, Gorgos' Dungeon, Elven Forest, Gorge of Oath, Marsh of Oblivion, Forsaken Barrows, Forgotten City, Gaikoz's Castle, Whispering Woods, Ruins of the Silver Knights, Lake Aurora, King Guang's Fen, Primeval Island, King Fang's Lair, Victor's Fortress, Void, Frostland Region, Trivia Region

3. Challenge the Void Event (November 29th After Maintenance - December 20th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/00c7f2b29e4949becd20664ff4d2a8d213d7eb55.png[/img]
 - Clear Week 1, Week 2, Week 3 missions to receive weekly rewards.
 - Players can clear 5 missions per week totalling up to 15 missions per week.
 - Weekly Reset will be on every Wednesday at 09:00 (UTC+0).
 - Weekly Missions are not Chain Missions.
 - Players can check this in the Event Mission Tab in the Mission Page.
 - Upon clearing weekly missions, players can acquire Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+17), Single Stat Change Scroll, Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll, Socket Gem Box, Reinforcement Support Box, Property Support Box, and Advanced Rune Summon Chest.


[b]<Shop Items>[/b]
1. Star's Whisper Seal Breaker Coordi (November 29th After Maintenance - December 20th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/e03625b25d4d7d7de6bc5d984d97964e6a9a1560.png[/img]


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Ancient Epic Reinforcement Property will be added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/bf4829913b6263870b598f98af43fa2704dcde3b.png[/img]
 - When Epic Reinforcement Stone is equipped to Ancient Grade Helm, Upper Armor, or Lower Armor, an exclusive Reinforcement Property will be applied.

2. Hero's Bullion Shop Upgrade will be Improved
 - Improved so that players can Upgrade All by setting up quantities.
Players can only upgrade 1 time when using Equipment Item as materials or when the resulting item is equipment, Coordi, or title.
 - Improved so that resulting item quantity will be added and is improved to display based on the set quantity.
 - Improved the pop-up window text for non-equipment upgrades.

3. Pet Balance
1) Keter
 - Fixed the motion before attack
 - Adjusted the damage and stun duration

4. Other Fixes
 - Changed so that certain monster cards don't take up inventory space
 - Fixed a bug where Kaze'aze sometimes did not disappear in certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where friends that have been just added will appear to be offline
 - Fixed a bug where friends that have been just added will have their location fixed to World Map
 - Fixed a bug where players will start the game with a small loss in HP under certain circumstances

notes.title: [Announcement] November 29th Raid Dungeon Part 2: 'Void (Taint)' Preview
notes.content:
Hello Heroes of Bermesiah,

The developers are busy preparing the new raid dungeon, winter contents, and improvements.
Today, we will be going over the raid dungeon Part 2


[u][b]■ Entry Requirement and Clear Count Reset Date[/b][/u]
Only characters at Level 85 SS+ (200K↑) Battle Power can enter.
Void (Taint)' Dungeon Clear Count will reset every Wednesday.

[u][b]■ New Ancient Rank Equipment and Set Effect[/b][/u]
Lv.85 Ancient Rank Equipment [Voidal Gazer Helm], [Voidal Gazer Upper Armor], and [Voidal Gazer Lower Armor] will be added.
Players can acquire [Voidal Gazer Helm Select Box], [Voidal Gazer Upper Armor Select Box], [Voidal Gazer Lower Armor Select Box] at a very low chance upon defeating the last monster.
Players can use [Voidal Fragment of Taint] and [True Iron Dragon Equipment] to upgrade into [Voidal Gazer Helm Select Box], [Voidal Gazer Upper Armor Select Box], or [Voidal Gazer Lower Armor Select Box] in Hero's Bullion Shop.
Players that equip [Voidal Devourer Weapon] and [Voidal Gazer Equipment] will receive [Void Defier] Set Effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/16a448ef3e12fc35dfc350cc307ab7cd52e5a6f2.png[/img]

[u][b]■ Dungeon Reward[/b][/u]
Players can acquire Monster Card for the monsters of Void and Raid Exclusive Titles on a set chance.
For every stage in Void (Taint) cleared, players can acquire [Advanced Rune Summon Chest] and [Twisted Void Box].
[Twisted Void Box] contains Lisnar's Prayer, Another World Monster Card Box, and other various rewards.

[u][b]■ Dungeon Overview[/b][/u]
From the previous Developer's Notes, we have outlined that our development goal is to strengthen the emphasis on mechanics and increase the sources of currency and materials to upgrade equipment.
- [Announcement] October 27th Developer's Notes: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/985810/view/3716092146805566535?l 

We will share the changes we have made in light of our purpose and goal.

[u][b]□ Cooperation and Mechanics[/b][/u]
The Voidal Devourer, defeated in Void Part 1 will take a new form and return in Void (Taint) Part 2.
In the first stage, players will battle against numerous Void monsters. Players will have to defeat specific Void monsters to clear.
In the second stage, players will battle against Voidal Gazers and their cronies, the Voidal Executors. Players must cooperate to prevent them from executing a powerful AOE attack.
A minimap system like that in Berkas' Lair and Hungry Pets' Revolt will be implemented so that players will be able to know the location of other players and other monsters.
In order to support quick communication, a new system will be implemented to allow players to bind chats to their hotkeys. We will see how this goes to see if this would be good to be implemented as part of a basic system.

[u][b]□ Added More Sources of Currency and Materials to Upgrade Equipment[/b][/u]
Players can acquire [Single Stat Change Scroll] on a 100% chance through the weekly mission to complete Part 2 'Void (Taint)'.
In this update, players will be able to acquire equipment and related scrolls through login and weekly missions through various events. We look forward to your participation.
More sources such as events and contents will be added to allow players to strengthen their Void equipment without using monetary currency.
[Single Stat Change Scroll (Weapon)] will be combined to a global scroll. If scrolls were divided into exclusive slots, it would make them very difficult to farm. We have adjusted the names of the scrolls so that 1 global scroll can be used.

[u][b]□ Higher Difficulty Hidden Stage and Higher Title Rewards[/b][/u]
If players clear Phase 3 within a certain time limit, the boss gate will appear. Upon destroying the boss gate within 10 seconds, they can enter the hidden stage.
Players cannot use potions or resurrect in Hidden Stage. If characters die, the game will end with the previous stage as progression.
Upon clearing the Hidden Stage, players will receive materials for True Title on a 100% chance. Players may combine with the materials in their possession to create a True Title.
True Title has higher stats compared to the Void Raid Title. It will be an honorable Title for completing a Feat of Strength.

[u][b]□ Other Changes[/b][/u]
Players can craft Voidal Fragment for Void (Taint) Dungeon using the current Voidal Fragment x3. If players have excess Voidal Fragments after getting their Void Weapons, players may be able to craft [Voidal Gazer Equipment] faster.
Players can also craft [Origin of Chaos] Title using Voidal Fragment x50. If players have already crafted the Void Weapon, they can craft to acquire the Title.
A new function will be added to allow players to upgrade in mass by setting the quantity so that players can easily upgrade crafting materials.
An exclusive upgrade property will be added  for equipping Epic Reinforcement Stone to Ancient Rank Helm, Upper Armor, and Lower Armor.

We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/fa097c27829fa62683b44c418ae83a08ad1ad877.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ce6625b260f322d3206319f3fdadca201456208c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d08b0f65f588c95c91776470b0153f15ee5d90a0.png[/img]
