 - Sale by Character


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Improved Event/Hero Dungeon
1) Hero Dungeon Shared Changes
 - Changed so that Hero Dungeon Box and Hero's Bullion Item can be crafted in the Upgrade Tab of Hero's Bullion Shop

2) Wizard's Labyrinth
 - Improved so that players can select the stage they want to move upon entry or inside the room.
 - Removed the Hard difficulty and allowed players to play the stage of their choice upon clearing Normal Stage 30.

3) Tower of Disappearance
 - A door will appear after clearing the 5th Stage of Tower of Disappearance. A 10-second countdown will begin.
 - The player may continue on to the next stage if they destroy the door within the countdown.
 - If the countdown ends or if the party leader presses ESC to end the countdown, the dungeon will end. (Upon ending, the dungeon will be marked as failed.)

4) Land of Judgment
 - Changed so that contribution points for Land of Judgment will only be reflected 1 time with the highest point.
 - Removed the daily entry limit on Land of Judgment
 - Compressed the contribution point and changed the loot table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/af74070fc64eacf17f6b5e7c639f9363a8c04791.jpg[/img]
 - Improved so that pressing ESC to end out of Land of Judgment will immediately apply the current contributions. (Dungeon will be marked as failed.)
 - Changed so that entry limit will not be applied for 5 minutes if the player immediately entered Land of Judgment again after playing it.
 - Changed Land of Judgment Card Box and Land of Judgment Special Card Box contents to drop Archimedia, Another World, and Harrier Cards.
 - Players can craft additional Land of Judgment Special Card Box by gathering Land of Judgment Shards.
 - Changed so that players can craft Land of Judgment Rewards in Upgrade Tab of the Hero's Bullion Shop.
 - Changed the tooltip of Land of Judgment Shards, Harkion's Earring Shards, Harkion's Ring Shards, and Harkion's Essence.

5) Event Dungeon Shared Changes
 - Target Event Dungeons: Nightmare Circus, Monster Train 301, Hungry Pets' Revolt, Moonlight Village, Angry Bosses, Talin's Revenge, King Slime Dungeon
 - Changed so that Crystal, Potion, Orbs by Continent, Monster Cards except Archimedia will not drop.
 - Upon clearing the dungeon, players can acquire Event Dungeon Festival Coin. (1 per clear)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/644cea53a08e2c2b1e33a149b25cebb2302dbb72.png[/img]
 - Players can craft various items with Event Dungeon Festival Coins.
 - Players can acquire various materials for reinforcement in Talin's Reinforcement Box.
 - Players can acquire 1 of the cards from Archimedia, Harrier, or Another World.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/794b94c27a1147f81aeba30b6ddfa2f6e7bc1a9e.png[/img]
 - Upon clearing all event dungeons, players can now acquire GP Item Property Scroll on a chance. Acquisition chance may differ based on dungeon difficulty.
 - Changed the Event Dungeon Festival Ticket to be able to be moved through the warehouse.

6) Nightmare Circus
 - Monster Stats and Patterns will be adjusted.
 - Changed so that character stat adjustments are not applied
 - Changed so that players cannot craft or acquire Nightmare Circus Outfit and Accessory Box of all levels
 - Nightmare Circus Outfit/Accessory Box Coupon will be changed to Nightmare Circus Outfit/Accessory Craft Coupon. The tooltip will change to reflect crafting.
 - 11 Nightmare Circus Coordi Parts will be added to crafting list. (Helm, Upper Armor, Lower Armor, Gloves, Shoes, Cloak, Upper Head Ornament, Upper Armor Ornament, Lower Armor Ornament, Arm Ornament, Lower Head Ornament)
 - Players can craft Nightmare Circus Outfit Coordi using Nightmare Circus Outfit/Accessory Craft Coupon.
 - Changed so that GP Item Property Scroll can be acquired from clearing all event dungeons. Deranged Ringmaster will no longer drop GP Item Property Scroll.
 - Nightmare Circus Coordi is an Epic Grade Coordi and will have its exclusive set effect with Season 1 stats
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b603df0fe919d9b3445cbeb0dca3bb84ee81bfa1.png[/img]

7) Monster Train 301
 - Players can only play on Normal Difficulty and will have monster stats and patterns adjusted.
 - Changed so that character stat adjustments are not applied
 - Changed so that players cannot craft or acquire Attendant's Outfit and Accessory Box of all levels
 - Changed the tooltip of Attendant's Outfit and Accessory Box to reflect crafting.
 - 11 Attendant's Coordi Parts will be added to crafting list. (Helm, Upper Armor, Lower Armor, Gloves, Shoes, Cloak, Upper Head Ornament, Upper Armor Ornament, Lower Armor Ornament, Arm Ornament, Lower Head Ornament)
 - Players can craft Attendant's Outfit Coordi using Attendant's Outfit/Accessory Craft Coupon.
 - Attendant's Outfit Coordi is an Epic Grade Coordi and will have its exclusive set effect with Season 1 stats
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7de503e2051b41bcb896c88642a28367b04e57bb.png[/img]

8) Moonlight Village
 - Players can only play on Normal Difficulty and will have stage order, monster stats and patterns adjusted.
 - Changed so that character stat adjustments are not applied
 - Changed so that Fox Marble Fragment, Moonlight Village Ring, Moonlight Village Earring, Moonlight Village Mask Box will no longer be acquired.
 - Changed so that Darkstone and Rune will be dropped as reward.
 - Players can acquire Advanced Rune Summon Chest on a chance upon clearing the dungeon.

9) Talin's Revenge
 - Reduced monster HP and changed the number of monsters and wave patterns.
 - Changed so that pressing the attack key (Z key by default) will allow continuous attack while on Valkyrie
 - Changed so that pressing the special key (C key by default) will allow charged attack while on Valkyrie
 - Added a text tooltip that guides a player on key maneuvers at start of dungeon (key settings in the tooltip will be the default key settings)

10) King Slime Dungeon
 - Monster Stats and Patterns will be adjusted.
 - Changed so that character stat adjustments are not applied

2. Pet Balance
1) Cordelia
 - Increased the damage and attack radius
 - Added a powerful stun

2) Tricky
 - Increased the damage

3. Other fixes
 - Fixed a bug where Asin would have an abnormal appearance when Roman Upper Armor is equipped
 - Fixed a bug where an unnecessary pop-up window would appear when Gorge of Oath is cleared for the first time
 - Improved character acquisition window
 - Fixed a bug where players could create a character already in possession
 - Fixed a bug where unnecessary level display would sometimes be on an equipment item slot 
 - Fixed a bug where craft list would be missing some items under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where in-game name creation window and background would not match
 - Fixed a bug where using Blocking would sometimes cause the target's attack to not be applied
 - Fixed a bug where a wrong Loading Image goes on display upon entering Event Dungeon Monster Train 301
 - Fixed a bug where pets don't have equal stats at equal levels
 - Fixed the tooltip of Chase Point pop-up window for certain languages


[b]<Items to be Deleted>[/b]

 - Magical Pumpkin Box
 - Halloween Day Coordi (21 Days) Select Box
 - Lucky Halloween Pumpkin Necklace Select Box

Number of players banned for using and/or promoting hack tools: 109 (Permanent Bans)


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Announcement] September 27th Balance Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f2cb1ef247fcc309e49842eb74e639cc85056f2d.png[/img]

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

   We'd like to thank everyone who has provided us with their opinions through the survey and other methods.
Please do understand that we cannot reflect all the requests that players have given us.
We have prioritized the first balance changes to be brought on September 27th.
Please see the below improvements and provide us with your opinion about the oncoming changes. We will review your feedback in regards to the balance changes.

1. Adjusted the performance of skills that were affected by Monster size.
   We have adjusted certain characters that benefited too much from this mechanics, but we took extra care to not to reduce their damage by too much.
   For characters who don't have a skill set that benefits from this issue, we have raised the value of other skills to make up for the loss.
2. We will also reduce the skill cooldown for AP characters in dungeons to improve their usage in major dungeons since they cannot use skill charging.
3. Edel and Veigas will receive Job Stat skill added since they are considered lacking from not possessing any additional jobs.
   We will not just end with the addition of stats to both characters. We are reviewing changes with the assumption that skill and job change will be added in the future.
4. We are not only going to adjust the damage, but also the bug fixes and improvements to existing characters for better gameplay.

   We resonate with the players' request that balance needs consistent management and improvement. We will continue to monitor and improve the balance content for not just the ones adjusted on the first batch, but also those that were not included in the current balance adjustment.
We plan to create an environment where every characters that players have put time and effort into will have their uses.

[b]<Balance Update Preview>[/b]
We thank everyone who participated in the Balance Survey.

We plan to have a balance update on September 27, 2023. We will go over the survey results and Void Raid statistics with dungeon play to go forward with balancing.
Since many players are curious about the direction that we're headed, we'd like to disclose some of the goals we have in regards to balance.

After checking the overall dungeon data, we realized that AP Characters have a very low clear rate and use rate compared to other characters.
For AP Characters, even though they had greater MP regeneration, they could not spam skills unlike MP or Hybrid characters due to their cooldown.
Taking this in consideration, we will be reducing the overall skill cooldown across the AP characters.

We have also taken note that players preferred characters with good AOE skills.
We suspect that this is so that the players could deal great damage to big monsters while also damaging the little monsters that are spread out.
The Void Raid added recently also has a big monster, which allows players to deal great damage using the AOE skill.
Although such mechanics are somewhat intended, we have decided that it hampers the balance between the characters and will make adjustments to it.
We plan on a possible change in the basic system of the skill damage structure.
We are also planning on buffing the characters who do not have such skill mechanisms so that they deal better damage against these bosses.

We are also going over these improvements.
1. Adding Job Change Stats to Edel and Veigas
2. Fixing the bug on the discrepancy between Rufus' Skill Tree Requirement Level and Skill Level Available
3. Other Bug Fixes

We hope to see a variety of characters in the contents through the balance adjustment.
We will continue to monitor and adjust the balance so that characters that players raised with love finds their use in various contents.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

[b]<Contents>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/714c97635ff666581b16957a52c1d2738303ebcd.png[/img]
1. New Raid 'Void' (August 16th Maintenance - ) (UTC+0)
"Save Aernas from getting consumed by the Void"

The GrandChase have barely emerged victorious against the Great Berkas.
However, with the fall of Berkas, the balance of powers began to quickly spiral out of control.
And through that small crack in the dimensions, darkness begins to seep into Aernas…

It is the 'Void'… A devourer born from chaos.
A being of everything and nothing…
An existence that is everywhere and nowhere.

The Void Devourer, firstborn of the Void Creatures
have taken up his first form upon seeing the fallen remains of Berkas.

The powers of the great corpus of a Dragon and the void have never before existed in Aernas.
Now the Void Invaders run rampant, slowly taking over Aernas.

Even though a small crack can crumble order down,
order can still be found amidst the depths of chaos.

The alpha of chaos… And the omega of order…
Will GrandChase save Aernas from the encroaching Void and restore order to the world?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/239ed28b8341aa1ce0c64bf5e7bf260196da180f.png[/img]
1) Entry Requirement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/27386edcf348f5693b2c7311fe364c41c022d4fa.png[/img]
 - Players at Level 85 and Battle Power at SS+ (200K↑) or higher may enter.
 - Players can enter Void 3 times per week. Players may enter more than 3 times to clear, but will not receive any rewards.
 - Players can use [Raid Dungeon Entry Ticket] to consume weekly clear count and receive rewards.
Tickets will be provided to players via future events and systems to be implemented.

2) Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b4a6c56271e007a59cde6afbc59aab6f50b8289a.png[/img]
 (1) [Voidal Devourer Weapon]
 - [Voidal Devourer Weapon] is a Level 85 Ancient Grade item.
 - Players can acquire [Voidal Devourer Weapon] on a low chance from defeating Voidal Devourer on Stage 2 or higher.
 - Players can also collect [Voidal Fragment of Death] to craft [Voidal Devourer Weapon Select Box] in Hero's Bullion Shop.
 - [Voidal Fragment of Death] can be acquired from Voidal Devourer or can be crafted in Hero's Bullion Shop through [Pieces of Voidal Fragment of Death].
   If the player clears higher stages of Voidal Devourer, the player will receive better rewards and will craft weapons at a faster rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d42964abdb803efa28494a89a663f1c706fcde37.png[/img]
 (2) New Ancient Grade Equipment
 - Ancient Grade Equipment possesses 4 Monster Card Sockets and 5 Stat Properties. It also has better stats than Legendary Grade Equipment.
 - Ancient Grade Equipment can now have 5 more types of properties compared to before (Taint Resistance, Back Attack Damage, EXP Gain Increase, Hell Spear Chance Increase, Hell Spear Damage Increase)
 - Ancient Grade will have its stats determined when it first has its properties applied. Afterwards, the stats will be reassigned when [GP Item Property Scroll] or [Single Property Scroll] is used to reapply the property.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/63d84027bd7683b9c93e7b41f10a78a5cc65d862.png[/img]
 (3) Ancient Grade Weapon Exclusive Property Scroll
 - [Single Stat Change Scroll (Weapon)] and [Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll] will be added.
 - Players can change the stat without changing the property with [Single Stat Change Scroll (Weapon)]. [Single Stat Change Scroll (Weapon)] can be acquired from [Void] Raid or can be purchased from Shop.
 - [Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll] can be used along with [Single Stat Change Scroll (Weapon)] to prevent the stat from getting lowered.
 - [Single Stat Drop Protection Scroll] can only be acquired by purchasing from the Shop at the moment, but will become available through future events and other various contents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/37271044654820218e7ee2bd0303e34ba906ad17.png[/img]
 (4) Title and Monster Card
 - Start of Chaos (Title)
 - Voidal Devourer 1 (Monster Card)
 - Voidal Devourer 2 (Monster Card)
 - Voidal Devourer 3 (Monster Card)
 - Voidal Invader (Monster Card)
These items will be available.

(5) T2 ~ T5 Runes

※ Drop Rate Increase Buff will not apply to 'Void' Raid dungeon.

1. Defeat the Void Event (August 16th After Maintenance - September 6th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)

1) Event Attendance Log

 - Players can receive Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15), Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16), 1,000,000 GP Coupon, Premium GC Club, Advanced Rune Summon Chest, Blacksmith's Protection, Ring of Beefiness, and other various rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/33f9a86303397dcb5639a7a27a16e35c4ab691e3.png[/img]
2) Event Mission
 - Players can collect [Mini Voidal Invader Loot Box] from clearing Daily Repeat Missions.
 - Event Daily Mission: Defeat Mini Voidal Invader 10 Times to receive 10 [Mini Voidal Invader Loot Box].
 - Players can repeat the Daily Mission up to 3 times.

 - Excluded Dungeons: The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, Wizard's Labyrinth, Berkas' Lair, Tower of Disappearance, Land of Judgment, Nightmare Circus, Monster Train 301, Hungry Pets' Revolt, Moonlight Village, Angry Bosses, Talin's Revenge, King Slime Dungeon, Dimensional Portal, Trial Forest, Trial Tower, Outer Wall of Serdin, Kerrie Beach, Orc Temple, Gorgos' Dungeon, Elven Forest, Gorge of Oath, Marsh of Oblivion, Forsaken Barrows, Forgotten City, Gaikoz's Castle, Whispering Woods, Silver Knights' Headquarters, Lake Aurora, King Guang’s Fen, Primeval Island, King Fang's Lair, Victor's Fortress, Frostland Region, and Trivia Region

 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15)] x5/x10/x20 Package

 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+17)]


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]

1. Reinforcement Changes
With the addition of a new equipment grade, we'd like to adjust the reinforcement upgrades so that mistakes are reduced when players attempt to reinforce new set of equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/dcea074d4a1e7f40bdea7abea8518d8827e94e11.png[/img]
1) Ancient Equipment Reinforcement
 - Only Epic Reinforcement Stones can be equipped to Ancient Grade Equipment. Epic Reinforcement Stones can be reinforced to +18.
 - +18 Epic Reinforcement Stone cannot be transmuted and can only be equipped to Ancient Grade Equipment.
 - Equipment with +17 Epic Reinforcement Stones can no longer be transmuted.
 - Once +18 is reached, 1 new Reinforcement Property with fixed stats will be added. (Increased Critical Damage)
 - The new Reinforcement Property will be maintained even after unequipping and re-equipping the Epic Reinforcement Stone.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d7034b3b06365f4afc136270bcbea421c83fd037.png[/img]
2) Added New Reinforcement Protection Scrolls
 - New 3 Reinforcement Protection Scrolls will be added, allowing the players to use the scrolls by each stage.
 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15)]: A scroll that protects the drop, reset, or break of a Reinforcement Stone at +0~+15 (Can be used when attempting +1~+16 Reinforcement)
 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16)]: A scroll that protects the drop, reset, or break of a Reinforcement Stone at +16 (Can be used when attempting +17 Reinforcement)
 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+17)]: A scroll that protects the drop, reset, or break of a Reinforcement Stone at +17 (Can be used when attempting +18 Reinforcement)

 - Reinforcement Protection Scroll and Advanced Reinforcement Protection Scroll Package will come to a sale end and New Reinforcement Scroll will be on permanent sale in Shop.
 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15)] x5/x10/x20 Package
 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16)] x5/x10/x20 Package
 - [Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+17)]

 - Players can now acquire the new Reinforcement Protection Scrolls instead of the old version from certain Box Contents, Dungeon Clear Rewards, and other Loot rewards.
 - List of Box Items: Gate Box (by Region), Serdin's Gratitude Gift Box, Hero Dungeon Box
 - List of Dungeons: Monster Train 301, Talin's Revenge, King Slime Dungeon, Tower of Disappearance.
 - Reinforcement Protection Scroll → Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+0~+15)
 - Advanced Reinforcement Protection Scroll → Reinforcement Protection Scroll (+16)

 - The following reinforcement protection items work the same way as before and remain unchanged.
 - Reinforcement Protection Scroll, Advanced Reinforcement Protection Scroll, Arquemeece's Reinforcement Protection Scroll, New Arquemeece's Reinforcement Protection Scroll

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/03a585030189d866f66d20978793b68d72c2b653.png[/img]
3) Additional Improvements to Reinforcement
 - If the player consumes all the scrolls in reinforcement, the player will receive a pop-up window.
 - The tooltip for Reinforcement and Transmutation will be in more detail.

2. Pet Balance
1) Dark Nightmare
 - Increased stun duration to Charge Attack.

2) Annie and Momo
 - Increased the radius of last explosion and adjusted the location

3. Other Fixes
 - Fixed a bug where equipping White Cat Lower Armor Ornament would not be reflected in the appearance for Decanee
 - Improved the UI to display Taint Debuff tooltip even if Taint Debuff would be at 0% in dungeons with Taint Effect
 - Fixed a bug where players would encounter Korean text in the tooltip for 'Lisnar's Prayer' even if their language setting was not Korean
 - Fixed a bug where party members could not see the symbol marked on portals in Berkas' Lair
 - Fixed a bug where Leona Pet Skill would be abnormally used under certain circumstances
 - Fixed the translation for Job Mission Items for certain languages
 - Fixed a bug where Veigas' Tet would have abnormal AP reduction
 - Fixed a bug where the font for the mailbox would have an abnormal display for certain languages
 - Fixed a bug where equipping Ronan's Keter Sword & Shield would have an abnormal appearance under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where Ai's basic command guide would not pop-up
 - Fixed a bug where Lass' Rising Attack would not turn him invincible
 - Improved the Treasure Box Select Screen at the Result Screen after clearing dungeons
 - Adjusted the Hell Spear based on Command and Skill Hits and Monster Counterattack Rate
 - Fixed a bug where Berkas would move out of the map under certain circumstances
 - Fixed a bug where Berkas would be forced to move under certain circumstances
 - Changed Berkas so that it would not go into a flight pattern if certain amount of damage was dealt in a short period of time
 - Adjusted the hitbox of Magic Kungji's attack
 - Improved the Drop System so that issues do not occur when drop rate greatly increases in such cases like August 1st Harrier Buff Event

[b]<Items to be Deleted>[/b]
1. Items to be deleted during maintenance on September 6th (UTC+0)
 - Mini Voidal Invader Loot Box
 - Welcome Back GrandChase Box
 - Welcome Back GrandChase Mission
 - Welcome Back GrandChase Growth Box 1
 - Welcome Back GrandChase Growth Box 2
 - Welcome Back GrandChase Growth Box 3
 - [Hyperspeed] Reduced Quicksave Cost Select Box
 - [Hyperspeed] Thirst for Power Select Box
 - [Hyperspeed] Unleash the Extreme Select Box
 - [Hyperspeed] Reduced Quicksave Cost
 - [Hyperspeed] Thirst for Power
 - [Hyperspeed] Unleash the Extreme


[b]<Banned Players Notice>[/b]
Number of players banned for using and/or promoting hack tools: 285 (Permanent Bans)


[b]<Balance Revamp Survey>[/b]
We are also preparing for a Balance Revamp.
We are checking both community feedback and in-game data to determine which characters should undergo a balance revamp.
In order to hear the opinion of players, we are planning on conducting a survey to improve our balance.
 - Survey Period: August 16th - August 23rd 23:59 (UTC+0)
 - We hope to receive various opinions regarding the balance.
 - All opinions will be carefully reviewed so that they can positively affect the balance revamp.
 - Link to Survey: forms.gle/rAARqxiMmW8p6Afm6

We sincerely thank you for your continued support of the game.
We will strive to create a better GrandChase Classic through the various opinions that we receive.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

July 26th 05:00 - 10:21 (UTC+0)

2. Adjusted the Dungeon Growth Pathing for Better Difficulty and Simplicity.
(a) Changed the unlock condition of Harrier Dungeon to Temple of Time Clear.[/b]

(will be updated)

 - Fixed a bug where jumping while riding on a water current as Amy caused her to double jump

notes.title: [Announcement] May 24th Maintenance Preview
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We'd like to provide some insights into the upcoming improvements to growth pathing.

The GrandChase Classic Team is working on a new content update that will come later this year.
Before we go into details about the content update, we'd like to cover the improvements made on growth so that new and returning players can easily adapt and get back into the game.
We will be preparing events that give rewards that help character level growth, so grab the opportunity and try out various characters you wanted to grow and check out the improved points.
Details may be subject to change during the development. Detailed changes will follow on next week's maintenance announcement.

[b]2. Adjusted the Dungeon Growth Pathing for Better Difficulty and Simplicity.[/b]
[b]a) Changed the unlock condition of Harrier Dungeon to Temple of Time Clear.[/b]
 - Players will be able to enter after reaching Lv.85 and acquiring Dimension Guardians Equipment.

[b]b) Champion Mode will be Removed from (Bermesiah Continent ~ Archimedia Continent).[/b]
Improved so that players can acquire Champion Mode rewards from Normal Dungeons.
 - Players can acquire equipment, pet creation manual, and titles from Normal Dungeons which were formerly acquired from Champion Mode.
 - Acquire count condition for titles have been changed to Normal Dungeons from Champion Mode.
 - Champion Mode Entry Tickets in possession will be available for use in Harrier Dungeons.

[b]c) Starting Dungeon for Edel and Veigas will be Adjusted to Trial Forest.[/b]
 - Players will be able to pick up items for Edel and Veigas from Trial Forest ~ Marsh of Oblivion dungeons.
 - Epic Missions for Edel and Veigas will be added to Trial Forest ~ Marsh of Oblivion dungeons.
 - If the player wishes the return to the former exclusive dungeons (Frostland, Trivia), players can select the dungeons in the World Map to enter.


[b]3. Improved the Burden of Running Daily Dungeons on Multiple Characters.[/b]
Reduced the Daily Entry Count on Hero Dungeons and Siege of Teroka.
Rewards will not be increased, but the amount of crafting materials needed will be reduced, allowing the players to craft items at a faster rate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5686e6c942b48fd33f52f8b3d2be47d509ddd2b6.png[/img]


[b]4. Reduced the Amount of Crafting Materials Needed for the Best Equipment, Allowing Faster Battle Power Growth.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/d75aae1d85bb6aca24ea0e3a0a3ae20494ad6bed.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0a315632db9aa9350828aeafa2f113eadf1e4584.png[/img]


[b]5. Changed True Iron Dragon Equipment to be Crafted in Hero Shop.[/b]

 - All party members will receive loot in the normal dungeons and not roll for loot.


[b]7. Other Improvements[/b]

 - Improved so that item sale price item drops from later dungeons are not at 0.

[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
The bug where Chaser Pass Mission did not complete under certain circumstances will be fixed during maintenance on May 24th (UTC+0).
Players who had this issue will receive Chaser Pass experience during the maintenance.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/42f9dbc12a27076b45551f1d208be7fc65b62ae6.png[/img]

 - Chaser Pass Mission can be found as [Chaser Pass] under Repeat Missions.
 - There are Free Chaser Pass and Premium Pass.

(2) Free Chaser Pass
 - Players can raise the Pass Level by gaining Pass Experience through clearing daily and weekly missions.
 - Plaeyrs who complete each Pass Level can claim rewards for that level by pressing on "Receive".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/09e1c1087a717a3e9469f20c67ae11ac4f0559f6.png[/img]
 - Players may purchase [Pass Level +1 Ticket] to receive additional EXP for their Pass. (Pass Level +1 Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

(3) Free Chaser Pass Reward
 - Exclusive Reward: Players can acquire [Star Chaser] Monster Card. [Star Chaser] has the same stats as Unknown Demon Monster Card. (Critical Damage 26.50% / Taint Resistance 0.40%) 
 - Players can also acquire Special Reinforcement Blessing Scroll, Premium GC Club (1 Day), Reinforcement Protection Scroll, and other various rewards.

(4) Premium Pass
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b733a7937afa899ce0e655e2a43af2b112bb3546.png[/img]
 - Players can receive Free Chaser Pass Rewards and additional rewards for purchasing [Premium Pass]. (Premium Pass Price: 20,000 VP)
 - Players can raise the Pass Level by gaining Pass Experience through clearing daily, weekly, and seasonal missions.
 - Players who purchase [Premium Pass] may only be able to clear [Chaser Pass - Seasonal Mission] only once during the Pass period.
 - [Premium Pass] will go into effect upon purchase and will alllow the player to claim the rewards for the levels already completed.
 - Players may purchase [Pass Level +1 Ticket] to receive additional EXP for their Pass. (Pass Level +1 Ticket Price: 2,000 VP)

1. Character Balance Changes

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

We'd like to thank you for your detailed opinion through the survey.
After reviewing every single survey, we have concluded that a majority of the players wanted a change in the character's damage output.
The developers have agreed that a big gap in damage between the characters may hamper players from trying out various characters.
Therefore, the character balance was focused on reducing that gap between the characters' skill damage in dungeons as the first step.

We have reviewed clear time by character and usage rate carefully in major dungeons.
Also, we have gone over each skill to update our data with the latest information.
As such, we have found that several skills have been rather lacking in power and have adjusted them thereof.
We hope that this data structure that we build helps us balance out the gap between the characters.
We are also discussing the improvements and adjustments that were brought up in the survey but not in the current balance adjustments.
We will continue to collect and review community feedback to improve the game and create a balanced game environment.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Finished) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates. 


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
March 22nd 04:00 - 08:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
1. Temple of Time
"Chase down the witch who jumps to the past from the center of the New World!"

After chasing the witch down, the GrandChase members have finally arrived at the altar for time reversal, the Temple of Time.
It is a hideout for her where her  cult was conducting the research on time travelling.

Although the GrandChase knew the flow of time was twisted,
they were drawn into a fierce battle as the witches' cronies blocked their way.

However, they were unable to stop the reversal of time and the temple starts to collapse.
Even worse, a Saint corrupted by the witch blocks the path to safety.

The witch is sure to bring catastrophe upon Aernas from the past.
One can only imagine what kind of atrocities she will devise to ruin Aernas!

Defeat all the enemies that stand in the way and work to return to the past.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5d083fef345d6434eb61dfda03a8bbdf09dc99c2.png[/img]

1) Entry Requirement
 - Based on Level 85
 - Players can play 3 times per day. Additional entry will allow players to receive the normal rewards, but will have a penalty in the clear rewards.
 - Players can acquire additional clear rewards by consuming 'Another World Dungeon Entry Ticket' to reduce the daily clear count.
Entry tickets will be provided via event and other systems in the future.

2) Rewards
 - Players can acquire 5 different Level 85 Epic or Rare Dimension Guardians Accessories (Taint Resistance Set Effect, 11 Sets).
 - Players can acquire Level 85 Epic or Rare Dimension Guardians Piercing Fragment (Players can craft Dimension Guardian Piercing by using the fragments).
 - Players can acquire Level 85 Epic or Rare Dimension Guardians Piercing
 - Level 85 Epic Dimension Guardians Piercing has a 2 set effect with Dimension Guardians Earrings. (Critical Strike Chance + Critical Damage)
 - Players can acquire the title: 'Time Defier'.
 - Players can acquire Temple of Time Monster Cards.
 - Players can acquire Hero's Bullion.


[b]<Event>[/b]
1. Temple of Time Update Celebration Event (March 22nd After Maintenance - April 12th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)

1) Attendance Log
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/3d3d9c59ecfa08bfd360bc68923e055b310983af.png[/img]
 - Login for 30 minutes to receive login rewards for 15 days.
 - Players can acquire Premium GC Club, GP Item Prop Reset Form, Natal Ring, +10 Bag, Advanced Rune Summon Chest, Skill SP Reset Card (10 Times), Bonus Recharge, Ring of Beefiness, and more.
 - Temple of Time Accessory (15 Days) Trial Box contains accessories for Limited Time (15 days). Box will be deleted after the event ends.

2) Hunt monsters in 'Temple of Time'
 - 'Temple of Time' monsters will randomly appear in normal dungeons at appropriate level range. Hunting them down will drop 'Temple of Time Box'.
 - 'Temple of Time' monsters will randomly appear in Harrier dungeons regardless of level. Hunting them down will drop 'Temple of Time Box'.
 - 'Temple of Time Box' contains Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), Premium GC Club, GP Item Random Prop Form, Advanced Rune Summon Chest, Lisnar's HP/MP Potion, Bonus Recharge, and other items on varied rates.
 - 'Temple of Time Box' will not drop in Hero Dungeons, Event Dungeons, and other certain dungeons since Temple of Time monsters will not spawn there.

3) Daily Repeat Mission & Weekly Mission
 - Players can complete daily repeat missions to collect 'Temple of Time Fragment'.
 - Players can clear The Crucible, Sanctum of Destruction, and Wizard's Labyrinth daily to acquire 1 fragment each for a total of 3 fragments per day.
 - Collected 'Temple of Time Fragment' can be used to craft Coordi accessories such as Dimension Guardians Circlet, Wings, Stompers, Shield, and Mask for the character of the player's choice.
 - Crafted Coordi Accessories are not for Limited Time, but Permanent.

4) Weekly Mission
 - Players can complete weekly missions to collect 'Temple of Time Fragment'
 - Collected 'Temple of Time Fragment' can be used to craft Coordi accessories such as Dimension Guardians Circlet, Wings, Stompers, Shield, and Mask for the character of the player's choice.
 - Crafted Coordi Accessories are not for Limited Time, but Permanent.
 - Players can acquire additional rewards other than 'Temple of Time Framgent' by weeks.
 - Week 1 (March 22nd After Maintenance - March 28th 23:59) (UTC+0): Clear Temple of Time 1 Time for Temple of Time Fragment x3, 5 Times for Advanced Rune Summon Chest x3, 10 Times for Premium GC Club (3 Days)
 - Week 2 (March 29th 00:00 - April 4th 23:59) (UTC+0): Clear Temple of Time 1 Time for Temple of Time Fragment x3, 5 Times for Advanced Rune Summon Chest x3, 10 Times for Advanced Reinforcement Protection Scroll
 - Week 3 (April 5th 00:00 - April 12th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0): Clear Temple of Time 1 Time for Temple of Time Fragment x3, 5 Times for Advanced Rune Summon Chest x3, 10 Times for Dungeon Entry Ticket Box x1


[b]<Shop Items>[/b]
1. Spring Messenger Seal Breaker Coordi (March 22nd After Maintenance - Appril 12th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/bfa5ffaf0dbbb046ae84111ce0f45006ba32e753.png[/img]

2. Grand Sage Coordi (March 22nd After Maintenance - Appril 12th Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/12e15d77ae7a5d90d47e6930deb7592420f349d6.png[/img]


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
1. Improved Seal Breaker Scrolls
1) Coordi Item Acquisition Method will be changed
 - The point system will be removed so that Coordi items will be acquired based on drop rates.
 - Players will have varying drop rates in acquiring a Coordi item based on the number of Coordi items they have yet to acquire.
 - If the player successfully acquires a Coordi item, the player will get a random Coordi item that has not been picked up yet. Players will not acquire duplicate Coordi items.
 - The rates for Coordi items will be announced separately.

2) Gauge System will be added

 - There will be individual gauge that will accumulate and reset separately for each Seal Breaker Coordi.

4) Sealed Gems will be removed
 - Players can now use Seal Breaker Scrolls without Sealed Gems.

5) Consecutive Seal Breaker System will be added
 - A new function will be added that will allow players to attempt Seal Breaker consecutively.

2. Certain GP Equipment (Fixed Rank): Restored as fixed rank and with random stats.

 - After the Disenchant, Stat Coordi will be changed back to the original appearance.

 - Added the following line to Coordi Transformation Tip: 'The rank and stats may change if you Fuse and Disenchant Coordi Transformed Equipment.'

 - Expanded the area of attack
 - Increased the damage
 - Removed monster displacement

 - Expanded the area of spin attack
 - Added a stun to spin attack
 - Increased the damage of fire attack

notes.title: [Announcement] (Modified) Preview for Update in Development
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

We'd like to thank everyone for providing various feedback on the contents and system to improve GrandChase Classic.
The developers will check everyone's concerns and ideas and continue to strive to improve areas where lacking.
We'd like to share some of the improvement updates that could be considered important.

Currently, the developers of GrandChase Classic are reworking the Seal Breaker System, adding Coordi Fusion Disenchant and are working to improve the balance between characters.
Seal Breaker System Revamp and Coordi Fusion Disenchant system will be updated during maintenance on March 22nd
and improvements to character balance will take effect after we have gathered enough game data and players feedback via survey.
We look forward to your participation in the survey.

The first improvements we bring to the table is the Seal Breaker System Revamp.
The current Seal Breaker system uses a mix of drop rates and points and plan to adjust the system to solely depend on drop rates.
Since there are limitations to a system with drop rates as the only factor, we will be adding a drop gauge to insure a form of guaranteed drop.
We will also be improving other parts of the system for a better experience.

[b]<Seal Breaker Scroll System Revamp>[/b]
1) Coordi Item Acquisition Method will be changed
 - The point system will be removed so that Coordi items will be acquired based on drop rates.
 - Players will have varying drop rates in acquiring a Coordi item based on the number of Coordi items they have yet to acquire.
 - If the player successfully acquires a Coordi item, the player will get a random Coordi item that is not in current possession on equal rates.
 - The rates for Coordi items will be announced separately.

2) Gauge System will be added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/702752218571fdeb2d8ab136652c36356515b5da.png[/img]
 - Every time the player fails to acquire the Coordi item via Seal Breaker, the gauge will increase.
 - If the gauge reaches full, players will receive an unacquired Seal Breaker Coordi item with equal rates.
 - The gauge will reset if the player acquires a Seal Breaker Coordi item.
 - There will be individual gauge that will accumulate and reset separately for each Seal Breaker Coordi.
 - The gauge will reset after the Seal Breaker Event ends.

3) List of Non-Coordi Items will be improved
 - Remove Large Potion Package 1 and Medium Potion Package 1 since the value of these packages go down as players reach higher levels.
 - Add Demons of Yore Potion Recovery Package, Demons of Yore Potion Special Package, Harrier Monster Card Box, Another World Monster Card Box, Grade 15 Reinforcement Scroll, Grade 13 Reinforcement Scroll, and Grade 11 Reinforcement Scroll.

4) Sealed Gems will be removed
 - Players can now use Seal Breaker Scrolls without Sealed Gems.

5) Consecutive Seal Breaker System will be added
 - A new function will be added that will allow players to attempt Seal Breaker consecutively.
 - Consecutive Seal Breaker will continue to unseal until the player acquires the Coordi Item, the player runs out of Seal Breaker Scrolls, or the player reaches max gauge.

The second improvements to follow is the Coordi Fusion Disenchant System where players can restore the appearance Coordi Item used in Coordi Fusion.

[b]<Coordi Fusion Disenchant System>[/b]
Coordi Transformation, Coordi Fusion, and Coordi Fusion Disenchant function will be integrated into 'Customize Coordi' tab.
1) Coordi Fusion Disenchant: Fusion Disenchant is a system where players can disassemble the Fused Coordi Item to restore the stat Coordi Item and the Appearance Coordi item.
 - How to Use: Go to Inventory > Press [Customize Coordi] > Press [Fusion Disenchant] > Register Fused Coordi Item to be Disenchanted > Disenchant
 - Players can consume GP to perform their first Fusion Disenchant.
 - Players will not be able to perform Fusion Disenchant if they have no inventory space.
 - The Fused Coordi Item will be separated into Appearance Coordi Item and Stat Coordi Item.

2) Fusion Disenchant
2-1) Appearance Coordi
 - Disenchanting a regular Coordi Item causes the items to be disenchanted back to their original rank and stats.
 - Disenchanting an equipment item causes it to be disenchanted into the Coordi Transformed Item following the rules below. (Players can check the stat changes if they transform the disenchanted Coordi item back as the equipment)
1. Cash Equipment: Restored as Epic rank and with selectable stats.
2. Certain GP Equipment (Fixed Rank): Restored as fixed rank and with random stats.
Ex) Legendary Rank Phantom Phoenix, True Iron Dragon, Event Dungeon Equipment, etc.
3. Other GP Equipment (Random Rank): Restored as Rare or Epic rank and with random stats.

2-2) Stat Coordi
 - After the Disenchant, Stat Coordi will be changed back to the original appearance.

3) Other Improvements
 - Added the following line to Coordi Transformation Tip: 'The rank and stats may change if you Fuse and Disenchant Coordi Transformed Equipment.'
 - Fused Coordi Item will be changed so that it will not be marked in the apperance and stat list once it is fused.
 - Added to following line to Coordi Fusion Tip: 'Fused Coordi Items cannot be used in Coordi Fusion.'

The third improvement will be the balance update.
We are reviewing all the community feedback and the game data to scrutinize which characters to opt for balance revamp.
In order to receive more feedback and to bring forth high quality improvements, we will conduct a survey to receive more opinion.

[b]<Character Balance Survey>[/b]
 - Survey Period: March 15, 2023 (Wed) 06:00 - March 22, 2023 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+0)
 - Please participate in the survey found in the link and provide us feedback regarding character balance.
 - We will review each and every feedback and work towards balance revamp.
 - link: https://forms.gle/8aKhx7WxaSGmVwpAA

Thank you for supporting us even in times where we were lacking.
We will continue to strive for a better GrandChase Classic by reviewing various opinions of the players.

Thank you.

notes.content:
(Added)
In order to compensate for the inconvenience caused by the maintenance extension today, players who log into the game from after maintenance - February 28th 23:59 (UTC+0) will receive Compensation Chest 1 in their mailbox.


Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates. 


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
February 28th 06:00 - 09:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Contents>[/b]
1. Saving System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5f45e5c3ad4948f48bcd64c81e2dec7cceaafcb9.png[/img]
 - Quicksave: A skill that dodges enemy attacks by using evasion command input with directional keys to pass through enemies
 - → → : Frontal Dash (Pass Through), ← ← : Backwards Dash (Pass Through)

1) Acquisition
 - Complete Saving Mode Mission 'Ultimate Evasion' to acquire Quicksave skill
 - Players will be able to pick up the mission when they reach a certain level
 - Players who have reached the level requirement prior to the patch will also receive the mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0fa7251f674938792411ec73175d31f29c875b05.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/ae05df451c013f905037eb8200935ae11a72e6d3.png[/img]

2) Specifics
 - Dungeon Exclusive Skill
 - All characters will have the same distance, invincible time, and attack after usage
 - Players can use it while in a standby mode on the ground, while moving, or after cancelling an attack motion
 - Players cannot use it while using a special skill, while getting hit, at a low evasion gauge, or while in midair
 - Players will be invincible while using Quicksave
 - Using Quicksave will consume the Saving Gauge
 - Saving Gauge can be expanded through additional missions to allow increase the max number of use


[b]<Event>[/b]
1. Gift Box Event (February 28th After Maintenance - March 22nd Before Maintenance) (UTC+0)

1) Attendance Log
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/edd9ac69e8183ca684e073cb0fccc1fd2670fa16.png[/img]
 - Login daily for 30 minutes to receive login rewards
 - Rewards consist of Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), Coordi Fusion Scroll, SP All Reset Card, GP Random Prop Scroll, Bonus Recharge, Blacksmith's Protection (7 Days), Coordi Coupon, Socket Gem, and other rewards

2) Create a Gift Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/084dd6329f6d4c1a31341e5342eaa90a669ebbb5.png[/img]

2-1) Complete a Gift Box
 - Gather 9 fragments to complete the Gift Box and press 'Open Box' to acquire the reward
 - Acquire 1 of the following: Single Property Scroll (Lv.85), Dungeon Entry Ticket Box, Premium GC Club (1 Day), GP Random Prop Scroll, Advanced Reinforcement Protection Scroll x2, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x3
 - Players who 'Exchanged' Gift Fragments for rewards will need additional fragments to complete the Gift Box

2-2) Exchange Gift Fragments
 - Players can 'Exchange' each of the 9 Gift Fragments for rewards
 - Players can only acquire the set reward for each of the 9 fragments
 - Each fragment can be exchanged for set rewards such as Advanced Rune Summon Chest, Event Dungeon Festival Entry Ticket, Hero Dungeon Entry Ticket, Champion Mode Entry Ticket, Mystery Potion (L) x10, HP Potion (L) x10, MP Potion (L) x20, and other rewards

2-3) Dungeon Clear Reward
 - Clear dungeons of appropriate level range to acquire Gift Fragment Random Box (#1~9)
 - Gift Fragment Random Box (#1~9): Contains 1 random fragment (#1~9)
 - Hero Dungeons, Event Dungeons, and certain other dungeons are excluded

2-4) Daily Repeat Mission
 - Clear Daily Repeat Missions to acquire Gift Fragment Random Box
 - Clear The Crucible to acquire Gift Fragment Random Box (#1~3) x1
 - Clear Sanctum of Destruction to acquire Gift Fragment Random Box (#1~3) x1
 - Clear Wizard's Labyrinth to acquire Gift Fragment Random Box (#1~3) x1
 - Gift Fragment Random Box (#1~3): Contains 1 random fragment (#1~3)
 - Gift Fragment Random Box (#4~6): Contains 1 random fragment (#4~6)
 - Gift Fragment Random Box (#7~9): Contains 1 random fragment (#7~9)

2-5) Weekly Mission
 - Clear Weekly Missions to acquire Gift Fragment Select Box (#1~9)
 - Weekly Missions for Week 1, 2, and 3 reset every Wednesday 00:00 (UTC+0)
 - Defeat 300 Monsters at the Appropriate Level Range to acquire Gift Fragment Select Box (#1~9) x1
 - Defeat 500 Monsters at the Appropriate Level Range to acquire Gift Fragment Select Box (#1~9) x1
 - Defeat 700 Monsters at the Appropriate Level Range to acquire Gift Fragment Select Box (#1~9) x1
 - Gift Box Select Box (#1~9): Contains 1 fragment (#1~9) of the player's choice

2. AP Exclusive Play Event
1) Players will receive improvement rewards for AP characters by mail
 - Login to receive '[Event] AP Character Support' Mission Scroll x5. Only AP characters may use these
 - AP Characters: Dio, Ley, Rufus, Zero, Veigas
 - Mission Completion Requirement: Possess 1 Gem while at Lv.85 or above
 - Mission Completion Reward: [Event] Chase Point Reset Card x3, [Event] SP Reset Card x1
2) Mission Play
 - AP Characters will receive exclusive missions
 - AP Characters: Dio, Ley, Rufus, Zero, Veigas
 - Clear the mission: Defeat 500 Monsters at the Appropriate Level Range to receive GP Random Prop Reset Form x1, Advanced Rune Summon Chest x7


[b]<Shop Items>[/b]

 - Login daily for 30 minutes to receive attendance reward
 - Ring of Beefiness, Champion Mode Entry Ticket, Hero Dungeon Entry Ticket, Another World Dungeon Entry Ticket, Event Dungeon Festival Entry Ticket, +10 Bag, Bonus Recharge, and more.

2) Dice Dice Baby! Event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/6b4187fbaf91a284999094d27cfe4833dc59e5c5.png[/img]

2-1) Dice Dice Baby! Game Board
 - Login during the event period to receive Dice Dice Baby! Game Board
 - Play Dice Dice Baby! By using the Dice Dice Baby! Coin that recharges over time
 - Players will receive reward for landing on spaces and doing laps until 30 laps have been completed. Players will only receive reward for landing on spaces from the 31st lap
 - Dice Dice Baby! Game Board will be removed after the event ends

2-2) Dice Dice Baby! Coin Recharge
 - Players can acquire max 10 coins per day
 - Players will receive 1 coin upon login
 - Players will also receive 1 coin every 20 minutes (up to 5 max per day)
 - Players will receive up to a total of 4 coins through daily repeated missions

2-3) Lap Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5cd7b89607e0fec3172480f54f5064a82b5ae6a1.png[/img]
 - Players who complete 30 laps will receive Big Head Accessory (Helm, Upper Head, Lower Head Accessory. There will be a set effect for the 3 set items)
 - Players who complete 5, 10, 20, 25 laps will receive up to 14 (Event) Seal Breaker Scrolls. 
 - Players who complete laps will receive Special Reinforcement Blessing Scroll, Advanced Reinforcement Scroll, Advanced Rune Summon Chest, and other various rewards.
 - Toasty Taiyaki Big Head Select Chest will be removed after the event ends
 - (Event) Seal Breaker Scroll will be removed after the event ends

2-4) Space Reward
 - Each space has a designated reward. Players who land on the space will receive the designated reward
 - Spaces have Advanced Rune Summon Chest, Normal Rune Summon Chest, Megaphone, HP/MP/Mystery Potion (Large), and other various rewards.

2-5) Daily Repeated Mission
 - Players can acquire additional coins through clearing daily repeated missions
 - 1 coin for clearing The Crucible
 - 1 coin for clearing Sanctum of Destruction
 - 1 coin for clearing Wizard's Labyrinth
 - 1 coin for clearing Siege of Teroka

2. Weekend Login Event (Every Saturday and Sunday)
 - Login during February 11th - February 12th to receive SP All Reset Card x1 by mail
 - Login during February 18th - February 19th to receive SP All Reset Card x1 by mail

"The Grand Chase Begins into the New World."

The prophecy of Chosen 12 Disciples. There are those who work to fulfill and those who work to deny.
The Tower of Disappearance has appeared in Aernas due to the followers and adversaries of the prophecy. 

Atop the tower, Kaze'aze has awaited the Grand Chase, along with … by her side.
They warned the Grand Chase that the Demon God will invade into Aernas before disappearing.

In order to protect Aernas from the Demon God, the Grand Chase stepped into the portal that leads to another world.
But it was a trap.

The Grand Chase was attacked the moment they stepped into the portal, and the Grand Chase members have scattered all over the place.
In order to gather the scattered members and stop the Demon God's dark schemes, the Grand Chase begins once again.

[b]<Content>[/b]
World Harrier Part 3 Update
 - The identity of monsters occupying the central zone of the island is Harrier.
 - They emanate demonic energies on par with demons.
 - But they are not demons. They are species from a world destructed by demons.
 - They use demonic energy as their main source of power for revenge so that they could raise enough army to invade into the Demon World.
 - To Harrier, Aernas is nothing but a stepping stone on the way to the Demon World.

 - Growth Opportunity Attendance Event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/88f0c4c99a066b48afc126b0841527618e296e64.png[/img]
 - Players can obtain 'Growth Opportunity' by clearing Harrier Dungeons or Dungeons at their appropriate level to craft various items that help the players to grow.
 - Players can obtain up to 15 'Growth Opportunity' daily. Players can obtain up to 3 from playing PVP.
 - 'Growth Opportunity' can be used to craft Special Rune Summon Chest, Normal Rune Summon Chest, Chase Point Reset Card, or SP Reset Card.
 - 'Growth Opportunity' will be removed when the event ends.

[b]<Shop Items>[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/fbc16ee9ca0dd0b46caa5919c187a61df3bd0def.png[/img]


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]

[Character 2nd Balance Update]
 - Changed the character stat adjustment in PVP
 - Adjusted all character damage in PVP due to the changes in stat adjustment
 - Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
 - Fixed skills to have separate stats in dungeons and in PVP and fixed skill tooltips to show PVP stat values separately from dungeon stat values (Tooltip has been added where missing)
 - Adjusted certain Rune set effects in PVP
 - Adjusted some of the normal attack type and special type applied in damage
 - Added Combo Down system to PVP
 - Changed so that HP, MP/AP recovery effects do not apply when attacking enemy under FATAL status.
 - Changed invincibility effect on evade skills without cooldown to Hyper Armor in PVP.

1) Adjusted Stats
 - Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, Special Defense, Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, Critical Strike Damage Resistance, HP Recovery, MP Recovery

2) Stat Adjustment Method

2 - 1) Adjustment Method 1
 - Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, and Special Defense will use the below method for adjustment.
 - Adjust stats based on the players' stats within the PVP room to calculate highest and lowest stats and adjust the stats as follows:
 - Highest stat in the stat comparison will be adjusted to the highest value below, and the lowest stat will be adjusted to the lowest value below.
 - Other stats will be adjusted to the value somewhere in the range below.
 - Attack: 3330 - 3700
 - Defense: 1440 - 1600
 - Vitality: 3807 - 4230
 - Special Attack: 5580 - 6200
 - Special Defense: 900 - 1000

2 - 2) Adjustment Method 2
 - Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, and Critical Strike Damage Resistance will use the below method for adjustment.
 - Adjust stats based on a separate formula into the following range:
 - Critical Strike Chance: 0 - 15%
 - Critical Strike Damage Increase: 0 - 100%
 - Critical Strike Damage Resistance: 0 - 97.53%

2 - 3) Adjustment Method 3
 - HP Recovery and MP Recovery will use the below method for adjustment. MP Recovery has stayed the same as before.
 - HP Recovery: 50% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 50% of Total Stat (Added a tooltip to the Stat Window)
 - MP Recovery: 25% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 25% of Total Stat (Same as before)

3) Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
 - Players can test stats adjusted to the below values:
 - Attack: 3700
 - Defense: 1600
 - Vitality: 4230
 - Special Attack: 6200
 - Special Defense: 1000

4) Improvements to Skill Tooltip
 - Added tooltips to skills with effects that have a different value whether it was used in Dungeons or in PVP
 - Emphasized the "Resurrection" with color in tooltips

5) Adjusted Rune Set Effects in PVP
 - Rune Set Effects that are adjusted in PVP will be shown separately in the tooltips.
 - Below effects apply to the adjustments in PVP.
 - Fury: Attack +1%
 - Endure: Defense +1%
 - Tolerance: Vitality +1%
 - Will: Max HP +2% on Resurrection
 - Focus: MP(AP) +3 on Resurrection
 - Fight: At Start of Combat, Ally Attack +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Guard: At Start of Combat, Ally Defense +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Enhance: At Start of Combat, Ally Vitality +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Limit: Attack +7.5% for 7 Seconds on Resurrection
 - Hunt: Damage +2% to Enemies Above 80% HP
 - Recovery: 5% Chance to Recover 15% of Max HP when Hit
 - Resurrect: Resurrect 1 Time in Fatal Status on a 50% chance
 - Rage: Attack +2% at Below 20% HP
 - Overcome: Defense +3% at Below 20% HP
 - Punish: Damage +2% to Enemies Below 30% HP
 - Protect: Reduce Damage by 3% from Enemies Above 80% HP

6) Adjusted Normal Attack Type and Special Attack Type
 - Changed the type of normal attack type skill damage to special attack type
 - Changed the type of special type normal attack and command attack to normal type
 - Added a new type with no MP recovery to normal attack of MP and Hybrid characters

7) Added Combo Down System
 - Added a system with all characters having a limit to 'down' gauge. Down gauge increases when hit by basic attacks.
 - When attacked, down gauge increases differently based on attack
 - When down gauge reaches the limit, combo down occurs.
 - When combo down occurs, an effect will occur and the character will be forced into a down state with 2 seconds of Arena Invincibility.
 - Down gauge increases: When character is hit by normal attacks.
 - Down gauge decreases: When character is hit by special attacks. Down gauge also decreases gradually when the character is not under attack.
 - Down gauge stays the same: When character is hit while under the effect of Super Armor or Hyper Armor
- Down gauge reset: When a character is revived, turned down from the ground, turned down, counted, or FATAL, the accumulated down values are initialized.

8) HP, MP/AP will not recover upon attacking enemy under FATAL status.
 - Changed so that HP, MP/AP recovery effects in skill and command do not apply when attacking enemy under FATAL status.
 - The skill tooltip in PVP will reflect the above changes.

9) Invincibility effect on evade skills without cooldown is changed to Hyper Armor in PVP.
 - Changed invincibility effect on evade skills without cooldown to Hyper Armor in PVP.
 - Hyper Armor effect duration only applies during The evade motion and will be removed when The motion ends.

tags.balance_change: - Changed the character stat adjustment in PVP
- Adjusted all character damage in PVP due to the changes in stat adjustment
- Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
- Adjusted certain Rune set effects in PVP
- Adjusted some of the normal attack type and special type applied in damage
- Changed so that HP, MP/AP recovery effects do not apply when attacking enemy under FATAL status.
- Changed invincibility effect on evade skills without cooldown to Hyper Armor in PVP.
- Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, Special Defense, Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, Critical Strike Damage Resistance, HP Recovery, MP Recovery
- Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, and Special Defense will use the below method for adjustment.
- Vitality: 3807 - 4230
- Special Attack: 5580 - 6200
- Special Defense: 900 - 1000
- Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, and Critical Strike Damage Resistance will use the below method for adjustment.
- Critical Strike Chance: 0 - 15%
- Critical Strike Damage Increase: 0 - 100%
- Critical Strike Damage Resistance: 0 - 97.53%
- HP Recovery and MP Recovery will use the below method for adjustment. MP Recovery has stayed the same as before.
- HP Recovery: 50% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 50% of Total Stat (Added a tooltip to the Stat Window)
- MP Recovery: 25% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 25% of Total Stat (Same as before)
- Players can test stats adjusted to the below values:
- Attack: 3700
- Defense: 1600
- Vitality: 4230
- Special Attack: 6200
- Special Defense: 1000
- Added tooltips to skills with effects that have a different value whether it was used in Dungeons or in PVP
- Emphasized the "Resurrection" with color in tooltips
- Rune Set Effects that are adjusted in PVP will be shown separately in the tooltips.
- Below effects apply to the adjustments in PVP.
- Fury: Attack +1%
- Endure: Defense +1%
- Tolerance: Vitality +1%
- Will: Max HP +2% on Resurrection
- Focus: MP(AP) +3 on Resurrection
- Fight: At Start of Combat, Ally Attack +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
- Guard: At Start of Combat, Ally Defense +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
- Enhance: At Start of Combat, Ally Vitality +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)

- When attacked, down gauge increases differently based on attack
- When down gauge reaches the limit, combo down occurs.
- When combo down occurs, an effect will occur and the character will be forced into a down state with 2 seconds of Arena Invincibility.
- Down gauge increases: When character is hit by normal attacks.
- Down gauge decreases: When character is hit by special attacks. Down gauge also decreases gradually when the character is not under attack.
- Down gauge stays the same: When character is hit while under the effect of Super Armor or Hyper Armor
- Down gauge reset: When a character is revived, turned down from the ground, turned down, counted, or FATAL, the accumulated down values are initialized.

notes.title: 3rd Update Notice on August 3, 2022: 2nd Character Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Character 2nd Balance Update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b459986d642347bb6066bf05b6868bb4b3b340d8.png[/img]
 - Changed the character stat adjustment in PVP
 - Adjusted all character damage in PVP due to the changes in stat adjustment
 - Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
 - Fixed skills to have separate stats in dungeons and in PVP and fixed skill tooltips to show PVP stat values separately from dungeon stat values (Tooltip has been added where missing)
 - Adjusted certain Rune set effects in PVP
 - Adjusted some of the normal attack type and special type applied in damage
 - Added Combo Down system to PVP


1) Adjusted Stats
 - Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, Special Defense, Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, Critical Strike Damage Resistance, HP Recovery, MP Recovery 


2) Stat Adjustment Method

2 - 1) Adjustment Method 1
 - Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, and Special Defense will use the below method for adjustment.
 - Adjust stats based on the players' stats within the PVP room to calculate highest and lowest stats and adjust the stats as follows:
 - Highest stat in the stat comparison will be adjusted to the highest value below, and the lowest stat will be adjusted to the lowest value below.
 - Other stats will be adjusted to the value somewhere in the range below.
 - Attack: 3330 - 3700
 - Defense: 1440 - 1600
 - Vitality: 3807 - 4230
 - Special Attack: 5580 - 6200
 - Special Defense: 900 - 1000

2 - 2) Adjustment Method 2
 - Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, and Critical Strike Damage Resistance will use the below method for adjustment.
 - Adjust stats based on a separate formula into the following range:
 - Critical Strike Chance: 0 - 15%
 - Critical Strike Damage Increase: 0 - 100%
 - Critical Strike Damage Resistance: 0 - 97.53%

2 - 3) Adjustment Method 3
 - HP Recovery and MP Recovery will use the below method for adjustment. MP Recovery has stayed the same as before.
 - HP Recovery: 50% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 50% of Total Stat (Added a tooltip to the Stat Window)
 - MP Recovery: 25% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 25% of Total Stat (Same as before)


3) Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
 - Players can test stats adjusted to the below values:
 - Attack: 3700
 - Defense: 1600
 - Vitality: 4230
 - Special Attack: 6200
 - Special Defense: 1000


4) Improvements to Skill Tooltip
 - Added tooltips to skills with effects that have a different value whether it was used in Dungeons or in PVP
 - Emphasized the "Resurrection" with color in tooltips


5) Adjusted Rune Set Effects in PVP

 - Endure: Defense +1%
 - Tolerance: Vitality +1%
 - Will: Max HP +2% on Resurrection
 - Focus: MP(AP) +3 on Resurrection
 - Fight: At Start of Combat, Ally Attack +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Guard: At Start of Combat, Ally Defense +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Enhance: At Start of Combat, Ally Vitality +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Limit: Attack +7.5% for 7 Seconds on Resurrection
 - Hunt: Damage +2% to Enemies Above 80% HP
 - Recovery: 5% Chance to Recover 15% of Max HP when Hit
 - Resurrect: Resurrect 1 Time in Fatal Status on a 50% chance
 - Rage: Attack +2% at Below 20% HP
 - Overcome: Defense +3% at Below 20% HP
 - Punish: Damage +2% to Enemies Below 30% HP
 - Protect: Reduce Damage by 3% from Enemies Above 80% HP


6) Adjusted Normal Attack Type and Special Attack Type
 - Changed the type of normal attack type skill damage to special attack type
 - Changed the type of special type normal attack and command attack to normal type
 - Added a new type with no MP recovery to normal attack of MP and Hybrid characters


7) Added Combo Down System
 - Added a system with all characters having a limit to 'down' gauge. Down gauge increases when hit by basic attacks.
 - When attacked, down gauge increases differently based on attack
 - When down gauge reaches the limit, combo down occurs.
 - When combo down occurs, an effect will occur and the character will be forced into a down state with 2 seconds of Arena Invincibility.
 - Down gauge increases: When character is hit by normal attacks.
 - Down gauge decreases: When character is hit by special attacks. Down gauge also decreases gradually when the character is not under attack.
 - Down gauge stays the same: When character is hit while under the effect of Super Armor or Hyper Armor
 - Down gauge reset: When chacracter resurrects, enters down state, counterattacks, or changes to FATAL state

notes.title: 2nd Update Notice on August 3, 2022: 2nd Character Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Character 2nd Balance Update
- Changed the character stat adjustment in PVP
- Adjusted all character damage in PVP due to the changes in stat adjustment
- Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
- Fixed skills to have separate stats in dungeons and in PVP and fixed skill tooltips to show PVP stat values separately from dungeon stat values (Tooltip has been added where missing)
- Adjusted certain Rune set effects in PVP
- Adjusted some of the normal attack type and special type applied in damage
- Added Combo Down system to PVP

1) Adjusted Stats
- Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, Special Defense, Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, Critical Strike Damage Resistance, HP Regen, MP Regen

2) Adjusted Normal Attack Type and Special Attack Type
- Changed the type of normal attack type skill damage to special attack type
- Changed the type of special type normal attack and command attack to normal type
- Added a new type with no MP regen to normal attack of MP and Hybrid characters

3) Added Combo Down system
- Added a system with all characters having a limit to 'down' gauge. Down gauge increases when hit by basic attacks.
- When down gauge reaches the limit, combo down occurs.
- When combo down occurs, an effect will occur and the character will be forced into a down state with 2 seconds of Arena Invincibility.
- Down gauge increases: When character is hit by normal attacks.
- Down gauge decreases: When character is hit by special attacks. Down gauge also decreases gradually when the character is not under attack.
- Down gauge stays the same: When character is hit while under the effect of Super Armor or Hyper Armor
- Down gauge reset: When chacracter resurrects, enters down state, counterattacks, or changes to FATAL state
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1d61661b3bf383d8837205a2f8edd53fb641e7b5.png[/img]


We will keep trying our best for GrandChase Classic.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Maintenance] (Finished) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates. 


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
July 13th 06:00 - 09:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Content>[/b]
1. World Harrier Part 2
 - The growing island possess various environments and various monsters inhabiting each environment.
 - Monsters compete to be chosen in the center. Those that fall behind by natural selection are pushed to the outskirts into various parts of the world.
 - Monsters that spread to various parts of the world are causing Monster Incident.
 - Players must find out who is behind this incident and for what purpose the monsters are competing to be chosen.
 - The Grand Chase is climbing the cliff to head towards the center of the island.

 - Skyward Approach
 - Glacial Valley of Zalos
 - Rofnus Snowfield Center
 - Harrier 1st Line of Defense
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/731202bf34a9cf31f0a860473dfc907e6c7f8bbb.png[/img]


[b]<Event>[/b]
1. 1st Anniversary Celebration Event (July 13th after maintenance - August 3rd before maintenance) (UTC+0)
1) Attendance Log
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/a1a83b8595ddc09cef3a1dfad845ed2b55883f3f.png[/img]
 - 1st Anniversary Commemoration Chest: A chest that contains Special Rune Summon Chest x10 and Chase Coordi Fragment x25
 - 1st Anniversary Celebration Chest: A chest that contains +9 Refinery Scroll x1, Special Rune Summon Chest x30, Chase Coordi Fragment x100
 - After the event ends, Commemoration and Celebration Chests will be removed.

2) Princeon Coordi and Pet Craft Event
 - Players can acquire 1 1st Anniversary Dungeon Fragment (Up to 30 per day) every time they clear Harrier Dungeons or dungeons at the players' appropriate level range.
 - Players can use 1st Anniversary Dungeon Fragments to craft Princeon Pet Card, Helmet, Upper Armor, Lower Armor, Gloves, Shoes, Cape, Circlet, Wings, Stompers, Shield, and Mask Coordi.
 - This event does not apply to hero dungeons, event dungeons, and certain dungeons

notes.title: [Maintenance] (finished) Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates. 


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
June 2nd 05:00 - 09:30 (UTC+0)


[b]<Content>[/b]
1. A new region, Harrier will be added (Part 1)
 - While unraveling the secrets of the Tower of Disappearance, monster incident happened worldwide.
 - Following the trail of monsters, an undiscovered continent has been discovered in the middle of the ocean.
 - According to the local fishermen, an island suddenly sprung forth from the ocean and started to grow in size into a continent.
 - Swelling Swampland Port, Forest of Aldeon, Howling Gorge, Ravenous Plunderer's Land, and more new regions are discovered even to this moment.
 - The GrandChase takes a step into this unknown new continent to find out what's behind the monster incident.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/cd97445984b81f9f85a8acfe0e0b6d535a4d2fa6.png[/img]

1) Harrier Debuff and Harrier Resistance Stats will be added
 - Dungeons in World Harrier reduces player stats through its special debuffs.
 - Debuffs will get stronger as players get closer to the center of Harrier.
 - To prevent the stat reduction, players need 'Harrier Resistance' stat.
 - Harrier Resistance stat exists in Harrier Monster Card, Title, Pet, Chase Level, Pet Glyph, and Rune.

2) Harrier Dungeon Monsters
 - Harrier Monsters have Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, Critical Strike Resistance stats.
 - Harrier Monsters randomly have new champion properties. The properties they have on their head provide distinct features in their attack and defense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/728650350c336ab847a16ad24d393dbb9e23034f.png[/img]

3) Invader Monster Appears
 - Harrier Dungeons have Invader Monsters appear randomly.
 - As players get closer to the center of Harrier, stronger Invader Monsters will appear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/0f431006bddf7e2194e3f46ae97127eb027e9242.png[/img]

2. New Equipped Item: 'Rune'
1) Rune
 - Rune can be equipped on characters.
 - Runes have 5 different shapes. They can only be fit in the slots that matches their shapes.
 - There are T1~T5 rank and each rank has Normal, Rare, Epic, Legendary grades.
 - Each rune has 1 primary stat and 3 secondary stats. There will be bonus options depending on what set of runes is used.
 - Rune shapes will determine what primary stats can be attached to the rune.
 - Runes with higher tier will have higher stats and runes with higher grade will have more secondary stats (up to 3).
 - Runes can be equipped from character level 54 and can be moved to the Warehouse only through Rune Sealing Scrolls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/51b8187c0434431bb229d827acc7d5011419a659.png[/img]

2) Rune Reinforcement
 - Dismantling runes will give Darkstones. Darkstones will provide EXP to runes, reinforcing them.
 - Runes can be reinforced to rank 10. Runes will neither be destroyed nor suffer from EXP drop through the reinforcement system.
 - As the reinforcement rank goes up, the primary stat of the rune will be increased.
 - At rank 3, 6, 9, 10, existing secondary stat will be reinforced or new secondary stat will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/da8f6415bca1a4c29bcc58a7aa280c502553c3bb.png[/img]

3) Rune Set
 - There are a total of 27 sets for runes. Set options will activate with 2 or 3 runes depending on the set.
 - More sets will be available at higher tier.

4) Rune Drops
 - Runes will drop starting in Xenia. As players get closer to Harrier, runes at higher tier will drop.
 - Runes are dropped individually.

5) Rune Shop
 - Rune Shop will be open where players can purchase with GP and VP.
 - Rune Shop can only be used by characters at level 54 and above.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/1855631e1b99f2d94828904a921fabc57ad624b9.png[/img]
 - Rune Summon Chest x10 Package: Players can purchase 1 package per day per account with GP. A package that contains 10 chests. Each chest contains 1 T1~T3 rune of all grades.
 - Special Rune Summon Chest x10 Package: Players can purchase 1 package per week per account with GP. Players can purchase this with VP with no limit. A package that contains 10 chests. Each chest contains 1 T1~T5 rune of all grades.
 - Darkstone x700 Package: Players can purchase 1 package per day per account with GP. A package that contains 700 Darkstones.
 - Darkstone x2,000 Package: Players can purchase 1 package per week per account with GP. Players can purchase with VP with no limit. A package that contains 2,000 Darkstones.
 - Rune Sealing Scroll: A scroll for sealing runes. Sealed runes can be moved to the Warehouse.
 - Players can expand their rune inventory up to 300 slots. Players can purchase +10 Rune Bag, +50 Rune Bag, +100 Rune Bag with VP.


[b]<Event>[/b]

1) Rune Gift Chest Attendance
 - Rune Gift Chest (T1~T2) and Rune Gift Chest (T3) will be given out with a 15-day attendance

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance for content updates. 


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
April 20, 2022 06:00 - 09:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Content>[/b]
1. A new character, Lime will be added
 - Lime “Please give me strength to uphold justice!”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/9f701183eac963c10d3c2399f68bf30f4436890f.jpg[/img]

2. Hero Dungeon Improved
1) Hero Dungeon Unlimited Entry and Clear Count
 - System updated to allow entry for hero dungeons even after consuming all tickets.
 - Before, tickets were consumed on entry, but now it will be used before the start of dungeon at the Ready phase.
 - When hero dungeon entry ticket is used, hero dungeon entry ticket and number played are deducted by 1.
 - If time goes past 00:00 (UTC+0) and hero dungeon is reset after using entry ticket to reduce clear count to ( 1 / 2 ), clear count is reset to ( 0 / 2 ) and the effects of entry ticket will be reset as well.
 - Hero Dungeon Ticket cannot be used during 23:30 - 00:05 (UTC+0).

2) Hero Dungeon Loot
 - After consuming all entry, players can still continue to obtain Monster EXP, Monster GP, and Hero's Precious Pearl.
 - After consuming all entry, no items will drop other than Hero's Precious Pearl and players will not obtain any rewards.
 - After consuming all entry, no items will drop in single play. In party play, there will only be loot for players who still have entry count left. Only those players can roll for loot.

3) Hero Dungeon and PVP Daily/Weekly Quest System
(1) Daily Quest
 - Daily quests have been added to 'The Crucible', 'Sanctum of Destruction', 'Wizard's Labyrinth', 'Tower of Disappearance', and 'Berkas' Lair'.
 - You can obtain Hero's Bullion Fragment, Refined Opal, Box Craft Tool Set, Core Essence, and Chase Coordi Fragment when you complete daily quests.
(2) Weekly Quest
 - PVP Weekly Quest: Land of Judgment is added.
 - You can obtain Hero's Bullion Fragment, Chase Coordi Fragment, and Refined Opal when you complete weekly quests.
(3) Hero Dungeon Random Box Craft
 - Players can craft Hero Dungeon Random Box by collecting Hero's Precious Pearls through hero dungeon and Refined Opal, Box Craft Tool Set, and Core Essence through Daily/Weekly Quests.
 - Hero Dungeon Random Box contains random rewards from Hero Dungeon on a certain chance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/82029da8be96616cdec9cdee1b3839ef2b435cc3.png[/img]

4) Hero Dungeon Individual Loot System
 - This pertains to hero dungeon random box materials and Tower of Disappearance rewards.
 - In party play for hero dungeons, if there is loot that drops, all party members will obtain the loot.
 - Loot that drops will only be visible to the player that receives the loot. Players will not be able to see the loot other party member receives.

3. Chase Coordi System
 - Chase Coordi: All characters' exclusive job coordi
 - Chase Coordi can be crafted in the 'Forge' by using 'Chase Coordi Fragment'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/7c92dd9ea0a793708f542406f2a04d0d18b6d4bd.png[/img]
 - 'Chase Coordi Fragment' can be collected from Seal Breaker on a chance and from daily/weekly quests.
 - If you collect all 'Chase Coordi' for a character job, you can receive account-wide stat boost, Chase EXP Potion, and 100 VP. Once the stat boost is obtained, you will retain the stat boost even if the Coordi disappears.
 - List of 'Chase Coordi' can be checked in 'Bermesiah's Hero Collection'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/eb6b1905373d3f4737ce56bbe80a8df19571ffc0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/c444fd8089d4e13ea396f2a56190f557501ebc2e.jpg[/img]

2. Chase Level System
- New growth system, 'Chase Level' will be added
1) After reaching Lv. 85, complete the account mission 'Limit Breaker' to open Chase Level
2) When you play a Lv. 85 character in your account, you receive account-wide Chase Level EXP from all previous sources of EXP (except PVP)
3) Chase Level can go up to 999, and Chase Rank will change every 100 Chase Level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/db80e853bc076e9b808deab0b11eb039fddfc295.png[/img]
4) When Chase Level goes up, you will gain Chase Points to grow your character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/69d699bb0a12e6777b52a390c87a9c861552d2ce.png[/img]
5) When you have a character with the Chase Level open, all characters in the account can use Chase Points
6) Chase Points can be used and reset on each character individually
7) Chase Point Reset Card, Chase Point All Reset Card, Chase Point Page Voucher, and Chase EXP Potion items have been added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/5ca9f9d6ef8ee0c53bf440b4dfb6cb067e6268e1.png[/img]
