4) Chasers who haven't logged in since January 26, 2022 maintenance will receive 'Returning Chaser Chest' when logging in.
- Returning Chaser Chest: It will reward Teddy Bear Coordi, Cuddles Pet, Premium GC Club, SP All Reset, 100,000 GP Coupon, and various items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/895d97d0aa4456818b5ae84ab6c7dc84db8a747b.png[/img]

notes.title: [Maintenance] Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!
We plan on having a scheduled maintenance to make content updates. 


[b]<Maintenance Schedule>[/b]
November 22, 06:00 - 09:00 (UTC+0)


[b]<Content>[/b]
1. New character, Dio, has been added.
"Be gone, you lowly creatures."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/03a3e045bea559be82043e6943c3001a11ad5a15.jpg[/img]

2. Dungeon balance adjustments for all characters
1) Elesis
- Greatly increased most of the basic combo damage (no change in 2nd job)
- Greatly increased the damage of utilizing combo, dash attack, and rising attack
- Greatly increased the damage of utilizing combo after jump in 3rd and 4th job
- Increased all skill damage (Except for level 4 skills)
- Greatly increased the combo damage when using "Bravery"
- Added a shared skill "Roll"
- Increased attack speed after Savior's Jump + DOWN + Z
2) Lire
- Increased the damage of basic combo in 3rd and 4th job, increased the damage of jump attack in 3rd job
- Increased the damage of most of the utilizing combo attack (no change in "Barrage" in base job)
- Increased/decreased the damage of dash attack, double attack, and critical attack
- Increased the damage of Z attack after double jump in base job and 4th job
- Reduced the damage of rising attack
- Increased the damage of Grade 1 skills
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 2 skills (no change in "Scatter Shot" and "Arrow Rain" in base job)
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 3 skills (no change in "Meteor Strike" in base job)
3) Arme
- Increased the damage of basic combo, utilizing combo, rising attack, and double attack
- Increased/decreased the damage of dash attack and critical attack
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 1 skills (no change in "Ring of Holding" in base job and "Ice Ball" in 4th job)
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 2 skills (reduced the skill damage of "Shock Stun Lv1", no change in "Creeping Death" in base job)
- Increased the damage of Grade 3 skills
- Reduced the MP recovery ratio of "Debilitating Aura"
- Reduced "Fear" skill's enemy attack and defense decrease effect
- Reduced the multiple hit damage when attacking multiple enemies at once for "Shock Stun"
- Reduced the amount of MP restored for "Mental Recovery"
4) Lass
- Increased the damage of most of combo attacks (no change in Combo Attack lv1 in base job)
- Increased/decreased the damage of utilizing combo in base job, increased the damage of utilizing combo in other jobs
- Greatly increased the damage of "Spike Trap", slightly reduced the damage of "Kunai Throw"
- Increased the damage of dash attack, rising attack, double attack, and critical attack
- Increased the damage of most of the skills (slightly reduced the skill damage of "Unlimited Blade", Except for level 4 skills)
5) Ryan
- Increased the damage of basic combo, applied attack after jump, rising attack, double attack
- Increased the damage of most of the utilizing combo attacks (reduced the damage of Z - Z - UP - Z - Z in base job)
- Increased/decreased the damage of dash attack and dash attack after jump
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 1 skills (slightly reduced the damage of "Freezing Attack" in base job)
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 2 skills (slightly reduced the damage of "Big Axe Destruction", reduced the damage of "Wild Justice" in base job)
- Increased the damage of Grade 3 skills
- Fixed "Leeching Slime" to heal each target only once
- Wolf Transformation: Slightly decreased the basic combo damage, Increased all skill damage
- Nephilim Transformation: Reduced the damage of basic combo, dash attack after jump, double attack, critical attack, and "Nephilim Transformation", greatly increased Grade 1 skill damage
- Magnus Dam Transformation: Reduced the skill damage of "Magnus Dan Transformation", increased all attack damage and skill damage
6) Ronan
- Increased the damage of basic combo, utilizing combo, dash attack, applied attack after jump, rising attack, double attack
- Increased/decreased the damage of critical attack
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 1 skills (no change in "Rune Flare" in 3rd job)
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 2 skills (slightly reduced the skill damage of "Giga Crash", no change in "Magic Defend" in 3rd job)
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 3 skills (no change in "Astral Vine" and "Tornado Stinger" in base job)
- "Holy Bless" in base job cannot be used when it reaches 5 stacks.
- Decreased the damage of "Magic Spear 2" during Erudon's Spear mode in 2nd job
7) Amy
- Greatly increased the damage of most of the basic combos (greatly increased the damage of Fight mode and Action mode, no change in Drama mode in 4th job)
- Greatly increased the damage of utilizing combo, dash attack, applied attack after jump, rising attack, double attack
- Greatly increased the damage of most of the skills (reduced the damage of "Grand Finale" and "Amy Kick" in base job, Except for level 4 skills)
- Increased the attack increase effect of "Dance Fever"
- Increased the chance to remove debuffs with "Blessing"
8) Jin
- Increased the damage of basic combo and double attack, reduced the damage of critical attack
- Increased the damage of most of the skills (slightly reduced the damage of "Destroyer of Heaven" in 4th job, Except for level 4 skills)
- Greatly increased the damage of utilizing combo attack in base job
- Reduced the damage of "Storm Fist", "Iron Mountain", "Taming the Tiger" and "Scorpion Sting"
- Increased/decreased the damage of utilizing combo in 2nd and 4th job
- Increased/decreased the damage of dash attack
- Increased the damage of most of the applied attack after jump (reduced the damage of Z + UP attack while jumping in base job)
- Increased/decreased the damage of rising attack
- Reduced the attack increase buff effect of "End of Days"(final damage ratio increase due to other attack damage being increased after the patch)
- Greatly increased the combo damage when using "Fists of Heaven & Earth"
9) Sieghart
- Increased the damage of basic combo, utilizing combo, dash attack, rising attack, and double attack
- Increased/decreased the damage of applied attack after jump, attack during power stance, and critical attack.
- Increased all skill damage, Except for level 4 skills
10) Mari
- Increased the damage of most of the basic combo and rising attack (no change in "Combo Attack Lv2" in base job)
- Increased/decreased the damage of utilizing combo, dash attack, jump attack, double attack, and critical attack
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 1 skills (slightly reduced the damage of "Laser Beam" in base job)
- Increased the damage of Grade 2 skills
- Increased the damage of most of the Grade 3 skills (no change in "Eraser Lv2" and "Nuclear Launcher" in base job)


[b]<Event>[/b]
1. Free Character Slot +1

2. Christmas Event (UTC+0 December 22, 2021 after maintenance - December 28, 2021 23:59)
1)Items issued daily upon login
- December 22nd: Holiday Bell Emoticon
- December 23rd: Rudolph's Nose Box
- December 24th: Pet Mittens Card
- December 25th: Box of Christmas Scarves
- December 26th: Stylish Coupon
- December 27th: +10 Bag
- December 28th: Large Potion Package

- Daily: Hero Dungeon Ticket x2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/20bafd969dbfa6b1d89a197cc50901f0d004c143.jpg[/img]

2) Christmas Santa Monster has arrived
Defeat Santa monster to get Holiday Gift Fragment then use them to craft Coordi items
- Santa will appear once at a fixed chance during normal dungeons (including Champion Mode, starting from Outer Wall of Serdin)
- Item drop rates will vary based on level difference between dungeon and character. 
- Collect Holiday Gift Fragment from Santa to craft them into Christmas Coordi Outfit and Coordi Helmet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/8d6a65c32967682bbfeec711d1cb601f0988a2cb.jpg[/img]

3. Year End and New Year Event (December 22, 2021 after maintenance - January 12, 2022 before maintenance)
1) Attendance Rewards given daily for staying logged in for 30 minutes
- Year End and New Year Lucky Pouch (1 of Rank Reset Card, SP All Reset Card, SP Reset Card, Premium GC Club (1 Day), Seal Breaker Scroll or Reinforcement Stone)
- SP Reset every Saturday
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/aca2d1787018be054e31be07a3da32037c67f85d.png[/img]

2) Every Saturday and Sunday Buff
- Extra 20% EXP from playing dungeons, extra 30% GP from all modes
- Excluding Hero Dungeons, Event Dungeons

4. Coordi Seal Breaker Set Encore Event (UTC+0 December 22, 2021 after maintenance - January 5, 2022 08:50)
- Keter Coordi Seal Breaker Set
- Sirius Coordi Seal Breaker Set
- Rexion (Dark Rexion) Coordi Seal Breaker Set
- Dokaebi King Coordi Seal Breaker Set
- Ordo Squad Coordi Seal Breaker Set
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/6a26c885556c9c727c5bf506a5c3b9d581022832.jpg[/img]

5. Balance Adjustments Event (UTC+0 December 22, 2021 after maintenance - 23:59 on December 24)
- 1 SP All Reset Card

6. Closing Event
Rainbow 7 Event
- Rewards for Happy Lil' Rainbow will be given during December 22nd maintenance via the mailbox
 - If you have more than 30 Happy Lil' Rainbow: Rainbow 7 Title Item - [ 30 Days ], Rainbow Shields - [ 30 Days ], Bag with 10 spaces x2
 - If you have 20-29 Happy Lil' Rainbow: Rainbow 7 Title Item - [ 14 Days ], Rainbow Shield - [ 14 Days ], Bag with 10 spaces x1
 - If you have 10-19 Happy Lil' Rainbow: Rainbow 7 Title Item - [ 7 Days ], Rainbow Shield - [ 7 Days ], Bag with 10 spaces x1
 - If you have 1-9 Happy Lil' Rainbow: Bag with 10 spaces x1
 Rainbow Login Event


[b]<Shop Items>[/b]
1. New Coordi Seal Breaker Set
- Rencia (Checkmate) Coordi Seal Breaker Set
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/29d7a4ffe88dd3d533b11dbd680e544055a96a8d.jpg[/img]

2. New Coordi
1) Awesome Christmas Coordi Package (Limited) (60% Discount)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/94f37417c0e45dae1eed418ee5ad38a8ce7d2058.jpg[/img]
2) Cozy Eskimo Coordi Package (Limited) (60% Discount)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/259aaa37f3cb2671b1f23055396299bd33edea26.jpg[/img]

3. New Pets
1) Christmas Mary Jane (Limited)
2) Winter Peng Peng (Limited)


[b]<Bug Fixes/Improvements>[/b]
Fixed the bug where damage counter for 'Get Hit Less than n Times' missions would count up when Ryan transforms into a wolf
Fixed the bug where Declare stance command inputs were possible even with a different job as Sieghart after he learned the shared skill Defense
Fixed the bug where static monsters could be moved when Mari, in her 3rd Job Polaris, installed Mana Divider

notes.content:
1. New character, Dio, has been added
